source_doc: 5 stars isn’t enough! I have a 1968 Yamaha F230 12 string that I bought brand new and the strings have over time raised up off the neck and made it very difficult to play. Now I plan to take it to a luthier to get it worked on but in the mean time wanted to pick up something cheap. So I took a chance on this Tario. I figured if this was junk it would make a beautiful wall hanger, and it is beautiful. The strings that came with it were junk so I put a set of Elixirs on it. This guitar has exceeded my expectations 10 fold. It plays beautifully and sounds fantastic. I had a buddy play it who owns a Goodall and he looked at me with a smile and said this thing is great. If I could have given it ten stars I would have. I try to stay away from buying things made in china but I have to admit this thing is worth ten times what I paid for it. I then bought a Gator hard shell case for it.

source_doc: Sublime now vexed, dismayed and disappointed. I waited until I had the perfect place for it. I unfurled and inflated with ease and speed. It slept beautifully! You could not tell it was an air mattress. I thought ok. I’m good until I find my bed! At least two weeks of sleep when I can as a birth worker.  I come home from an extended and taxingly long birth (DAAAYS!). My sister is surprising me with fresh linen. As she crawls to the center to get the final corner… the seam.. TEARS! She sinks. My nephew goes flying at 19 months. I literally broke into tears grabbing him. The absolute JOKE of a patch (note the square) Sticks then blows away as we begin to think of refilling. I am soul weary at730 pm this evening. So instant bond glue and duct tape to the rescue.  30 mins in. It’s filled and holding. So having no choice I will pray I can sleep on it and rest. And have to figure out what the hell to do next. I don’t know about anyone else.. but I done happen to have a spare amount of cash just waiting to purchase a bed on the fly.  I’m so very disappointed.

source_doc: Awesome!!! This pole is awesome I've never fly fished before because it seemed to be expensive and took some practice/skill to do butt this pole is super simple. I watched a bunch of videos then took a practice fly out in the yard setup a coffee can and started to practice before I new it i was able to pop that fly into the can with easy its all on the wrist. I like that the pole is all self contained i did get a line holder that attaches to the rod just above your hand so when collapsed you can just wind the line around it slip it in the tube and be on your way. I dont know that Ill every want to buy a fly rod I have several lengths and weights of tippet lines and most of the small streams and brooks I fish are tight quarters so your not able to cast a country mile anyway. I suppose on the bigger lakes you would want a fly rod too but the portability of this rod is awesome I would recommend trying one out especial if you already have the fly gear its quick to setup and be on the edge of in the water with 13 ft and a 12-16 ft  tippet you can get a decent amount of distance and accuracy. I think its a great setup for beginners or pro's its just another style of fishing.

source_doc: Pretty Good. I haven’t been in a sleeping bag in a long time.  So I got this and tried it in the back yard.  Well, I picked a cold night with wind, below 30 on the mercury, and it did good.I had no tent which might have been ok if I had no wind.  It was cold.  But I did sleep, about as good as I could expect for the conditions.  I used my field coat to cover my face but the wind woke me up many times.I’m a little over 6 foot and medium build, I fit in the bag.  I feel like my head could have a little more room but it wasn’t a problem.Most importantly for me was having a very thin foam filled self inflating mattress.  it kept me off the cold ground.  And it was much better than being directly on the lumpy ground.  Again, a tent would helped a lot with the wind.Not that I needed it, but the bag has snaps that let it shut without being closed, or maybe there’s another purpose.  The zipper worked great.  The sleeping bag rolls back up easily to fit the carrying bag.I think with a blanket and a tent I would do just fine camping for a weekend.  Hope this helps you.

source_doc: Mixed feelings. The 2 star is for THIS mat I bought. I must admit, it's taken me 5 years to write this review.  But I just used my OLD Jade mat and thought I should write this review.  I have mixed feeling because I bought a Jade mat at my yoga studio and have used it for many years. Great mat! I love it.  It was getting kind of dingy, so I thought I would use that one at home and buy another one for the studio.  So I bought this orange one. After about 2-3 months of uses, and past the return, it started to deteriorate.  I'd find orange specks all over my pants, as it was visibly breaking down. Life was busy so I just shoved the new crappy one in a closet and went back to using my old mat, which is over 10 years old and holding up.  I can't get it sparkling clean looking, but at least it's not falling apart.  I'm still disappointed that I wasted $80. Why was one mat great and durable and the other one crappy?

source_doc: Ordered 2 new monitors. One was already opened. When I opened the first shipping box, I saw that the product box inside was not sealed. The tape appeared to have been cut or torn. I thought maybe i had cut it when opening the outer box, or maybe the tape had split. It wasn't until I started opening the second monitor's box that I realized the first one was used. The second one had a padded bag around the speaker. The first did not. The second one had the volume knob turned all the way down. The first one had it turned all the way up.I would have rated these 5 stars, easily. They sound great. But sending used products to people paying new prices is unacceptable. I don't know how much it has been used. I don't know if it was abused. I don't know if someone else registered the serial number, which could cause me issues if I have a warranty issue down the line. I would not have ordered these if I knew I would be getting a used one. So I'm knocking it down to 3 stars.

I believe that the price is a little high as similar products sell for quite a bit less, but if it keeps working for me it is worth it.

source_doc: Love it! I honestly don’t know why I haven’t tried a silicone insert for my air fryer sooner! Washing the air fryer basket is a nightmare and I can never seem to get it a clean as I would like. If I had been using one of these wonderful inventions a long time ago, I would not have had this problem. I absolutely love this set! They fit my Ninja air fryer basket perfectly and clean so easily. I can hand wash these or run them through the dishwasher. I haven't used them other than in the air fryer, but I can certainly see many other uses as they can withstand heat up to 450°. The only time I probably would not use these is the air fryer is if I am cooking bacon since I want the bacon to drain and not sit in its grease unless it's just one or two slices. These will certainly last a very long time and I don’t see that I will ever need to replace them. Since they come as a set of two, I will always have one handy!  Great quality!

source_doc: Not bright, what timer function? I was excited about this great deal; batteries with the lights were enticing. I thought how easy it was all together.  I got the lights and put them together, put them up, and then got the remote to set the lights. The first night they were great, shining bright in the windows. The second night I noticed they were not all turned on, so I reset them and paid extra attention to the settings, so I wasn't making a mistake. I saw the next night that the lights were again not turning on together. I had to manually turn them on so many times, which was a nuisance. I don't know if the remote was not working correctly or if there is just something wrong with the lights, but they were so difficult to use. The lights were supposed to be on every night for 8hr max. (according to the remote setting) but they seemed like they would turn off after 2 to 4 hours, no matter how I adjusted them and redid the remote. The most upsetting part was that the batteries they came with didn't even last until Christmas. By Christmas day, more than half of the 12 lights I had in my windows were completely dead. I don't recommend these lights; very disappointed.

source_doc: I actually live these. I live alone and have two doors in the back of my house that I don't use that often. I wanted something that was simple, but made me feel better about forgetting about those doors. I bought three of these, and I honestly like them. The "locking" feature on them is slightly annoying when I'm trying to take out the trash and I need both hands to unlock it, but I would rather have that annoyance that it be easier to undo the chain.They were simple to install and I felt that they were made very well and felt sturdy. The only thing I did different on installation was use longer screws than what was provided. But that was just my preference.All in all I think these are great locks to have as just an extra lock for any door.

source_doc: Nice low glow color ring. I wanted an adjustable light in my bedroom but I didn't have a ceiling mount (where I wanted to put it) in place with the wires to the breaker box. Since the lamp itself was very lightweight, I wired with old lamp parts that plugged into a wall socket. It worked out perfectly for me. I like that I can turn off the main light with the color ring on for the late nights and serves as a nicely dimmed nightlight. There are several light settings to choose from to please any mood or brightness needed. The main light is impressively bright and can be toned down to my preference at that moment. When I turn everything off and turn it on the next day, it remembers my last settings of both lights. To me at first, the remote was a little complicated to figure out and remember each buttons capabilities. Even after a week I was fiddling around with the remote to change the settings where I wanted. Now that I got the hang of it, I love this light and happy that I decided to order this one out of several different choices I was considering. This lamp has many setting option and I would recommend it for any room.

source_doc: The plastic adheres when soaked. I bought these as liners for my reusable belly bands. First of all, I realize they do give measurements but you definitely need to go larger than a belly band sizing to get them to fit, so I should've gotten bigger ones. I think the length is inadequate to the width for the absorbance to wick away if you have an excessive urinator, which I do. But the worst part is when they're fully soaked, which happens quickly with my foster cairn that had bladder stones previously, then the plastic backing will sort of permanently stick to your fabric belly band. I had to soak in very hot water and pick away at it to get it all off. This had happened several times, so I won't be rebuying. I honestly should return them it's so bad. I much rather keep with the disposable Amazon brand wraps. My dog chews on those so I have to cover with a fabric one to keep him from eating them and as backup if they become soaked. I'm honestly surprised at the rating level on these, because that's why I tried them. It should be lower.

source_doc: Not anti-kink hose. I've had this hose for over 4 years now and have used it many times in the travel trailer.  I also have the 10' version to use when the trailer is much closer to the water outlet at campgrounds.  I wish I could use the 10 footer all the time, but many times I need to get the 25' hose out, which drives me nuts.  It's a real pain to put back in the storage bin if it's slightly cold out as it won't coil up neatly and I have to fling it all around to get it to curve correctly so it goes in the bin.  It has several kinks in it that won't go away.  So, yeah, not anti-kink in my opinion and it's been that way ever since I got it.  (Didn't realize I hadn't reviewed it until I was searching my orders for another hose I purchased a few years ago.)  I'm about ready to toss it as I just ordered another 10 footer and will connect the two together when I need to.  The good thing about the hose - knock wood, it's never leaked or split in the years of periodic usage.  But, yeah, anti-kink is a lie.  Can't really address the hooking issue as I have it hooked to a Hose-Grip from J Wright Concepts, which is wonderful and a device every camper needs!

source_doc: Not A Bad Alternative For Cat Litter. I wasn't so sure about this litter but I was surprised that it was not so bad. I have 3 cats and 2 litter boxes so the main issue I have with cat litter is the strong smell that the boxes leave around the house. I've tried all kinds of litter and while they do work it doesn't get rid of the smell entirely. I started using this mixed litter and it works really well. I know the litter is flushable but I feel better just throwing it away when I clean the boxes. The cats took a bit to get used to the mixed litter but I was surprised that it did handle the odor really well. I would have to get more bags to handle my 3 cats but I would use this Mixed Litter again because it did get rid of the odor and easy upkeep.

I really hope this one doesn't break.  Other than that, I love this thing.  It isn't huge like most of them, and it works for what I need, counting steps and as a silent alarm.

source_doc: Do not overtighten the bolts. I bought this about a year and a half ago based on the features and reviews. source_doc: Surprisingly comfy for a good night's sleep! This turned out to be a life saver on a recent camping trip. I was planning on tent camping but during the night the weather turned and I was pummeled by rain & hail. My tent is great in the rain, but I was set up in a low area and the space under the tent quickly turned into a lake and my tent turned into a giant waterbed. Since I had this in the car, I decided to inflate it and see how it worked. It was pretty easy to set up/inflate quickly and it was SO comfortable! I was honestly surprised at how comfortable it was. I'm 5'0 and had to sleep a little curled up, so if you're taller, consider how you like to sleep.The only downside is in my Mazda 3 I had to move the front seats all the way up to fit it, so I can't drive around with it installed. I could probably pull the pieces out of the footwells and angle the mattress a bit to push the seats back to drive, but haven't tried it yet. I do love the versatility this provides! Now I have another option for camping when I don't want to go through the hassle of setting up a tent for just one night.

source_doc: Using as an Ice Bin. I am writing this review and including pictures for those, like myself, who wants to use this as an ice bin.  I don't have a refrigerator with an built in ice maker and so I needed something to store a bag of ice.  I had originally purchased the 21 cup LocknLock but when it arrived, it didn't look big enough to hold a big bag of ice; so I sent that one back and ordered this 50.7 cup LocknLock bin.  It is large and takes up almost half to the upper freezer shelf but as I have a separate stand alone freezer, this isn't a problem.  What I like about it is that this bin have a large front door that I can scoop ice out of.  The lid snaps easily in place and the base seems pretty solid so I don't expect any leakage.  No cons so far but will update if I experience any.  The pictures shown are what was left of the bag of ice I'd purchase, so about a quarter of the bag.  I think another bag of ice will fill this bin completely full.

source_doc: Black and Gold Luxurious Dining Setup. I got sold on this table cloth’s color combination.  A black table cloth with a separate gold sequin table runner is a clever idea.  I thought that the gold fabric was attached to the black cloth, but when I opened the package, I saw that they were two pieces.  Please see the photos I posted.This table cloth is a perfect size for my kitchen's island marble table.  I love that I can decorate my table with just black cloth or spice it up, and I can lay out in the middle of the gold sequin runner.  I could even use a different table-runner.  I think I will buy this company's rose-gold variant, so I can mix and match them.The fabric had no toxic odor.  The black cloth would be easy to clean, but the gold sequin I believe needs careful and gentle methods for removing food stains.  This table cloth plus the gold sequin runner appears luxurious, except for the gold runner edges.  The easiest, fastest, and cheapest way to prevent fabric from fraying is to use sergers and form a zigzag pattern across the edges that this table runner utilizes.  I wish that the manufacturer fold the edges of this table runner and create a seam that would make it perfectly nice.For the kitchen/dining aesthetic, it will bring for a reasonable price, and I would say this gets my thumbs up approval!  Highly recommended!

source_doc: All I can say is "WOW"!!! I was skeptical of this type of product and its claims of moving dust/dirt out of my car's interior versus a standard blowgun. I always thought it was the same PSI getting to the gun, how can it possibly be better? I finally broke down and bought this version as it was cheaper than the recommended one I see in all the car detailing groups. I hooked it up the day I got it and did a side-by-side comparison with my metal blowgun. My standard blowgun blew up a little dust on the floorboard of my wife's Jeep for the first test, and then after I attached the Vortex and went to it, it was literally a dust storm. I had to move away from the vehicle to get fresh air. I am literally blown away by this product and time will tell for the longevity of the product.I highly recommend this to anyone looking to up their car interior cleaning game. I will be bragging about this to my friends & family, it truly is a great product, and I would buy it again if ever needed.

source_doc: Works great for pets. I am using this item to secure my dog's car seat/booster seat. The lap belt of my rear seat hooks into her car seat. I liked that I could actually lock the belt nice and tight so in case of an accident, her seat would be as immobile as possible. This is a great invention, and I wish I would have found it when caring for my grandfather who had dementia. I can't tell you how many times I would slow down the car to park, and he would be releasing his seat belt and trying to get out of a still moving car. I did have a little trouble getting the belt locking clip on my seatbelt. (I have a 2018 or 2019 Buick Encore). I took a little trial and error, but after about 5 minutes, I locked it where I wanted it.

source_doc: Slight Odor in the Bags. I am not as impressed with this PAMI brand of gallon storage bags as I was with their quart-sized double lock bags.  There are 100 bags but NO twist ties were included with my order even though it states it on the box.  I have a ton of extra twist ties, so I moved on.  The bag is wider and shorter than my store bought ones.  So, it probably is still gallon sized.  I do like that the top is slightly uneven for easy opening.  I also like that there’s multiple suffocation warning prints on the front.Why did I give it 3 stars?  When I opened one to place prepared vegetables, I noticed a slight odor.  It’s not unpleasant or plasticky.  My store bought ones don’t have an odor.  Even though the bags are BPA-free, I decided to use it for storing non-food items, just to be safe.  For storing craft items, they are quite useful.  Each bag is about 8 cents, so twice as much as generic store-bought ones.  I would give it a resounding five stars, if it weren’t for the odor.

source_doc: Not enough fragrance. I really wanted to like this product. When it came out of the package, the scent packets smelled amazing. I put it in its holder and stuck it to the side of my trash can, which has its own tall cabinetry drawer. I expected to come back and smell lemons the next time I opened the trash drawer. I just smelled trash. I took the trash out and put a new trash bag in and shut the door. When I came back, I still could not smell lemons. I finally leaned over towards the scent packet and had to practically press my nose against the plastic holder to smell the lemons. I revisited the trash several times over two days and it never improved. I won’t be ordering this product again. The convenience of the holder and the great scent doesn’t make a difference if you can only smell it when it is in your face.

source_doc: A Practice Tool. I bought this transmitter specifically for practice.  I don't think I'd ever use a low-end wireless for a live performance.  There are too many cross signals that will cause signal drop.  I was surprised when I got some drop in my practice room.  To be fair, not long after it dropped a few times, the battery died about 10 minutes later. So that was probably the cause so kudos because it didn't drop more frequently.  The volume control is not linear, at least by my experience.  It went from to quite to booming with just a few touches.  I had to play with it a bit to get the level where I wanted it.  I also noticed the wireless is tonally different than the cord.  Actually, I like the sound a bit better.  I didn't notice that difference with my other wireless system.  I have only used this device in my practice room so, I don't know how it will react if practicing with a group, especially if there are other wireless devices in the room.  When I know, I'll update this review.

source_doc: Expensive. After watching a few videos I purchased this lacquer to refinish an old Gibson guitar.  I applied gloss black lacquer over automotive primer.  I bought two cans @ $35 for each can.  I followed the instructions and warmed the cans before use. The first can applied fairly evenly but the second can I had all kinds of problems with splatter.  I had to sand out some big globs of paint and put on another coat.  I tried shaking the can, heating warmer and lower but the splatter would not stop.  I had to spray for a couple of seconds then clean the nozzle with a rag to stop the splatter. The other problem was orange peel.  I have used other brands for 1/3 the price and gotten better results.  If I had to do this over again, I would use a less expensive lacquer.

source_doc: Native DualSense touchpad on PS4 with new firmware. I love my DualSense controller, it's amazing, and I don't own a PS5 primarily being a PC gamer.  Recently dusted off my old PS4 to discover that I was running firmware 8.5, and thus could jailbreak it on 9.00, breathing life back into the old device.  The DS4 controller is good, but it's no DualSense, so I set out looking for a way to usef the DualSense on PS4.  I had previously purchased a Magic-NS a couple years ago to use it with a Switch, so I looked into Mayflash devices again.Enter the Magic-S.  All around it was exactly what I was searching for.  I could pair the controller to the device and then move it between the various platforms I game on without having to repair it.  Only setback was touchpad wasn't fully functional.  However I contacted the developers, discovered there is a way to do gestures on it, but it was clunky.  Well new firmware came out a day or two ago and now there is native touchpad with DualSense on PS4!  Freaking amazing!Highly reccomened if you are looking to use your PS5 controller on a PS4 or other devices.  And superb communications when I bumped into pebkac issues.  Thanks!

source_doc: Nice kit with plenty of extensions. I used this to pull the center drive shaft bearing on my BMW. I found it really easy to setup and get everything in place. I had to use a pair of extenders to reach down the shaft a ways, but even with them combined I found that the tool worked perfectly.All of the pieces are well made and precisely cast. There is a pretty sharp edge to the bearing separator that is great for some applications. This tool is made of cast metal, but it's stronger than I expected.The case is great also at keeping things organized.This is my first tool from Orion Motor Tech, but I'm happy enough that I'll look for their brand next time.Update 02/20/23...I have now used this to remove 5 different bushing or bearing sets and I'm Really Really happy with it. The last bushing I removed was the lower control arm bushing and I used a low torque impact wrench to turn the shaft instead of my fixed ratchet. No matter what I throw at this tool it remains looking and working like brand new. If I lose this one day I would buy it again. Of course I can't imagine it breaking at this point, but I would buy it again in that case as well.

source_doc: There are 2 white wires. This is going to take some playing to determine which is the hot and which is the neutral. I have never seen any light fixtures with all wires being the same color.The light is pretty enough to look at. It's  a light for an RV, how pretty does it need to be? I bought it to provide light in a space with no windows.Having to wire one way and hope it works, then possibly have to switch the wires to make it work is stupid. A little tape or marker on the hot or neutral can not cost that much.Further, there are no instructions,  nada, zip, zilch. It's a good thing I just replaced 5 other lights in the RV or this would be going back. I'll have to mark a wire so I know which way I had it if it doesn't work the first way I try it.Also, there are 8 holes in the light for screws, but only 4 screws provided. They should be enough, but why put in 8 holes if you only need 4 screws?The light is led, so energy efficiency should be good. I don't pay for electric where I currently am, so I don't know how much savings there will be. I may update after I get this thing up.

source_doc: Exactly what I have searched for to help my dark circles! Years ago I used the green Garnier under eye for dark circles and no idea when/why I stopped. I was searching for something to help my dark circles (I’m very pale and 52 yes old) as even if I was able to cover them up initially, an hour later it looked horrible and crepey. I saw this product mentioned on reddit and several people called it their “holy grail”.I tried it in the am, before a shower as I was curious if it lived up to the hype. I was amazed! Very little goes a long way. I tapped it around my under-eye area and it looked great. Plus, it didn’t look crepey/dry an hour later.It also lasts and looked great at the end of the day. I’m thrilled to find something that works! Today I did a full face of makeup and a tiny bit of concealer over the top was my only addition. I can’t recommend it enough!

source_doc: great stabilizers and super pretty!!! OMG! I LOVE these rings! I purchased a set of 6"-12" crystal bowls from Amazon. I really enjoy them, as does my kitty Olivia who regularly totally blisses out listening to them! (The root chakra bowl is her favorite, in case your interested!) The only problem was that the tiniest bowl, the crown chakra bowl, was seriously unstable. I found it super difficult and frustrating to play. The problem may well have been that I have the bowls on carpet. I don't know, although I did try setting it on a stone coaster. (Desperate, I know!)  But it got frustrating enough that I eventually replaced it with an 8" bowl. I needn't have bothered! The new ring perfectly, absolutely, 100% stablizes the bowl, perhaps because it raises it above the caarpet. I don't know! I DO know that these rings are much thicker and actually  hug the bowl. Also, unlike the rubber rings which seem to come in only 2 sizes,  these are individually sized to fit each bowl. The bowls aslo seem to sound better. The carpet issue again?? They are also color coordinated to each bowl and are readily visible, so they are super pretty, I mean, really pretty! I am thrilled with this purchase.

source_doc: Initial thoughts are good. I went from a hard folding cover to this one due to the weight of taking the cover on and off. I just always kept the hard cover on but I bought an ATV that will be riding in the bed of the truck. I like having something over the bed when driving around. I've never had a soft cover before, but that was the only option to get away from the weight. I went with this one as I needed the bed rails free for a removable rack I use with the tonneau. This one sits nice and flush. The only reason I took a star is the cover is completely flat, it has some ripples in it that run the length of the bed. I'm thinking this will probably settle, but for now I'm taking a star. The only other slight issue is the front clips are harder to snap in place than I expected. Again, I think this will probably resolve once it's been installed a while.Update: Had to return it. Maybe it's the tailgate mat I have installed or the way it fits on the rails, but the tailgate hits on the rail and makes it really hard to close. I have the rail all the way forward and it's still hitting on the drivers side. I can close it, but it's much harder.

source_doc: Buy them! I bought these 20 inch extensions about 3 years ago and they are still in such great shape. I dyed to match my hair, I hardly style them, I like the natural curl in them, it matches my own hair texture. Just ordered the 14 inch which is still about an inch longer than my real hair since my real hair is extremely fine and thin. That will give me a naturally voluminous look. These are super soft, curl, straighten and color with ease. For the price of $100 I can look like I spent $500 on tape ins at the salon. And I can reuse far past the 3 month mark on my tape ins. I will also say being a person with incredibly fine/thin hair, I have tried all types of hair pieces, weaves, ponytails, wigs, you name it. And my scalp is very tender. I can wear the full set of the 20 inches for 8 hrs with no headache. Not heavy at all. I can't wait to get my new 14 inch ones colored and in rotation. Love this company! Wish they made ponytail pieces and lace fronts too because the hair is SO nice for the price! Minimal shedding and minimal tangling. Buy it!!!

source_doc: Great for traveling. I have 7 kids so I've had a lot of baby gear. This is one thing I wish I bought sooner. It's very compact and easy to set up. I used it for my toddler at Thanksgiving when we visited family out of state. He's currently 20 months and I anticipate it wouldn't work well once he's two because it's a little small. His little brother will use it later. I just set it up on the floor and still need to install the straps to used on a chair so I can't say if it's easy or not. The main things I love about the booster is the look and the removable tray insert. The only thing I think is dumb is the little spot on the tray that has like a cut out for tiny utensils. It's pointless because only doll utensils are that small. Other than that I love it. It's sturdy and easy to use. Oh and the best part is the way the tray can be removed or swing open on either side. It's a good design. Also the cover is easier removable to be washed which is a must! That makes it better than other brands I looked at.

source_doc: You guys…buy this ASAP! This thing is magical! Seriously. Where has this been all my life??? Why have I been sleeping on this!? Why have I been using a blower dryer AND a round brush all my hair drying life when I could’ve been using this all along? Well maybe this didn’t exist, but it does now and that’s all that matters.With a blow dryer, it would normally take me 45-60 min to blow dry my hair. I have THICK hair, that’s somewhat coarse and curly/wavy, but even more textured towards my scalp/hairline. It’s impossible to straighten with a blow dryer and I heavily rely on a flat iron. AND I can’t blow dry my hair as soon as I get out of the shower. I typically have to wait 30-45 min for it to air dry some or else I’m standing there sweating for eternity while 20 hairs dry. It’s torture.I don’t know what kinda witchery this is, but I literally blow dried my hair in 30-40 min today. Straight out the shower! What?! And flat ironing was minimal! I can’t believe it. I’m beyond happy!The dryer seemed kind of loud, but it’s powerful. The heat felt kind of too hot at times, but I had it on the highest setting. I just had to make sure I didn’t let it blow on my skin/scalp for too long or it would get uncomfortable. Aside from that, it’s perfection. Believe the hype. Seriously.

source_doc: Beautiful drawer handles! I was upset when I opened these because I had ordered the rose gold, and I was only going to give three stars for receiving the wrong color. However, after looking at these more closely and holding them up to my cabinets, I actually think I like these better. Not only are they gorgeous, they match all of my oil rubbed bronze fixtures throughout my house. My mailbox, house numbers, all faucets, towel racks, shower racks, and some decor are the rubbed bronze color, and these tie in perfectly with that theme. These handles have a nice weight to them, you can tell they are real metal. They feel so smooth and luxurious to the touch. The pictures really don’t do them justice, it’s so hard to tell from a photo but these really are extremely nice drawer handles. I’m waiting until I get my cabinets refinished to use them in the kitchen, but I tested out the screws and they fit seamlessly into the handles. Sometimes with screws they feel like they just don’t like up right and it’s a pain to get them in all the way but these fit in flawlessly. I like that the screws are cuttable too, depending on the thickness of your drawer front/cabinet. Overall these are what I would call deluxe drawer/cabinet handles, and I would highly recommend them.

source_doc: Handiest thing you never knew you needed! Absolutely loved these clips! I bought them originally because those hanging toys made for the car seats always slipped everywhere on the baby’s car seat handle. Drove me nuts! I looked for these and they did not disappoint! I’ve used them before to clip a Muslim blanket to my shirt so I can nurse when I’ve forgotten my cover. So many things! They are durable and I have yet to break any.

source_doc: Simple versus Stanley. Simple modern every day hands-down! I bought this one because it had my football team logo on it even though I received a Stanley for Christmas. I have since bought two more simple modern tumblers.My simple modern is light weight and holds ice until the next day. It is perfect for my iced coffee. My ice does not melt down and water down my product. Of course no tumbler is spill proof when there is a straw involved however, it does not leak when it spills over unless it comes out of the straw when it’s been completely flipped. I found that out when I hit the brakes and my lunch bag went flying from the car seat to the floorboard upside down. With a Stanley, it does not seem to keep ice as long and I do get the water down effect and it is heavier. also when it tips it doesn’t leak not only from the straw but the straw hole in the sides of the lid. I do have the new Stanley H2O.Another great thing about the Simple Modern is the price.  It’s affordable and I definitely use it. There is a $10 price difference between this and the Stanley.I absolutely love this and and I am definitely more hydrated and I noticed that my skin does not look as dry. I would recommend this cup.

That said, this one is as good as it gets. The fact that it truely is GOOD GRIPS and sturdy, and it does not bend or warp when you are using it, are what makes it safer than others i have tried.As I age, my hands suffer more each day from the years of cutting and chopping, i can't slice as acurately as i used too, so this short cut helps me in that way, too.I have put it in the dishwasher 100's of times, and i see no wear and tear form that. source_doc: Just what I needed. With a young kid and a baby on the way I wanted something that could accommodate both kids. I like that the baby seat can recline or go more upright as my little one grows.  The canopy is small but easy to position.  I like how easy it is to fold up, this works best when the basket is empty.  I do not have the matching car seat so I can not comment on that.

source_doc: I'm REALLY Impressed. At the beginning of pandemic, I was constantly on video calls/doing virtual presentations etc. I heard a lot of  other people in meetings where you could barely understand them, and decided that I didn't want that to be me. I decided to buy a Blue Yeti because I figured it's probably important that other people can hear you speaking.After a few months, I upgraded to the Shure SM7B. It was an incredible upgrade and I was very happy with it. If you can, start with the Shure as opposed to a USB mic.Fast forward a few years, and I'm doing meetings and hosting webinars at least once a day. I heard the Neumann U87 is what NPR uses and I wanted to up the professionalism. I couldn't stomach paying $3500 for a U87, so I decided to compromise and get the TLM 103. It's a huge step up from the Shure.Both are great, but the 103 is way less fuzzy and sounds a lot more like my actual voice. A bonus, is that now I don't have to use a $150 cloud lifter to get decent sound out of the Shure. I highly recommend this product. The price is still a kick in the teeth, but it's noticeably better than anything I'd tried previously.

source_doc: Love this kit, would love to buy another, but don't try to take throught TSA checkpoint. I bought this to tune my piano and my parents' piano; theirs was way out of tune, and I had not tuned a piano before.  I watched a youtube tutorial or two, got the panotuner app, and ordered this kit.  I was able to get my parents' piano sounding much better in just a few minutes.  Unfortunately, I tried to carry the kit through the TSA checkpoint, and it would not go (the tuner device is a tool more than 7 inches) so I had to ship it to my parents' house, and I left it there.  My piano is also slightly out of tune, but I am hoping they will restock and I can get another kit like the one I got my parents.  Otherwise, I will be shipping that tuning kit back to me in a few months.  Much cheaper than hiring a piano tuner, and just as effective.

source_doc: It is better than i expected with a small cabinet!!! I have a sub that is a 6" that I paired with a set of Presonus Ceres 4.5BT monitors. The bass was lacking and I wanted something a little stronger. I ordered it and It was delivered in 24 hours on prime. It is much smaller than I expected. source_doc: Love the Zero Water concept; Filter Quality Control Is A Problem. Normally I try to be positive with my reviews of products, however with these replacement Zero Water filters it is a struggle. Love the 23 cup Zero Water I purchased. The  original Filter that came with the dispenser worked perfect. Came time to replace the filter, I purchased the 6 pack, (I was committed). First filter I tried I let set overnight to give it "a chance". Next morning, no filtered water, surprise, surprise. Opened a second filter and installed it. Fourteen hours later I had 8 cups of water. 2 for 2 bad. Too late smart, I looked on the web for other people having a similar experience. I found I was not alone, in fact I was one of many, many people experiencing quality issues with the Zero Water filters. Since I purchased them as a 6 box set, I have to return them as a set. I can't begin to tell you how disappointed I am with this whole experience. And by the way, they were original equipment manufacturer with the name proudly emblazoned on the side. Love/hate, you have to be ready for a measure of both with this product.

source_doc: Best Bassinet!! This bassinet is absolutely perfect. I am so happy with it! I bought 2 because my daughter had twins. Best baby buy EVER. I wanted a bassinet that had the side to side glide but I wanted it to be sturdy and it not be able to shift a baby into the side panels (we have 5 and 3 yr old siblings.) I wasn't crazy about the all white but it works so beautifully it could be puke green and worth every penny.If I were on the design team I would change that the glide motion have an "always on" feature for the exhausted new mom in addition to the 60 min timer.  I would improve the sound quality. Its harsh. The white noise and nature sounds are great but not so much the music. I would not have the flashing light. We havent figured out exactly what the flashing light is all about. I'm sure it's just that we haven't set up the wifi yet. Which we will get to and update if it changes our perception of the bassinet.I have 4 children and I have 6 grandchildren. I wish this product was around for the past 40 years!!!

source_doc: After a year of trying, I'm over it. I was gifted the Gaming Mouse during the December 2021/ January 2022 holiday season. This item was purchased via Amazon.The mouse started randomly dying and coming back. By that I mean my PC would say it had disconnected, the mouse LEDs would turn off and it the mouse would not respond. Upon research and inspection, it appears that the power cord connection is faulty.There is no stress to the cord, there are no pets or children around to have damaged it. I emailed the seller on Friday, Apr 8, 2022 to inform them of the issue. At that time, I had not had the mouse long enough to consider this routine wear and tear. I love the size and shape of the mouse so I would much rather get a replacement than simply returning it. I received not response. I rigged the mouse together and just focused on controller gaming. It is now January 2023. I loved how big the mouse was so I really tried to like it but its stupid to try and make this work. Please do not buy it. "Lizsword" has a way better mouse. Equally affordable and lasts way longer. My husband has had that brand for years so I should have started with that one.

source_doc: My dog started using this as a chew toy. I purchased this because slip leads seem to be recommended and my dog was pulling a lot. My adopted dog was like a completely different dog once out of the shelter. When I first saw her at the shelter, she was calm, no pulling whatsoever. I sign the papers and she immediately started pulling and running up to each thing.I noticed that the leash they use for the shelter dogs was a slip lead and the leash they give you upon adoption is a standard. I thought it must have something to do with the leash and ordered this one.While she walked better on this leash, she would also rile herself up and decide to start attacking it and playing tug of war. I saw a video on how to turn your slip lead into a harness - it worked better, but wasn't perfect. I ultimately switched to a short leash and harness because I can almost hold the leash loosely without problems with that combination. Even if I hadn't gone that way I wouldn't still be using this leash - someone else walked her for a few days with it and I didn't notice till later it has been chewed through - if she did decide to run I could not trust the leash in its current state to restrain her.

source_doc: Its ok. not great, but not terrible. I looked at almost every bedside bassinet on market. Read every review, and ended up getting this one. Its not bad. its ok. I dont see much of an issue with sturdiness like some report. I think if you push with force any object even a livingroom couch you can get it to teeter totter. I think the collapsable feature to fold up and set back up is not as simple as i had thought. I wish i had watched a video of someone doing both. I imagine we will leave it assembled and just pick it up to go to another room if needed. The height has 4 settings, although not as high as i imagined. it wont even line up flush with our basic bedframe and matress i think is low to begin with, sits lower. For what it is and for the price, i cant imagine any other would be any better. So, for now, it may work out. baby not here yet, so havent actually used it yet.

source_doc: I thought it had an on off button. I have a few Snarks  and the pivoting features  have broken..  I had tried to duct tape them, but  ultimately they were finished... Since I have several guitars, my theory is to have a tuner with each guitar... everything in it's place. to replace the Snarks, I ordered 2 FENDER  tuners, wanting to try something different.I  was pleasantly pleased! Fender's oval hinge feature makes me believe that I will not have any breakage issues. The tuner's panel is very easy to read and shuts off in 5 minutes. I've had these tuners  for 2 days now, and so far they are pretty nice. Of course i will come back and update later on in the year, but for now i give it 4 stars until I witness the Fender's durability.One thing I didn't count on, was the lack of an on/off switch. I almost sent the tuners back, but tried it out for the hell of it. The on/off is automatic and shuts itself off in 5 minutes, which is more than enough time to tune up.  If you are jamming and want to tune later in your session, all you have to do is unclip from guitar re-clip to the head stock. I'm guessing the on/off switch is paired up with the tuner's clip on screw. It's not that bad of a feature.Good Job, Fender!

source_doc: Exactly what I needed in my closet. These are great! There are two different sizes you can order and I chose the smaller ( I think its like 7 inches)  since I wanted to use them in a sliding door closet with limited wall space. I put one on each end, at two different levels and now I can see my clothes so much better when I slide the doors open. Now, I slide the closet door open, the lights come right on and so much easier! And I can make it hand-held if I want an even closer look. They have a magnetic strip that attached them to the wall and it just pops off and on. The bigger size would probably give even more light, but for the space I had to use them, the smaller size work just great. I have mine set at the auto setting so they turn on activated by motion and shut off automatically once the door is closed again after like 20 seconds. But you can also just use the on/off switch if that’s better for you.

source_doc: Sleek flosser. I love this flosser.  Opening it up, it looks and feels like a quality piece.  What I love most about it, is its sleek and minimalist design. I'm a sucker for a good design, and It doesn't look like every other flosser you see out there.  It's well designed, and easy to hold and use.After I charged it up and cleaned all the necessary pieces, I tried it out for the first time.  Filling it is quick, with the reservoir at the top.  It's very easy to use, you can change the levels simply by pressing the power button. Mine was set at the strongest setting, and I quickly adjusted it to a lower setting.  Even at the lowest setting, It does a fantastic job at getting all the dirty bits out of my teeth, leaving my mouth feeling extra clean.  I've only felt the need to use the standard nozzle so far, but the others are there for when I need them.Verdict:  I'm so glad I got this. It's worth it's price in my opinion.  I love the design of it, I don't mind if it's sitting outside on the counter, and not put away. I would absolutely purchase this again if I ever needed to replace this one in a few years.

source_doc: Wonderful! I absolutely love this product! The older I get the more trouble sleeping I seem to have. For the longest time I was taking an acetaminophen nighttime formula, but I was getting concerned about taking that every day and decided that it was time to try a melatonin supplement and I am so glad that I did! Not only are the gummies very tasty, but within 30 minutes of taking two of these at bedtime, I feel the need to sleep. Although there is a small amount of sugar in these gummies the sugar does not seem to bother me, and I am very sensitive to sugar especially when trying to sleep. Not only do I fall asleep faster, I stay asleep except for the occasional times I have to use the bathroom due to an “old age” bladder.  The jar is rather big as it contains 100 gummies. Suggested use is 2 gummies at bedtime so this jar will last me 50 days if I should need to use them every night.  From the makers of Nyquil, this formula works great for me, and I plan on having these in stock at my house for as long as they do.

source_doc: Helps for arthritis-type pain. Many reviewers say the capsules are big. I agree. I take with a cupful of water and thoroughly wet it before swallowing but it still sticks in my throat for a few minutes. I don’t know why.That said, this supplement is amazing. Another reviewer mentioned it helped with her arthritis. I don’t know if what I have is arthritis, but for nearly a year I have had pain in my left hand and have not been able to close my fingers completely into a fist. Not even halfway. I tried creams, ibuprofen, Tylenol, and even dmso, and nothing helped the pain or changed how my fingers closed. It got to the point I became used to the pain and basically accepted it as my new normal until I got around to seeing a doctor—not easy to do in the rural area I live in. So when I read the review that mentioned how it helped with the person’s arthritis, I looked at my hand. I had only been taking it for 2 or 3 days, but the pain was gone, and I could close my hand almost completely. I hadn’t even noticed! I take only one capsule a day now (half the daily dosage), and take it with liposomal vitamin c for better absorption, and my hand is doing great. I’m sure it must be helping me in other ways I don’t recognize. Great product!

Jiná recenzentka zmínila, že jí pomohl s artritidou. Nevím, zda to, co mám, je artritida, ale už téměř rok mě bolí levá ruka a nedokážu úplně sevřít prsty v pěst. Ani z poloviny. Zkoušel/a jsem krémy, ibuprofen, Tylenol a dokonce i DMSO a nic od bolesti nepomohlo ani nezměnilo to, jak prsty zavírám. Došlo to až do bodu, kdy jsem si na bolest zvykl/a a v podstatě ji přijal/a jako svůj nový normál, než se dostanu k lékaři – což není v venkovské oblasti, kde žiji, vůbec jednoduché. Takže když jsem četl/a recenzi, ve které bylo zmíněno, jak to dotyčnému pomohlo s artritidou, podíval/a jsem se na svou ruku. Bral/a jsem to teprve 2 nebo 3 dny, ale bolest byla pryč a ruku jsem mohl/a sevřít téměř úplně. Ani jsem si toho nevšiml/a! source_doc: If you put together many items, this is a great addition to your toolbox. I have a drill with hex bits and this ratcheting wrench set - it shaves about half the time to put the item together, for real! Woo-hoo!  Thank you drill and ratcheting wrenches for that!  The heads included should help with most of the items you will encounter in household item builds and for me, that's enough!

source_doc: Great console organizer! Even better with a few modifications! I got the one without the coin holder and USB ports! I did this for several reasons:1. I want to use a rapid charger for my phone2. I've read reviews about the coin holder being a knuckle buster when putting the car in park3. Better utilization of space to not have the USB ports taking up space in an already small compartment.So i made a few modifications to an already great console organizer. I used my dremel to cut a square in the top to allow the console light to enter the top compartment. I also cut 2 holes in the back of the organizer to allow me to run my apple charger through any compartment that I wanted. I chose the small upper right corner for my ear pod charger. Check out the photos.The unit fits tight and snug like a glove. I really don't have any complaints about this unit although it would have been better if it already came with the modifications that I did. Overall I'll give it 5 stars and I would highly recommend it!

source_doc: Best deal ever !! I have been playing guitar since the early 1970's.  I ordered this guitar package  for my grand daughter for Christmas but it didn't get here in time so I gave her one of mine, she was very happy with that.  So when this came I carefully unpacked it with the idea that I was going to send it  back.  So I tuned it up and installed an old DeArmond pickup and plugged it in.  It blew my mind,  the sound was great and the action was super fast and easy to play.  I normally play my old 1972 Guild,  I can honestly say this guitar played as easy and sounded as good as the Guild (that was not easy for me to say)  and for this price which included a hard case tuner and strings , it is just an unbelievable deal.  If anything changes I will do an update,  for now I am very happy with this guitar and strongly recommend it.  I would like to know what strings came on the guitar, they appear to be very light but I do not know what brand they are.  (who ever set this guitar up knew what they were doing, the action was perfect)

source_doc: Gear for Motorcycle front sprocket. I used this sprocket JT1264.17 17-tooth to swap out the front sprocket gearing of my Lifan Xpect 200cc motorcycle.  There are videos on how to do it on youtube. It's a very well-made sprocket and heavy-duty. After removing the sprocket cover and loosening the back wheel and chain I was able to take the stock 15-tooth sprocket (JT1264.15) out and install this 17-tooth with little issue.  The sprocket cover needed a little wiggling to get back on over the larger sprocket, but it worked. The result: This was a test I conducted as my own gear ratio experiment. Please consult for advice, from a mechanic professional, the manual, and the service dealer before doing this experiment. What did I gain? I was able to extend lower gears out longer and gained a comfortable (less RPM) 5th-gear speed riding the paved highway.  What did I lose by doing this swap?  I lost lower gear torque to the rear wheel.  I don't want to lose lower-gear torque. I am going to ride the bike on dirt roads and ATV trails where I need lower-gear torque for many purposes.  I won't keep the 17-tooth front sprocket in the motorcycle.  The 17-tooth sprocket looks very well made.  No manufacturing imperfections.  If you have a purpose for this front sprocket this looks like a good one to buy.  I am a DIYer.  Please consult your dealer service department for professional advice.

source_doc: Made me break out, scent is a bit strong for me. This has a sticky texture and doesn't quite absorb into the skin, but rather, sits on top of it. As soon as that happened, I went to wash it off my body and then came to read the reviews, where I learned from another review that this is meant to be WASHED OFF after applying, though it isn't included in the package instructions. I must say that, after rinsing, I did feel a bit of relief from the pain I was experiencing and it did help me feel sleepy.I would use it again, but this needs clearer instructions.Also, about the pack@ging: Personally, I feel it's a bit wasteful to pack the plastic-wrapped bottle in a heavy b0x, use something to fill the empty space. And the note from the family is sweet, but I don't know them and it's printed on heavy cardstock. I'm not hanging it in my house anywhere, and I'd rather none of this was included, it just gave me more to discard (I recycled the b0x, its filling and the note). But even if I were giving this as a gift (which I wouldn't), it felt a bit overdone and wasteful.

source_doc: Absolutely Awesome! I needed to fine away that I can have my dehumidifier in my basement run consistently without me having to remember to empty the bucket. In the summertime, my dehumidifier will fill up a 70 pint bucket every day! Since I don't go down to the basement every day to empty the bucket, I wanted something that can empty the water itself. I noticed one of these pumps on my fathers central air unit in his basement. He told me that this pumps collects the condensation until it gets full. Once it's full, it just pumps it out a hose into the back yard. Unfortunately I don't have the ability to run a hose out to the back yard but I do have access to main sewar line in my basement. I mounted this to the side of the table that holds my dehumidifier and ran a hose from the water outlet tube to the inlet of the pump. I connected the hose from the pump to a threaded barb fitting I mounted on a 2" PVC cap that screws onto my main sewar line. This setup has been running for months and I has worked flawlessly!

source_doc: Brings sound down a notch and are super comfy. I work from home and have a couple of dogs a toddler and various other distractions around the house, usually when I want to tune them out I throw on some headphones but sometimes I just want quiet so I got these to help with that.  It came packaged well and I didn't see any defects in them.  In the box you get a case, two rings to put the ear tips on, and 6 different ear tips to use.  I chose the large double-flanged and got to it. Getting the stock tips off was fairly easy and putting the new ones on was too after that I stuck them in.  It isn't complete noise cancelation I can still hear most things fine but it's like the volume got turned down a bit which I love.  Also when Im wearing them I can barely feel them so I might actually try sleeping in them.  All in all, these are fantastic 5 starts not notes.

source_doc: I can't deny, I love these bare limbed lighted trees. I have one the same height as this one but it is all white lights. I am now using 10 drops because I realized I have an almost 2 gallon tank so I'm hoping next week when I clean them I'll see even less gook.

source_doc: perfect for daily powder supplements on vacation. These helped me bring 15 days' worth of powder supplements to make my morning smoothies while on vacation; I poured the powder from these directly into my wide-mouth "ShakeSphere" bottle and added drinking water to shake it up. My powders filled each container right to the brim (approximately 70cc I think, if I did my math correctly from all the various scoop sizes). I didn't like being forced to use the funnel top as the lid on the topmost container; I don't have a baby and I didn't need to use a funnel, so it was wasted space in my already tight luggage - I would have preferred a flat top lid. When closing be sure the pieces are securely tightened with each other, and strangely, when you use too much force, the pieces don't twist apart nicely; after I loosened my grip, then the pieces came apart smoothly. I used these for a 1 week trip to San Diego and now I'm packing them up for a 2-wk trip to Hawaii. I use these weekly at home too, because I love the time savings in the mornings of not needing to measure all the powders out each day (now I do that only once per week).

You can run a 10 min cycle that will purify all the water. I have not found a water filter that this company makes, but I have found others that I cut in half. They work great. I will never go back to a plain water dish because I love this water fountain asich as I am sure my cat does!!! If you love your animals like I do than buy this fountain. The first picture shows you all the parts that come with this fountain. The only thing you will need to start is a charging block, and eventually you will need to buy more filters.

source_doc: Handy multi-device car charger with useful voltmeter. I don't currently have any auto devices that need their own power port so the best thing about this charger for me currently is the voltmeter so I can always know the condition of my battery. I am hoping to get a dash cam soon though so perhaps that will need the extra power port. I like this charger a lot but it fits a bit too snugly in my van's power port, when putting it in and removing it I worry I could damage my van's power port. My first generation Toyota Sienna may have a slightly smaller power port than usual because I had that problem with another charger, I also read about another Toyota RAV4 owner with the same problem. If it weren't for the tight fit I would probably use this as my main charger so I could always know the condition of my battery. Another odd thing, but not a big issue is that since my port is low, when I insert the charger so that I read the port labels right side up, I am forced to see the fine print on what I consider the bottom of the charger, maybe that's a good thing in some situations. I like the soft touch on off switch.

source_doc: This gives me great breath, and I think whiter teeth. My girlfriend had this electric toothbrush and liked it, so I decided to buy it. I love it! Other than that, I love this, in fact, I’m going to buy the same toothbrush to give as a gift to my sister.

source_doc: Did not work with my cats. I have a 10 year old cat and just adopted a kitten. I was hoping the Relaxavet would help ease the transition while they got used to each other. If this calmed my cat down, then I don't want to know what she would have been like. After I unplugged them, I saw no change in her behavior.I've used Feliway in the past for different situations, but thought I would give a different product a try. I can't say if the Feliway would have been better, I did not switch. I just stopped using the Relaxavet when I felt it wasn't working.Fact is that she is slowly (very slowly) adjusting to the kitten's presence. I even noticed her playing with him the other day when she thought I wasn't looking. So I think the real solution here is time.

source_doc: Love the color and brightness, but they do not last. I purchased 2 boxes of these lights 2 years ago (march of 2021) to replace old can lighting in our basement and kitchen. Out of the 24 lights I installed probably 17 of them. I love the color of the light and how bright they are. HOWEVER.... I am giving these lights 1 start because over the last year one by one they have been dying and need to be replaced. I am at the point where I have had to use the 7 extras that I had to replace ones that died. Since using the last spare I had which was maybe 2 weeks ago,  I now am sitting in my basement with 2 dead lights and one dead one in my kitchen. Very disappointed how they did not last at all. Total waste of money as I am going to have to buy all new lights knowing that the ones I have left are going to die soon.

source_doc: Bright is a Under Statement. I have been wanting to switch over to LED's for awhile now, but I have held off because the colors of LED's were more pastel and didn't look good to me. So I can honestly say these do look great and remind me of my classic C9's. I still have over 20 strands of C9 Christmas Lights from the 70's that are still going strong with GE light blubs. More than half are still original and look great, but as you can guess my light bill for Nov. - Jan. shoots up a lot when using.So when I saw these lights I decided to try one box. When they came and I first tried out I was blown away how good they looked.  They look so good. I will be definitely getting more.  Well let me redo that last statement. If these hold up this season, and make it through the cold weather, rain, snow, ice. Then I will be getting more. I will update later if they don't, but for now all is good.

source_doc: 1mg time release lasts WAY too long, 13+ hrs after taking pill. I've done a lot of experimenting with different timing/dosage of melatonin, so I have a pretty good sense for how any given pill is affecting me. In theory, a 1mg time-release pill should be exactly what I need (more on this below). However, for me, this pill takes too long to kick in, and then induces drowsiness WAY too long. I don't feel much affect until 1-2 hours after taking it, and then it gets most intense right when I need to be waking up (about 8 hours in), and then it continues to make me sleepy for 4+ hours after that. I can definitely feel the affects lasting more than 12 hours.Before trying this tablet, I had been taking a regular melatonin pill divided into 0.5mg pieces twice per night---0.5mg before bed, and 0.5mg between sleep cycles (about 4 hours later). I had been doing this because I need help both falling asleep and staying asleep, and I only need a little melatonin to notice the affects. Taking 0.5mg twice worked well for me. I plan to use this the whole time baby can stay in a carrier. I love this better Tham the bjorn, which I had with my first son. This is so much more versatile and transforms as the baby grows.

source_doc: Well worth the price! I love everything about this slim eyeliner by Eco Soul! Since I have aged, eyeliner has become more difficult to apply. It is either too thick or too thin going across my eyelids as they seem to have become “bumpy” as I have gotten older. I also tend to have watery eyes for no apparent reason and my eyeliner will run. None of these prior problems with eyeliner has occurred with the new Eco Soul Super Slim Eyeliner.  The eyeliner applies very smoothly without tugging and I can have a very thin line, or bolder if I choose without any struggle. I love being able to just twist the tube just a little to get the point come out further when needed. I have not noticed any loss of my eyeliner when my eyes water as it stays put all day until I remove it at night. I especially appreciate the brown color of the eyeliner as it is more subtle than a harsh black. I am really enjoying using this new powerproof slim eyeliner and I would definitely recommend this to any age, but especially to older women who struggle with eyeliner.

source_doc: Excellent feed. I bought this for my green winged macaw because her other food went up $20 and I wanted something a little less expensive. Despite what some people said about their birds rejecting it I decided to try it anyways. It had a good pellet size, smelled good and had a nice crumble factor to it. My bird usually dives into her other food but only ate a little bit of it when I put it in her dish. Usually she eats all her food by 5 pm which is her second feeding time. There were pellets left over. I waited a few days for her to get used to it but she never did. I did not want her to go to many more days without eating so I broke down and despite the cost  bought her, her old food which is what I will keep her on from now on. I have nothing negative to say about this product except you have a 50/50 chance of your bird liking it. I didnt want this to go to waste so I gave it to my friend who owns a bunch of parrots.

source_doc: I use this for my dog's toys. My dog, Hank, is overly spoiled and has a ridiculous amount of toys. It may be important for someone who is using it more as a nice, decorative way to store blankets, etc. though. I also may have done something wrong when I tried to form it. Despite those tiny quirks I love the basket and am really happy I ordered it.

source_doc: Great for reptile enclosure!! I got this lock for a 4x2x2 Dubia reptile enclosure for my Uromastyx. source_doc: Fantastic beginners microphone. I purchase this microphone to make videos for my YouTube channel. The reason I went with the ATR is because it is a dynamic microphone. Apparently, this type of microphone is very good at isolating only your voice, and not picking up background noises. Since I am making these videos in a non-soundproofed room, it only made sense to get this microphone. There are newer, looking and cooler looking microphones if you’re a neophyte like me and it would’ve been easy to choose them however, I am very happy with the choice I made.I wish I purchased the boom package as well as I now recognize that the boom makes it so that there are no extraneous sounds making it into the recording. Tapping noises, if close enough to the microphone will unfortunately make it into the recording. So now, I am looking for a boom.Are use this microphone with my iPad Pro 2021 and also with an OWC thunderbolt hub. It works well. I did not choose to go down the XLR option but instead I am using the USB-C option. I highly recommend this microphone.I also purchased a wind blocking cover for the microphone head it seems to be helping.

source_doc: Versatile cat shelter. I helped a young feral cat all fall. I bought this shelter for him.  I was impressed with it's sturdiness, and how rain rolled right off.  I stuffed it with straw and he used it regularly.  Recently I found a barn home for him. I have 2 other feral shelters in the back yard so I wondered if I should leave this one out too.  I cleaned out the straw and put a soft rug in it. I put it back in one closet.  I was not sure if my inside cats would take to it, but they did. Now there's a race to see who gets it first. No need to hang a no vacancy sign on it.  One cat is always in it.

source_doc: Needed it to sleep outside. I’m not one to rough it in the outdoors.  And I don’t function well without sleep.  So, when I decided I’d like to try testing in preparation for camping again.  I knew I’d need something like this, and I was right.I picked about the coldest night to test this out.  I first laid out my bag and crawled my over six foot self in without this mattress.  I could feel every lump under my nearly 200 pound body.  I know that if I raked up the earth under me it would’ve been better but that’s not something I was prepared to do.So, I then unscrewed the valve cap to the mattress and it inflated very quickly.  I set my bag on top and got in it again.  It was quite a difference.  But, after 10 minutes or so, the mattress had settled some.  So got out and opened the  valve again.  It sucked in more air.  That held for the rest of the night.  And I needed this comfort to feel relaxed enough to sleep.It was easy enough to deflate, just open the valve and roll it up.  The strap works great to store it.For anybody who is thinking about camping in the woods after having not done it, I think you’ll want this.

source_doc: Not the Quality I Was Expecting. Typically I love JRPG's. The ones published by Square Enix have often become some of my favorite games so I was surprised to find myself having trouble getting into this one. First off, I felt the player movement was too slow and to me it seemed pretty laggy on my PS4. I didn't feel any sense of flow in the movement or the battles and found this to be one of the few non first person games to give me motion sickness which greatly influenced my negative opinion of the game. The battles weren't anything super complicated which usually I would enjoy as I like to just enjoy the story on my first playthrough of a game. Unfortunately there was keeping me hooked on the story so I didn't feel the need to continue forcing myself to play hoping at least that would be worth it in the end. I also found the world itself didn't feel worth exploring as I wasn't finding anything notable in the treasure chests or making interesting discoveries along the way so I will admit I have not finished the game. If it were to get updated at some point I would consider trying to play again, but as of right now I don't feel it's worth playing.

I did try Hello Bello diapers and they’re a definite no, they’re cute but way worse on the absorbency, her skin would be visibly wet when i’d change her diaper with those!

source_doc: Very easy install. I purchased this timer from a local store, just because I was afraid it wouldn't work and could take back. With that being said, this 62 year old female who is not an electrician had no trouble installing this switch. It helped that whoever did the original wiring had the box nice and neat. The only thing I had to figure out was which black wire was the load wire that you connect to the red on switch. Planned on using my tester, but it no longer worked. So I did the next thing I saw when googled. It was the wire that came in from top of box. Wasn't sure I was right, but figured if I was wrong all I had to do was change around. Turned power back on and it worked!!! The worse part was connecting the white to my whites, there were a lot wrapped up together, but I managed. Now for the operation of switch. The buttons are really tiny so not the easiest to push, but I use 40 minutes most of the time for after showering. Have it set so just push the big rocker switch and it starts on 40. You can easily override by pushing any other button. So didn't get 5 stars because of the button size, but I am otherwise very happy with this switch, better than leaving fan on all day cause forgot to shut off.

source_doc: Worth every penny. I was skeptical that this would work as well as people have said but we had a small grease fire and I decided to give it a try since entering else had cleaned the stove very well. I had read it is best to smear it on and let it sit for a few minutes before scrubbing so I smeared it all over the stove and under the lid making it really thick in the bad areas. Almost everything wiped clean and I only needed a little elbow grease in a couple spots. Even the spots I had to scrub didn't need much effort. As you can see in the pictures that the stove is spotless! Next came the metal drip pan under the burner that caught fire. Included is a before and after picture. I did two rounds of smearing it on, letting it sit for about 5 minutes and scrubbing. As you can see it cleaned most of the burn off! I am amazed. Im sure if I continued a couple more times it would have removed the remainder (but honestly this was good enough for me as im going to cover it with foil anyway). I am amazed and highly recommend this for the tough jobs! Oh also, I didn't notice a strong offensive scent and I was elbows deep in this stuff.

source_doc: Nice! Recommended. This product was not the brand I thought I ordered but it is the same style and string number and I like it very well. Looks like the above picture of Byla 27-string lyre harp with accessories. I could not tune the strings as noted above the tuning pegs because they got too tight toward the high end, but I added an F# after every F and that has worked out very nicely for me. I play hymns and have used the F# strings for several hymns that I would not otherwise be able to play. With the F#s added, it has been very easy to tune. It is a lovely instrument and has good sound. I used sharpie markers to color code my tuning pegs and strings. I tried several other lyre harps before this one, but this is the one I really like. Glad I bought it. Shipping took a bit longer, but the seller contacted me about that through Amazon and I was willing to wait for it.

I really liked them but I just wish they were similar to stock in depth so I could have used them.

source_doc: Was really hopeful but my hope burnt out. I bought these for my truck cargo lights as well as my door lights.  When I first put them in I was amazed at how bright they were.  It was amazing and I was excited.  Then about 2 weeks after having them in I noticed one of the cargo lights started blinking.  I thought it might be the wiring in the truck but then shortly after I noticed the other light started doing the same thing.  I had my little daughter push on the brake to see about the brake light and it seemed to still be okay.  So I took 2 of the bulbs out of the doors and put it back in the cargo lights.  It was about 2 days later that both of those started to struggle as well.  Then I noticed the one in the brake light started to flicker as well.  I was so hopeful for these bulbs and am quite saddened that they stopped working so quickly.  I would understand it if was 1 bulb then it could be a fluke but I now have 6 bulbs total that aren't working any longer or flickering really bad.  Thankfully they weren't too expensive so it didn't hurt too bad when I threw them away.

source_doc: Refreshing. Here I thought we have a really nice shower head until I came across this. How silly of me that I did not know a dual shower head/spray exists. It's not complicated to install, I actually thought I had to wait for the hubby to do it but I managed to do it myself. I love, love that it has 2 places where water comes out of so that I can shower more fully and quickly. Our current shower head has only 3 settings and with the highest pressure turned on, you don't get to cover lots of areas because the spray coverage is narrow. I love that I don't have to sacrifice the water pressure to get the most body parts washed. I also love that there are 9 different settings so even the pickiest person should be able to find the most suitable setting for their liking. Usually I'd have to take off the handheld to rinse properly but with the dual feature on this shower, I don't need to do any unnecessary work. I actually feel like I'm staying in some fancy hotel, it's really nice and refreshing.

source_doc: Great for Gross Garden Feet! I take baths instead of showers, and I just never cared for bath mats. But when I saw this one is machine washable and has the foot massage nubs and rectangular soft nubby foot-cleaning area, I decided to get it. I work out in the garden a lot, sometimes in clogs that get red-clay muddy (along with my feet!) and sometimes barefooted (even worse), and I can't believe how easy it is to just run a little water into the tub, sit on the side, and scrub/clean/massage my feet. I don't even have to take my clothes off. Easy to drain and rinse off with a sprayer, and then I can fill the tub with water and epsom salts for a nice soothing soak. I even enjoy the feel of the nubs on my butt! LOL! It remains to be seen if this will stain from red clay over time and not come clean, but I don't care about that. I'm the only one who has to look at it.Be sure to follow the directions for flattening it and sticking it down. I put mine on the bathroom floor with a bottle of vinegar on top of the most-curled end for a day or so before using. If you have a smooth floor, you could even use it as a floor mat in front of your toilet so you can massage your feet every time you have to go.

source_doc: Great bulbs! I had a lamp I wanted to use Alexa with and I have other older Kasa smart plugs that work fine.  My other bulbs were Lumiman and I was thinking I'd switch to all Kasa so I'd have just the one app on my phone.  So I ordered a Kasa smart bulb but it refused to connect.  I thought that maybe it was because the lamp was one of those metal swing-arm things, so I decided I'd just get another Kasa plug instead and ordered a used set of 2 minis.  They both refused to connect.  Thinking it was because they were used, I ordered 2 more new ones.  And guess what, they refused to connect, too.  I tried everything with all of them.  Multiple tries and resets, moving the lamp all over the house and even right next to the router.  None of them would connect.  I thought it was me.  I decided last resort to try a Lumiman bulb just to eliminate a Kasa hardware factor and maybe my WiFi was an issue and, lo and behold, it connected right away with absolutely no issues.  Plus, these have no color which I rarely use on any of my smart bulbs.  So win win.  Too bad it seems there are no Lumiman plugs.  I used the second bulb in a lamp where I was using a Kasa plug.  Anyone have any recommendations to replace my other Kasa plugs?
