source_doc: Great for a toddler. I needed a 2 pack so she can have 1 by toilet and 1 by the sink (she being my 3 year old toddler). For reference, I already own a similar stool by IKEA and it's basically the same stool. I do not have an IKEA locally so would have to pay to ship it, since I didn't have anything else I needed from them I chose to just buy this set on Amazon instead this time. It's exactly what I wanted and I liked that I could get white with gray instead of having to get the white with green, which is IKEA's only color option. If you did purhcase this set in the white with green it'd probably be just like the IKEA stools. I would never use this for an adult but I see in the reviews some people are. This is pretty flimsy and really is meant more for like a 20-40 pound toddler not for an adult or anyone over 90 lbs. That's pretty risky, imo.

source_doc: Well made, good value. This one I am keeping. I have purchased other guitars with semi hollow jazz style design. I have gotten rid of all of them, mostly because of feed back and tunning issues. I did spend a lot of time getting the action to my liking. At first I thought I would not be able to accomplish this but I got it. I was tempted to buy the classic vibe model because I already have one in 50's tele, which I really like. However, I really like the simplicity of design on the affinity model in spite of some of the bad reviews I have seen. Did not really find them on this guitar. The neck set up was a bit of a challenge but I got there. I also own an American made tele and strat. Nothing plays as easy or as well as those. This one poses a good competitor at a really substantially lower cost and it is really pretty, The pups are not the greatest but still really ok and I can refine the tone with my modeling style amp. I truly enjoy playing this guitar.

source_doc: at 73yrs old, I need to be picky! Just read other reviews and am surprised that some do not like this.  I try many brands of drugstore foundations but hardly ever Almays' which is ironic since I have sensitive, allergic skin!  By chance I tried this one (first I love that it comes in a tube rather than a bottle) (seems more hygenic), and then liked that it has the word "prebiotic" in the name.  I am somewhat on the light side, with cool undertones, pretty descent skin for my age with some wrinkles, no age spots, average pours.  Skin is normal but can tend to be dry if I don't work at it.  I bought the 130 beige because in the pictures it looked like a cooler tone than the 120 color and I am more than happy with this.  It looks natural and very healthy looking and I am picky.  I put it on with my fingers all over my face including my eyelids.  I just love how this looks even out in the bright sunlight.  I would be one to highly suggest mature women like me try this out if you are on the fence, looking for a natural foundation that is hypoallergenic with descent products in it.  I would totally rebuy this a second time.

source_doc: Love this grinder and the bag it comes with. I've been getting into whole bean coffee here recently and I wanted something that I could fine-tune better than an electric grinder so I got this.  It came packaged just fine and I didn't see any defects or dings on the grinder.  In the package, you get the grinder, a storage bag, and two cleaning brushes. It is basically 3 main pieces the handle which has a nice wood knob, the grinder which has all the guts, and the collection bin which catches your grounds.  I got a whole bean that I hadn't tried before and loaded it up and got to grinding.  It was really easy to grind although I set it for a bit too fine on my first go-round so unless you are old hat at manual grinding you will probably have to play around with it to find your preferred setting.  Cleaning it was a breeze too, it says not to get it wet so I took it most way apart (I left the grinder guts in) and took my electronic duster, and just blew it out. What I really like about this one compared to the others I have is it comes with a storage bag so I don't have to keep it in a big bulky box.  All in all, I do really like this and its matte black color looks great.

source_doc: Operation money Grab. I needed this cord so badly that money was not an option for me. I didnt even look at my bank account when I bought his cord so I said to myself why not, I needed a rope for mountain climbing and this was probably the most affordable. So I gave it to my wife, by the way is my X wife now, somewhere hiding at the bottoms of some valley but that's not important whats important is this review. We started off on a beautiful mid summers day camping and my wife had a climbing rope but it was her birthday so I surprised her with this state of the art $1000 dollar futuristic rope tested by Nasa. She was hooked! although we didnt have internet so she couldn't look up the information but she trusted me and it looked pretty legit. As we climbed up the mountain I told her to save the special Nasa Strength Rope for the highest peak because that's when we will need it and she agreed. I can not believe she did not hold on correctly so it was user error but the cord is still intact. I will not be returning the Technologically made cord just incase I may need it for my next date. Thank you so much in selling me this incredible gold digger saver.

source_doc: Do not use two days in a row when starting out. I have fairly sensitive skin, and was careful when reading the directions about applying daily. I tend to get milia under my eyes, my cheeks and chin so I was hoping this would keep it from developing. I used the first day and had no issues so I thought I was safe to use it again the second. Again, I was ok. Third day, I was working out and sweating quite a bit when I felt my face start to burn. It was annoying but nothing alarming. I immediately thought of the retinoid. I took a shower and washed my face. Afterward it was burning so so bad. Even applying my regular moisturizer stung. The next day I realized it had completely destroyed my t zone. The corners of my mouth, under my eyes and nose were so raw and peeling. Even applying light make up hurt so bad. It’s been three days and I am still trying to put as much moisturizer on my face as possible just to get it back to normal. I hate to completely bash a product that may be a god send to someone else. It’s just not for me and I highly advise not using it daily in the beginning even it feels fine.

source_doc: This comes in real handy even if you think it won't. These oil 'suckers' have been around for a while but I never thought I would use one. Let me tell you I was wrong. I wanted to do something simple as a test so I changed the oil in one of my mowers. I removed the dipstick and inserted the larger tube and pumped a few times (maybe 5-6) and the oil began flowing out.  I pumped a few more times and within 3-5 minutes I had removed all the oil from the crankcase. There was no mess. The spherical accumulator showed the exact amount I removed and I replaced that amount into my mower. Very easy deal.I will note that many new zero turn mowers are sold with 'lifetime' filled transaxles and I had been putting off purchasing one because of this. Now that I have this extractor pump I know I can change the fluid and prolong the life of the transmission. Fluid changes can be very cumbersome for a unit that was never meant to have the fluid changed but this extractor will make it easy.I wish there was storage for the tubes and the extra caps that come with the unit. Also, you need to be careful to keep the rubber isolator straight (unbent) between the tube and the tank or you may lose vacuum while pumping.Overall, this is a good deal on a very useful tool.

source_doc: Works well for me. I have bought quite a few Camilla  hair barrettes.  I like the rubber on the clasp and I like the way they look.  Nicely made and hold up well.  I think they're worth the extra cost as you get what you pay for.  I do not have a lot of hair, very fine, medium length.  This clip holds my hair in a ponytail and because it's wider than a hair tie, I think it might make it look like I have more hair.  I think it would be too small or people with thicker hair.  They have plenty of 4" clips that would be better for really thick hair in a ponytail.  Of all the Camilla barrettes I have, none have ever come out of my hair, even with my hair being so fine and thin.  I even have some of the bigger ones and they work fine for me, but this size is ideal for my type of hair in a ponytail.  I would really like to see some models wearing their hair accessories so I could get a better idea of what they look like.

source_doc: I wish I had known about Keychron before I bought my Ducky One 3 Daybreak. I bought my Ducky one 3 daybreak back in January of 2022 when I started to get really interested in keyboards. I wanted something with hot swappable switches and a variety of keycap options. After using that for about year the keys started to double type. I did everything from updating the firmware on the KB to replacing every individual switch after cleaning it out with compressed air. Unfortunately I concluded that it was a PCB (printed circuit board) issue, and none of it ever worked and so it's been sitting on my shelf since October.The Keychron Q6 is a breath of fresh air. I was hesitant to spend over $150 for a KB again after my previous experience but wow am I glad I did. Almost immediately you can feel the quality in this absolute unit of a KB. It is heavy, I cannot emphasis enough with how heavy this KB is. The sound is rich and comforting using their lubed reds. I thought I'd miss an illuminating RGB experience but I've gotten to the point to where this subtle south-facing RGB is perfect for my needs. The customization is endless using the VIA software that it recommends.I will absolutely 100% recommend this if you want something built on a proper platform with room to grow in whatever direction you so desire.

I would recommend it at this point as I have had no issues.

source_doc: Works great for me! As I have gotten older and I suppose less active, I seem to have more trouble going and staying asleep. This product not only helped me get to sleep faster, but I stayed asleep most of the night with the exception of having to get up to go to the bathroom as usual. I also suffer from restless leg syndrome and even that is better when I take this supplement. I believe that it is because of the addition of Tryptophan, passion flower and St john’s wort, among other herbs that has helped with the restless legs. The suggested usage is two capsules and since this bottle has 60 capsules this product will last 30 days if used every day. I think the price of this supplement might be a little high, but with the quality ingredients used in this product and how well it works, I think it’s worth it. I am very impressed with the results I am getting from this sleep aid, and I highly recommend it.

source_doc: It works best for my neck and shoulders. I ordered this bath cushion realizing that the reviews were polar extremes. My tub is pretty uncomfortable so I thought I would give it a shot anyway. I took into consideration the review that said suction cups were necessary, so I put those on first. They were not as difficult to insert as I had anticipated. You just have to use two hands and pull one of the honeycomb openings apart, then using the thumb and finger on one of your hands insert it into the opening. I had no trouble doing it, but my mother with arthritis could never manage it.I first tried this on my lower back and it was comfortable but a little bulky. I know that my issue taking a bath is a scrunched neck so I slid the pillow up on the tub to my upper shoulders and lower neck and that gave me the support that I wanted and needed. While it is still a little more bulky than I I would have preferred, it really helps my neck. I'm pleased and glad I chose it.

source_doc: Maybe mine is defective... When this bottle warmer arrived I was so excited to try it.  After unpacking I noticed that ours is missing the lid for the formula cup---we don't use formula so I thought that is not a big deal.  I cleaned all the pieces and charged it overnight for use the following day.  The next day, I took a bottle out of the fridge, found the correct adapter, screwed it on tightly, and set it to heat the bottle to 98 degrees Fahrenheit.  After about seven minutes, the milk was ready.  I turned the warmer so the bottle was upright with everything attached and it leaked milk all over my hand.  After removing the bottle from the warmer, I turned the warmer on its side which is supposed to stop the heating function, but I noticed that the little red light that indicates the device is heating came on.  For a bottle warmer that costs $79.99 USD, this should not leak, and the automatic turning off of the heating element should work as advertised, but the one I received did not.  It is possible that I simply received a dud, but for the price I am not impressed.

source_doc: Don't fall for the same bait and switch I did. I had decided that I was going to purchase the carpet One, non-Pro version. When I pulled up the page, I was looking at prices and the carpet One pro had a $100 off coupon available. This made the price $499 which was the same price as the non-Pro version at the time, so it seemed like a no-brainer to me. A couple of days after receiving it, I went back on Amazon to see what current prices were and I was  let down. The non-Pro version is now selling for $349. They had obviously raised the price to get people to switch just like I did, probably because they needed to unload some. I contacted them about being upset about being duped, and their solution was to offer me a free bottle of cleaning solution. I felt that was rather insulting. The carpet One pro is definitely not worth the extra money spent. The Wi-Fi function is pointless. While the LED screen is fancy, it doesn't do much more than what the non-Pro version does. I do feel like the sensor showing how dirty the area is, or the sensor showing how damp the area is, are both gimmicks. I have not noticed any consistency with either of those functions. I do feel like it is a good carpet cleaner, but definitely not for more than $349.

source_doc: Condominium life assurance. I live in a condo and one thing I learned FAST was that pug + beagle + separation anxiety = howling and barking all day.  I've tried the citronella collars, thunder shirts, and standard bark collars but keep on the lookout for something that's user friendly and effective.This was priced right where I look for and seemed to have a nice interface.  I don't use it often but when I do, I know whether or not it's working thanks to doggy cams.  I like that I can disable shock mode - usually the vibration are enough to correct the barking and even the beeping is a good warning that a vibration is next.  I also like that unlike other collars I know when I should charge it before it dies on me.  It's good looking and effective and has a bunch of little features like longer prongs and prong covers.It worked for my dog without hurting him so yes it's been a game changer for me.

source_doc: Not soft, smelt like burnt plastic, lots of fuzz after the first wash. Despite others reviews, my set came completely the opposite (in a bad way). I got the gray set, and was super excited to use some new, soft towels. That didn't happen.First off, after taking them from the box, removing the bag, they stunk. Like burnt plastic stink.. I HAD TO wash them, because no way was I about to use that on my clean body.Secondly, after washing (cold, light detergent, low spin), and I threw them in the dryer (low heat, light tumble, fabric sheet)... there was so much lint. I am not certain that is normal, but it shed worse than my husky in the middle of July. They aren't losing any stitching, tassels, but it must have been there - somewhere. I know the lint I saw in the catcher was from it because I clean it before each dryer use.Thirdly, they are thin. This might be a good thing in terms of drying times (after bath/shower and leaving on a rack).. but we're talking see-through thin.So overall I am not happy, and I would not recommend INK+IVY Nova 100% Cotton Terry Bath Towel Set. source_doc: Awesome AirPods Max stand. I LOVE my Airpod Max headphones! I already had what I had hoped was the perfect AirPods Max stand, purchase as a kickstarter and I waited for 9 month to get it... it was minimal and came with a mag charger set-up that automatically start charging when you set the AirPods into it... I LOVE it, and it has one fatal flaw: It does not sleep the AirPods. I am always having the AirPods pick up calls when I answer the phone. I spent twice what this cost for that and I had to stop using it for that reason.That said, I received this stand totally broken. Amazon seems to have sent me a returned item and once I contacted the seller they politely, quickly and efficiently sent a new one. The second stand is flawless and works perfectly. it is attractive and sleeps the AirPods immediately when set into it. The padding is perfect to not mar the beautiful finish on my AirPods. I do wish there was a more perfect charging solution, but I am very happy with this and recommend it wholeheartedly. It feels premium for premium headphones.

source_doc: I use this for my dog and cats. This camera is decent for what I wanted it for. I actually got it so I can monitor my cats and dog, while they hangout, or play, on my fenced in porch. The camera isn't rated to be outdoors, but I have an overhang that keeps the camera dry, and then I just move it inside at night. Since setup is super easy, it's easy for me to move it back and forth as needed.If my animals had it their way, I would be hanging out on the porch with them the entire time, which I don't mind doing, but unfortunately, I have chores to get done. So, this camera gives me the ability to go back into my house and do a little work while they hangout. I can monitor what they are doing, and if they are misbehaving, I can call their names through the two way talk, and it's clear enough that it actually will stop them in their tracks. The picture quality isn't fantastic, but like I said, it's a decent monitoring camera for what I intended it for.

source_doc: Nice!! This is my first experience with a pet water fountain. At first I was unsure where the cord went because it didn't really show it with part in the water. But I figured it out. It's very sleek and looks perfect where I have if. Luckily there was an outlet where the animals eat anyhow. It's quiet and the little fountain goes along keeping the water fresh. I haven't caught our cats drinking it but my dog really drank! I did have to find a spare bathroom rug and I put the cat food bowl, dog food, and the fountain on it. I found my dog dripped water more than usually drinking from this fountain. One more thing, I used half cold water from our fridge dispenser and half from the faucet. I was very surprised that, about 5 hours later, the water still seemed pretty chilled, which is nice. It isn't stainless steel or anything so I am not sure how it maintained its temp but I am glad.I looked at several water fountains and landed on this especially because it had a viewing area to see the level of the water. Again, I am very impressed with this little machine!

source_doc: Not safe. I wanted to love these, and I saved them for when I got a new car. When I put them in they were fine, until I did the test with the carseat and no matter what I did to tighten down the carseat, they still moved substantially with these protectors underneath them. I could move the carseat more than 2 inches side to side, and I grabbed my kids dad to see if he could tighten them more and it didn't change much. With that movement and my kids car seats, I won't be using these. There are also standards I didn't know about when I first ordered these... any accessory meant to go with or under a carseat (even harness strap covers) must be crash tested and approved. I could find no evidence that these had been crash tested and approved.

source_doc: Awesome 8 inch stainless steel fry pan. I have been looking for a well built 8 inch stainless steel fry pan. I did not want something heavy and it had to have a sturdy handle. I came across a company named Babish that has everything from pots & pans to knives & cooking utensils. I noticed they had a 8 inch tri-ply stainless steel frying pan. When reading all the information about the pan, I decided to give it a try. Upon receiving my pan I could not get over how light it was which I loved. The handle fit so well in my hand. I knew right then I had made the right choice. I also liked the fact it was dishwasher safe, but they recommended hand washing which was fine with me. I read the information that came with the pan on how to clean your pan before you use it for the first time. Upon cleaning the pan I decided to give it a try. I fixed one of the best veggie omelette I have ever made. The pan cooks so evenly-no hot spots. I let the pan cool before I washed it. Clean up was a breeze. I am so happy with my pan, I am planning on ordering more items. I would HIGHLY recommend this pan. It exceeded my expectations.

source_doc: So far, So good  a tip. I don't know about anyone else, but always hated those old mercury thermometers.And I knew if I was going to get a digital one, I wanted one you didn't have to touch skin.This one seems to give a good and LIGHTNING fast reading.Also comes with batteries, but I don't know how good they are, so will keep some to change out.And I also like you can read temp in a dark room!TIPS:  Let it get to room temp before using.  Mine had been in my cold mailbox awhile, but whether in cold or heat, just try to give it time to really adjust to room temp.  I was in no hurry, I waited an hour, but probably didn't need to wait that long.ALSO LOOK at example of WHERE to place it, not too close or too far from forehead and I place above the center of my eyebrows.BOTTOMLINE:  GLAD I got it.  In these times, one NEEDS a thermometer and I am pleased with this one.  Will UPDATE if anything changes.  Oh, and for older peeps, which I am one, our temps can be below 98.6.  NORMAL temps can range for different people, different ages.  I'm concerned more with how HIGH my goes.

source_doc: First Canister Vac - So Pleased. I have gone through three stick vacuums in the past 5 or 6 years. I have had Dyson, Bissel, and Shark. I have three pets - 2 dogs and a long hair cat. My entire house is ceramic tile. The stick vacuums would clog horribly with pet hair. I had to take them apart about every week to deep clean just to get a lackluster clean on the floors. This vacuum, whoa! I have vacuumed my entire house, furniture, door and window frames. The attachments are fantastic, and the vacuum is just stellar so far. One caveat for which I didn't deduct a star, if you have never used a cannister vac like myself just understand that it takes a minute to adjust how you vacuum. I felt like everything was awkward and too big the first two or three times I used it. Like I said, first canister vac. After that, I have had zero problems. And I really do love it.

source_doc: I like it. I’ve used myrrh essential oil in the past, when I made homemade natural skincare. But I’ve never before used it as something to ingest. I tried one of these capsules for the first time about a week ago. I’ve been in rather poor health, and I guess I hoped to discover a natural remedy. The first day I tried these, I took one and stayed attuned to my body to see if I felt different. After a bit, I did feel a subtle sense of relaxation and also some pain relief. A few hours later, I felt, ever so slightly, a sort of blood sugar type of jitteriness and irritation. I waited a day and tried it again, same way: one capsule. This time, I didn’t get any kind of jitteriness or irritation, as if I drank too much coffee. But I did feel mild, gentle pain relief….or, I should say, I felt as though “something” took the edge off of the pain I’ve been experiencing. Since then, I have been taking 1-2 capsules per day. Obviously, I feel that it may be helping me with my health issues or side effects. ..but I don’t know for sure if it’s these capsules of myrrh, psychological, or something else,…yet. I can say that I’ve been taking less aspirin and ibuprofen since using these myrrh capsules.

source_doc: Great Dry Bag! I like this bag because it has a clear window so I can kinda tell where things are at. I purchase towards the end of the season so I only have used it a few times I can not really comment on the durability. It appears to be constructed well  however there are seams throughout the bag its not 1 peace nor do I think it would be possible to make it that way. Like anything with seams its more apt to leak in wet conditions although the few time I had it out kayaking on the water and exposed it to water everything i packed in it stayed dry. I can fit a beach size towel some sweats and sweat shirt a t-shirt socks etc. my DSLR with a lens an additional lens snacks etc its pretty roomy and it all stayed dry rolling around in the bottom of the boat. I may have had a few drops of water on the top layer where it was folded twice and not 3 times but it was stuffed and I was experimenting how much i could actually carry with me. I say its a good quality for the price and would recommend to anyone looking for this size however I can not comment on durability as I've only used a few times at the end of the season.

source_doc: Absolutely brilliant device. I am an instant fan of this adorable egg cooker. I found out about it only a few days ago and I am so happy I got this.To start, my boyfriend suffers from a highly sensitive egg allergy, to the point where if he's in the kitchen while someone is frying eggs he will feel unwell from the fumes. As a result, I gave up cooking eggs for myself for over 5 years.This device is a blessing because I can finally eat eggs again without worrying about bothering my boyfriend. I might not ever make fried eggs again but being able to enjoy them boiled, poached, or as a tiny omelette is more than enough for me.The domed lid keeps the "fumes" contained pretty well until I have to open it, but since all the cooking is steam powered it's really not bad. This morning I attempted soft boiled eggs and as you can see I think they turned out wonderfully. My boyfriend didn't notice any discomfort in the kitchen either.So so happy this is in my life. It's very easy to clean and I love that you can set it and forget it, since it plays a little tune when it's ready.

source_doc: My cats love this bed! I just ordered 2 more! The bed arrived in great condition and was easy to fluff up. My cat immediately left her old bed and climbed into this one. I waited to write this review until I washed the bed, and I am glad I did. It came out great. I washed in in cold water and dried it on a medium heat. When I pulled it out of the drier it had fluffed up even more than when I first opened the bag on delivery. And you really can't beat the price. I just ordered one more in the 20 inch size so the cats don't have to share, and one in the 24 inch sized for my dogs - 2 chihuahuas that snuggle together. My larger chihuahua is a super chewer and is notorious for destroying beds, so I am always on the lookout for inexpensive beds. Hopefully this one will be so comfy that it will survive for a while ;). The photo is when she left her favorite older bed for this new one. Overall I am very pleased with this cat bed!

I also use it for the balcony pee pee pad right after they go. Literally zero foul smells. Also, the hand towels I use to soak everything up used to smell so gross in the wash as I was waiting to fill up the machine. Now that I use this instead of other cleaners, the wash smells nice and I don’t get grossed out walking by it lol. I have used it on carpet, different fabrics, my furniture, and toys. source_doc: Not Enjoying All the Possibilities. In 2020 I bought this preorder from the manufacturer (before they were shipping). It came with no user manual. I found a manual on their internet site, but I wasn't able to find much that was helpful to me. My initial problem was that the app did not work on my i-phone 6 operating system. I set the amp aside until I recently bought an i-phone 14. I recently (2023) downloaded the App. First message was that I needed to download a firmware update for the Spark40. That required a computer. I tried a computer with Windows 11. Then I tried one with Windows 10 Pro. Neither computer recognizes the amplifier. After contacting customer service (very nice response), I connected to a different USB port on the Windows 11 computer and the update worked. This amp is supposed to do wonderful things, and many are happy with it. In my small amount of time using it, I found adjustments on the App difficult to make because of the small phone screen size. Maybe an i-pad would be easier, but that would cost a lot to gain that capability. I'm impressed by all the Spark40 is supposed to do, but not very pleased with the learning curve and the amount of supporting equipment needed (App capable phone or tablet, and a computer for updates of firmware). Make sure you have a phone with an operating system that can run the App.

source_doc: Not really that bright. I got these for my 2002 F350 SuperDuty.  I installed them and was excited as I was replacing my old incandescent bulbs that seemed very dim and yellow.  I read the description and was looking forward to the bright new fog lamps.  I put them in and waited for nighttime to come.  As I was driving I turned them on waiting for the great reveal and I didn't even know they were on.  I actually at first thought that they didn't come on at all.  I actually waited to pull behind a car where I could see the reflection and saw they were indeed on.  Unfortunately it really doesn't make a different.  I'll leave them in for now though they really seem more like driving lights than fog lights to help see the road.  I won't buy these again.

source_doc: Bring the water bottle! Due to a surgery I had, I'm extremely prone to dehydration, so I carry a water bottle with me everywhere I go. My favorite is my Owala Free Sip 32oz. I drive a 2020 Toyota Highlander, and the bottle doesn't fit in the cup holders. So, I've been driving with my bottle between my legs, which makes things awkward and less safe. When I found this cup holder, I was excited about finally having a solution for the car. Tip...be sure to check the size of your cup holder before ordering to be sure you get the right size. I got the large one, and it adjusted perfectly in my console without having to offset. It is big and makes the cup holder the focus of the center console. My husband hates it and told me I just need to use a smaller cup. But when you have to drink as often as I do, that's not a good option. I love this thing, and I love that it's made it safer for me to take care of myself while driving. It's easy to insert and doesn't scratch the existing cup holder or console. Great for me!

source_doc: American AF. I have a really extensive, high quality knife collection and this particular knife I believe would be the one knife I would take if I could only have one. I have knives that cost much more, made of "better steel", superior finish etc, but this is the one. On mine I used a manual mill and a 3/8 endmill (better than filing imo) to take off just enough to give it a sharp 90 deg spine. Not necessary but that's what I did and that is the only mod that I wanted to do. May get a leather dangler sheath for when I want it like on my rat7, but I love this sheath. It's kinda tacticool, but rides high for my liking. SOLID locking in the sheath though. Surprisingly easy to unsheath with a little thumb push. This thing just works well, feels intuitive and doesn't leave you wanting. It's high enough quality that it always looks the part if ya know what I mean. A no brainier. As a (I hate "as a" comments) American, I believe we should be issued on of these at birth.

source_doc: Surprised. I've often worried about my Shady being warm enough, especially this winter where it's been so cold. He mainly sleeps with me but he still feels cool to me. So when I came across this product, I put it in my wanted list. I felt it was a little expensive. And I have bought blankets and beds and he ignors them all. So am I going to spend this much money for him not to use it?As the cold days keep coming and not letting up, the more I was concerned about him not being warm. The last thing I wanted was for him to get sick. So I purchased the mat. I no more unboxed it and tossed it to the area on the bed he likes to sleep when not on me. He jumped on the bed and walked over sniffed it and laid down! I was shocked, I didn't have to put catnip on it to get him on it! As I write this he is laying there on the mat sleeping!I couldn't be more impressed.Thank you for easing my mind. I know he will be warm now.

source_doc: This product is the best thing I’ve ever purchased! Peace of mind knowing my baby is monitored!! I recommend this product or any and everyone who has a baby!!! This thing is super accurate and I read all the instructions to know that you can’t put the bed under vents or ceiling fans because it can cause false alarms etc but if we forget to turn it off when getting him out of the crib this thing will go off and I LOVE how loud it is!!!! I sleep great knowing my baby is still breathing when I wake up. I give this 10 stars ⭐️ if I could!! The owlet monitor is a huge waste of money!!! Their false advertising should get their product removed in my opinion but this thing, this is the best thing I’ve ever purchased and I highly recommend it to others!! Our baby was in the nicu for 4 weeks and I was terrified to bring him home because i was confused about this monitor at first but when the owlet monitor didn’t work I was upset and decided to try this out anyways and I’m so thankful I did!!! I can’t say how much battery life it has because it’s only been 4 weeks but I will say I’ll update if I remember in 6 months!!! This one is so easy to install as well 🥰

I recommend if you are thinking about purchasing a shock collar don't pick a cheap one, because they will only last 6 months dispending on brand.

I recommend a 5.5 pH balanced cleansing bar such as the one by 100 senses  or cleanser perhaps from JLo’s line about which I can’t say much I love you, because I haven’t used her cleansers! Regardless, hyper sensitive skin that is sensitized will always sting until rebalanced no matter what you use on it.Regardless, I have been using this mask consistently  since October 2022  and it’s now March 2023 and I will say consistency is truly key and will pay off! Unlike what the instructions on the mask say I rinse the serum off after doing a facial massage and apply my own serum, but I there’s an option to leave it on all night!  If you have a normal skin that is aging a highly recommend this mask, it truly is a game changer!

source_doc: Honestly, I love this bag. I got this bag specifically for one day of a three day music festival I went to out of town. I flew in the morning of, attended the show, stayed in a hotel, flew home. I had to take everything I needed to the show with me because I wouldn’t be able to check in before the show. Granted I packed light, but this bag held everything I needed for a day in the sun and an overnight.Ive since taken the bag on a handful of travels where we’d venture out all day without returning to the hotel and it was perfect. Everything I need for the day AND room for some crap I’d buy along the way, one time it was three books and a T-shirt! It was stuffed, but it held it all.I’ve been looking for something a little better quality because I’ve grown to love this style and I can’t find anything that I like as much as this bag. I’m not having issues, but there are a lot little strings from unraveling fabric that’ll eventually cause problems.I carry it almost every day now. It’s gonna wear out, but I figure I’ll carry it gladly until it does.I took the patches off and put a couple of my own on, looks much better now.All in all, great bag. Probably 8L or so. Plenty big and decently constructed with lots of pockets.

source_doc: Very lovely fragrance- Jamilla. I am a bit of a tomboy but I love my perfumes and I love getting compliments on my perfumes. I have a ton but I will be wearing this a lot. It is a floral sweet smell  with just a touch of sensual news to it. The floral is not over powering or, believe me, I wouldn’t like it. The gentle blend of citrus and sweet is just perfect. I couldn’t stop putting my wrist to my nose,,,It literally made me feel comforted, to smell this fragrance. My husband wanted me to put some on his pillow, so he could smell it as he went to sleep. It’s not watery, like standard perfumes, it is an oil so it will last a long time. It has a dropper applicator. The bottle is beautiful,,,you’ll feel elegant, just opening this.  I’m going to transfer some of it into a small roller bottle to travel with. I put it on this morning, as soon as I got it, and it’s 12 hours later and I can still smell it. Not crazy strong,,,just enough to make me smile.  Read the notes of the perfumes, from this creator, to find one that suits you, and I’m sure you will, I know I will most certainly be purchasing more. Thank you for such a heavenly fragrance.

source_doc: Well-made, sturdy, elegant case. Just received this yesterday. The first impression is, as the title says, that it is a well-made, sturdy and elegant case. I read reviews that said the handle was uncomfortable. I don’t think it is. also read reviews that the straps were uncomfortable, that if you just hold by one strap the bass Flips upside down. That’s not true. The shoulder straps are fine. I wonder if people know how to adjust them? I opened them up all the way. That works for me.To put the bass in the case, you really do have to open it up almost all the way. And the extra pads at the bottom or a little bit in the way sort of. I didn’t want to remove them because I like the extra padding there. I don’t want to take the strap off my bass when I put it in the case, but that would probably make things a lot easier.  Anyway, it fits in there the case itself as I mentioned is very good looking in an understated sort of way  - you could show up at symphony hall with this thing and fit right in. It feels very sturdy and solid and stiff. The best of both worlds between a case and a gig bag. In my opinion I bought it because I fly sometimes in like to gate check the bass. this I think is as good as it gets for that option.

source_doc: Had a horrific allergic reaction - swollen eyes, teary… Is this even FDA approved?? I had a terrible allergic reaction to this product - and I even wore gloves the whole time I was handling it! My eyes were so swollen I debated going to the ER but I decided to take some Benadryl and wait it out (after I tossed the cleaning gel in the trash!) I was feeling better the next morning, thankfully, but the ordeal made me realize that I have no idea what is in this stuff or if any of it is toxic. It reminded me of the slime my daughter used to make in elementary school (if not identical.) Some of those recipes use Borax, which is indeed toxic, so perhaps that is what I reacted to… It did a great job cleaning some used camera gear I was prepping to trade in though, I have to say… Next time though, I will look up a recipe for nontoxic slime instead.

source_doc: My GPRO TKL Replacement. I hate to admit this but I'm a Logitech fan, and all of my peripherals, until now, are Logitech hence why I have a GPRO TKL and a G604... Both of which have problems after 2 years.. Anyways, goodbye Logitech, and here I come Keychron. I originally bought the K3 v2 since I wanted a little bit more space on my desk and improve the ergonomics. Summary is it didn't work out. I kept hitting the LED and Page Up keys so I got these instead. For the price, this keyboard has A LOT to offer especially since I outgrew the RGB trend. I also don't care for the software or custom macros. For the past 2+ years I've owned my GPRO and G604, I never touched custom macros and key binds.As a Logitech fan, it hurts me to say that the quality of this keyboard is probably better than their G lineup. Only time will tell if this will hold true for me, but it probably doesn't matter because I can just replace the switch and keycaps when this dies, unlike the GPRO TKL (you can desolder it...).

source_doc: Sounds Great in the Mix. First, please know that I'm not a great drummer- basic beats, keep it simple, minimal kit, that sort of thing. But I've been singing, guitaring, and songwriting in bands for 25 years, and I'm also a studio engineer, so I know what I like when it comes to how cymbals sound. I recently bought this Wuhan Crash Ride to round out my own small kit for jamming with my buddies, and I didn't really think it was going to be anything special for the money... to me it seemed like buying a Squire rather than a Fender. I do have to say, though, after hearing this thing in a pretty decent live recording of a show we played the other night, I really dig it. It sits in the mix just right, lots of dark wash but not so much sustain that it takes over past where it should fade out. I have a more traditional ride (Zildjian vintage blah blah) that I like, so the Wuhan functions as a crash... but I do find myself riding it a bit, especially on louder songs where I want it to really cut. I love it when the affordable option turns out to be really fun and sounds great.

source_doc: Make the clay bar process much easier. So when I picked up my car from an overnight stay at the service center, I was beyond livid.  Some ‘genus’ left my pristine black car parked by their sprinklers and it left horrible water spots.  After the tried to wash them off with no success, I took it home expecting a long tedious day of detailing to try to get my paint back to normal.  While I know that using a clay bar does not usually remove water spots, I decided to try these clay mitts anyway because nothing else was really working.  I made sure to keep the area of the paint and the clay mitt well lubricated with the aerocosmetics wash/wax spray I use.  I used no pressure because Tesla black paint scratches extremely easily.  After two times, the spots were almost gone - even the deep ones.  I then used a polish to make sure I had not swirl marks and now my car looks even better than it did before.  The process took a fraction of the time I expected to spend.  The quality of the Ragnify Clay Mitts are really good and saved my paint.

source_doc: Absolutely Beautiful!! As an avid, long time bass fisherman, I am quite used to paying, what my wife considers to be, big money for a good reel.  I use only bait casters for my bass fishing and relegate spin casters for light stuff like crappie and brim.I really didn't expect too much considering the price of the reel.When I took it out of the box and unwrapped it, my chin dropped to my chest.  This reel is beautiful.Once I got past my initial surprise, I started to inspect it closely for the features that I would pay big bucks for.  I found all the features of my more expensive reels and more.  I would normally change out the crank handles for the ones with soft, grippable rubber handles.  This reel already had those.  I got the owners manual and read it from cover to cover and found it to be the most comprehensive and instructive manual I have ever seen.  It explained every single thing about the reel in very understandable English.I have yet to fish this reel, but if it works as good as it looks, I won't be dissatisfied in the least.I highly recommend this reel to serious fishermen everywhere.  I am considering buying another for my flipping rod.

source_doc: Excellent nest holder but no instructions; Khaki color looks like a pasta nest. First of all this Khaki colored nest looks like some sort of edible pasta that has to be cooked. It comes with absolutely no instructions either when received or online. I almost was going to throw this out. However, after manhandling it for a few minutes, I had to strongly pull it apart. Once I opened it like an accordion, I understood how to use this.I have short to medium fine curly hair and I was able to roll my hair up in a  bun and then close this over the bun while holding my hair with the other hand. This then formed a nest. I tried unsuccessfully to take photos of it in my hair, so I only got a photo of one side. However, it holds exceptionally well because it is very strong.If using this with a ponytail, I recommend holding the ponytail with an elastic first and then pulling it through and clamping this over the hair. This is both unique and a wonderful hair implement. I do not love the khaki color, but I love the design. It also appears to be well-made. I would have rated this 5 stars had it come with instructions.The current price of $4.99 appears to be competitively priced for such a unique design and strong holding hair nest.

source_doc: Auto headrest tablet and hat holder that works OK with an additional installation step. I had a bit of trouble installing this. Rotating the knob behind the tablet holder is not as easy as they make it sound in the instructions. I couldn't get it tight enough to keep my 11" iPad Pro from drooping, so I thought I had it cross threaded. Through my efforts to tighten it by hand, I broke the knob. I glued and tried again the next day, but this time I used a pipe wrench to grip the knob while hand turning the tablet holder, which worked well enough so that now the tablet does not droop so easily. It's probably best for use with cellphones or lighter tablets.I love the hat holder feature. I keep large brim hats in the van to protect against the sun when going out for walks. Before I installed this holder, I was constantly moving the hats around in the van because I didn't have a good permanent place for them. As seen in the photo, I have two hats in the hat holder, the one in the back is hanging by it's chin strap.I wish I could use the nicely collapsible tray AND the hat holder but one is forced to choose between them.Now that it's installed and working, I'm happy to have this auto tablet and hat holder.

Considering how worried I am at this point... I don't think I would.  I just hope maybe I am wrong, but I don't think so.

source_doc: This product has changed my life. I care for my elderly father who is confined to a wheelchair but can get himself on the toilet. He is constantly bumping his feet and his toes are always bleeding. As a result when he goes to the bathroom there's always blood on the floor. I take a diuretic and when I have to go, I have to go. I use these pads to stick to the floor in front of the toilet so that if I go in the bathroom and he has been in there bleeding, all I have to do is rip the mat up off the floor, and I can go to the bathroom without stepping in the blood. This product has changed my life and probably saved my kidneys. I will be subscribing to regular deliveries of this product. There are probably so many other uses for these wonderful pads. If I could give 10 Stars I would. Also the price is reasonable for such a quality product.

source_doc: Not gold and not absorbant. These are really soft and fluffy microfiber towels!  I've never seen microfiber towels like these.  I got them because I have a new color theme in my bathroom that includes a bright egg yolk yellow.  I was trying to liven it up from the grey, beige, black and white in there.  I bought a new rug, new bath towels and a couple pictures to hang on the wall.  I wanted these to wipe off the faucet handle and tub spout after I take showers.  We have a new home and I want to keep it looking new as long as possible. These microfiber towels are labeled as gold and look more yellow in the description than what I recieved.  Mine are bright orange, not gold at all.  But what I don't understand is why they are considered absorbant...?  They smear around the water on the faucet.  I thought maybe I didn't get all the stuff out they use when they are manufactured so I hand washed them again in fragrance free detergent, and baking soda.  Tried again and they still don't wipe off water like my old cotton towels.  I tried them several times.  I think they might be good at dusting.  They probably pick up dust well.  They probably also work great at washing things, but I specifically ordered them for their color and their absorbancy and neither work for that purpose.  I will find another use for them, but I am disappointed.

source_doc: Maybe I don't love these, but I really really like them. I take that back - maybe I actually do love these. I have about 300 miles now with these and have yet to find a deal-breaker with them.  I hike all types of terrain and haven't had any problems with them.  I never used poles before, but after tripping and falling last year when hiking some really difficult terrain, I thought it prudent to try something for added stability.  These Foxelli's have been great for me.  They remain locked in position for me and I haven't had problems with them sliding out of position, even in very cold and changing temperatures.  I can see how one might break them if they aren't paying attention - especially if using on really rocky trails where the tip can get caught between rocks and jam.  But that’s not the pole’s fault - it’s “operator error".  What I really like is the lower handhold which is sooo useful when going uphill in changing terrain.

source_doc: Comfortable but not slippery, cute steering wheel cover. This is my first time having a steering wheel cover. I have a 1st Generation Toyota Sienna. I measured my steering wheel and it was close to 15", so I figured this would work. It was a bit of a struggle getting it on but not too bad, I didn't need any help or tools. I do wish I would have given more thought to where the seam on the cover would be, because I didn't and it ended up being on the right toward the bottom which isn't as bad as if it were closer to the top, but I think I would prefer if it were in the middle at the bottom as a clear point of reference. It's a pretty thick seam. I don't want to have to remove the cover and put it back on though, it was a tight fit. I chose this Bohemian design because I think it goes pretty well with my old and ugly brown interior. The cover does make the steering wheel quite thick, which, I guess, is easier to hold onto. The fabric has a tooth to keep my hands from slipping, but it still feels pleasant to the touch. I'm picky about how fabrics feel on my skin, and this feels pretty good.

source_doc: Hard to open—at first… I do a lot of traveling—and I mean a lot. I ordered this eight compartment pill organizer box in hopes that it would be helpful on my travels. I was really disappointed however, to find out that the individual compartments were nearly impossible to open. I struggled with them for several minutes, even breaking a nail before I decided to head to the reviews. Thanks to the angel who mentioned removing the silicone band, I was finally able to get the compartments open. Once they’re open and shut a few times they open much easier. Phew! I wish the compartments were a little larger because they really don’t hold that many pills and I need plenty of room for my overseas travel days. I still think I’ll use this, but probably when I’m traveling not as far.

source_doc: Reminds me of my other more expensive name brand sound machine. Worth it! I love the sound options. I always wish I could get it a little louder for covering noises in the house. But all in all I love the sound machine aspect. I like the ready to wake clock. My kids respond well to it. I like that there is a clock display for my. If kids who can tell time. The nightlight options are great. I LOVE that you can adjust the brightness!  love that it had battery back up so I don’t have to reset it every time I unplug it to move it. That’s such a pain. I wish it had a battery power option for when a storm knock out the power but it’s not a deal breaker. Overall it reminds me of my expensive Hatch sound machine that I like as well.Edited to add: I LOVE that it is a Bluetooth speaker! I can play audiobooks for my kids through it and they love those!!

source_doc: My hair drank this up. I don't use a whole lot of product in my hair but every so often I think it's good to get shampoo like this just to strip out any gunk that has got deep into my hair.  This came packaged just fine with no leaks though keep in mind I did not receive a pump lid like in the picture.  I hopped into the shower and lathered this up in my hair.  I was surprised at how much I had to use as my hair just drank this stuff up like it wasn't even there,  which tells me that my hair definitely needed a product like this.  It rinsed out just fine and I noticed after drying my hair that it felt super clean.  All in all, I really do like this product, maybe not be an everyday type of thing but I will use it at least every week, I do wish it had come with a pump handle but I was able to manage.

source_doc: Not a clear wipe. I guess I am old, but I remember replacing wiper blades quickly and easily. I have a 2014 Pathfinder and somehow the driver wiper (26") cracked. Still worked fine, but I noticed a slight scratch in the glass. I had a 17" replacement for the passenger side a few weeks ago. I thought I bought the same. Duh. That one is great(Rain-X 5079283-2 Latitude 2-IN-1 Water Repellency Wiper Blade, 17") put on by mech at last oil change. This one hat two other adapters, and I finally removed the one on it as I had the old hook style. Slid on easily, but the cover at the end would not snap shut. I redid it three times. Anywho. at the center of the blade under the connection there is water that is not cleared, and when it hits the water on the right ( next to the rear view mirror) pushed by the passenger blade it hardly wipes it. I am about ready to reorder another like the 17" and keep this for emergencies.

source_doc: Dressing up the stairway. I had been looking for ideas to dress up the risers on the stairs going to my second floor and was thinking stencils, or different paint, when I came across YouTube videos where diy shows were using this type of dress up for that project.  I had been looking around for awhile for some pattern I liked and came across this one.  It's neutral colors of beige/taupe and blue/grey that should blend in well.  It has a variety of patterns so each stair riser would be different and I like that idea and the look.  Haven't started that project yet as I have to prep the area.  It takes me awhile but I will get to it and I am excited to see how it turns out.  I will post an update when I get to that point.  The strips are a little over 7 inches wide and about 40 inches long.  There are 15 pieces, each a different pattern, all in the same muted shades.  Each piece has backing to protect the sticky side.  Feels pretty sticky so should adhere well.  I believe well worth the $$ if I can get this project done with my time and $40!  We shall see.

source_doc: VERY STRONG FRAGRANCE!!!! Smell is extraordinarily fragranced. I left this box on my bathroom counter for a half day while I did other things. Returning to my bathroom area, I could smell it out in the hallway. I ended up double bagging it in ziplocks.I don’t like scents and I can have allergic reactions but usually shampoo smells are okay. So, I kept it. Finally tried it this morning. The black shampoo + the green conditioner. Worked okay but again, the smell was EXTREMELY STRONG. I felt my lips tingling in the shower so I was definitely having a reaction.Anyways, an hour later I got migraine. I get them very infrequently - maybe once a year or less. This one was only visual but the strongest visual one I’ve ever had. Kinda suspicious I got it right after using a new product. No one to know for sure.Long story short, everything was double bagged and put into the trash.I really, really would like to be doing better and using and discarding less plastic but not at the expense of my health.Definitely not a good product if you are sensitive to fragrances.

source_doc: You need this! Love this swaddle carrier! I had one similar to this one I got from Walmart a couple years ago (but I got rid of it thinking I wouldn’t have another kiddo) and I struggled to find one that you don’t have to wrap all yourself until I came across this one. I am so happy with this purchase and so is my daughter she is all smiles when she is walking around in her carrier. There is plenty of room for baby and mama I ordered a size large (I weigh 185) and it works fine, I could probably fit an XL but I didn’t know if it would be too loose on possibly making it not supportive for baby so I went with my gut and got a L. I will say I sometimes notice the support band that goes across baby’s belly rolls down it’s more annoying than anything it doesn’t mess with the support when it does that. Definitely a great buy for a solid price.

source_doc: Amazing red light handheld. I got this because around the winter I tend to get cold sores and I currently have one on the side of my lips and I want it gone.  It came packaged well and I didn't notice any defects on it.  In the package, you get the light, two batteries, a charger for the batteries, glasses, a microfiber cloth, and a case for it all.  I really like that this comes with removable batteries instead of being charged in the device as when one battery dies I can have the other ready to go. The light really is really bright and you can feel your skin heating up when you have it on. There are three different lights red, blue and red, and blue though I primarily use blue and red. I used this on my cold sore and I guess it has made it speed up healing kinda hard to tell without going to the dr.  Out of all the handheld red light devices I have tried this one is definitely the best I've tried.

source_doc: Excellent product. I purchased this product in hopes it would help with scratch marks from my English Bulldog jumping on and off my large leather sectional couch. I had read all the reviews and decided to give it a try. I am so glad I did, I followed one of the reviews given by GingerInkc and did one section at a time using microfiber cloths to put the product on using circular motion. When dried I went over the area with a barely damp microfiber cloth...(I forgot to mention before starting this project I used my leather cleaner to clean the sectional). I finished with the leather conditioner provided in kit. I wish I had taken before pictures but l didnt. I can tell you my leather sectional looks brand new!!! I too had only used maybe a third of the of the coloring balm if that! A little amount goes s long way! Very pleased with this product!!By By scratches!

source_doc: Not very good quality. I doubt this is truly a therapeutic grade oil. I wasn’t expecting the best oil, at the price…but I was disappointed. It had an unusually greasy feel to it for an essential oil, the smell is basic, and if the sting of clove oil is any indicator of its purity, this is not pure. I’ve put clove oil in my armpits a few times and regretted it. I actually put this one on to test it, and eventually I did feel a little heat. But I wasn’t sure I would at all. I do like the dropper feature though. I bought it to use under my finger nails while fighting a pinworm infection with a toddler, so I didn’t care if it smelled great, I just wanted something I could use frequently after diaper changes. Hmmm, perhaps latex gloves would have been a better choice.

source_doc: Best Wipes - From a Preschool Teacher! I’m very fortunate in that I teach a class of twelve toddlers who all require diaper changes throughout the day. I’m fortunate because while I was pregnant, I was able to test out ten different kinds of wipes! These were by far my favorite. Most wipes are too dry to really get anything clean. I felt like I was scrubbing some of the kids’ bottoms to get them clean, which obviously isn’t very comfortable. These wipes are a dream! Wet enough to get the job done, and thick enough that I have never felt like I was going to get anything on my fingers. (Granted, I wear gloves at the preschool. I mean with my new daughter!) My girl has never had diaper rash, and while she has eczema on her little face cheeks, her booty remains clear! I had 3 boxes of these wipes, and she is ten weeks old. I still have 3 packs from the second box, and I’m only opening the third to send some to daycare. They last a while! Just get them!

source_doc: Build Quality Could be Better. I purchased the ES110 based on exhaustive research and reading reviews. I also own an upright Kawai piano. What convinced me to purchase it was the key action and sound quality. I primarily wanted a piano and didn't need a lot of other features.When I set up the ES110 I noticed a fair amount of noise from some keys clacking when released (plastic on plastic). Most keys seemed adequately sound dampened but some were not. I contacted the vendor and Kawai support. The vendor told me to contact Kawai support as well. I never heard back from them.The clacking key noise was driving me crazy so I returned the ES110 and asked a few different music stores what they would recommend. I Purchased the Roland FP30X. I didn't purchase the Roland initially because a reviewer said the keys were a little too heavy and it might not be the best for high speed fingering used in classical music. I've also been very satisfied with my Kawai upright.The Roland keys feel much more solid with no clacking noise. The build quality on the Roland seems better than the ES110. Maybe the key feel is a little heavier but you can adjust the Key Touch to make it feel lighter.I really wanted to love the ES110 and was very disappointed. Maybe I got a lemon. The Roland FP30EX has been great so far.

Plus, my other watch monitors my blood pressure, which the fitbit does not, unless I enter it manually. All in all, I can say I tried it but I am not impressed. The seller, however was great. I had the watch in less than 2 days.

source_doc: Works perfectly for what I need. I just moved my toddlers into their own bedroom. While I do have a Ring Camera in there which sends motion alerts, I was needing something that would alert me of sound in real time. This monitor does just that.Set up was super easy. I literally just plugged them in and they paired instantly. It picks up every sound so I can even hear when they move. I like that the volume can be adjusted so I can lower it down while they’re settling to go to bed and turn it up when I myself am ready for sleep.I do not use the cordless feature as the parent monitor is plugged in to sit on my nightstand and the one in my kid’s room is also plugged in so I can’t comment on the battery life.The night light on the kid monitor is a really nice touch and I like that whenever there’s higher sound the parent monitor lights up orange to alert.When we have our next baby I will definitely be purchasing another one of these. They are really simple but work perfectly for what I need. I wish I bought them when my little ones were in the baby phase to help when we put them in another room for naps.

source_doc: This battery delivers its rated capacity of 100Ah. I have a Bluetti AC200P connected to a 6 circuit manual transfer panel and this works well.  I was looking for some extra battery capacity and watched many reviews of the different brands of 100Ah LifePo4 batteries.  Power Queen was a highly rated battery and their price was equal to about all the others.  However, Power Queen was running a promotion where you would get a 12.8V 6Ah battery for free with each battery purchase so I took advantage of that.  I decided to go with 2 of the Power Queen 100Ah batteries.  I use the smaller battery in my electric start gas generator.  I was able to test their capacity to ensure that I was getting the advertised 100Ah from them and I am pleased to say that each one delivered about 101Ah.  I now have them wired together in series to get 24V and then attach them to the solar generator through an adapter.  This works well although the solar generator only charges at about 340W.  I can't speak for the life cycle of these batteries but with a 5 year warranty, I am not to concerned about that.  I did have the opportunity to ask a question via email to Power Queen and they responded within a day.  I think that they were a good value and would buy again.

source_doc: Very disappointed, and had to return. As someone with MCS - multiple chemical sensitivity- any fragrance can make me extremely ill. Someone can walk past me wearing perfume or fabric softener or lotion, and I can become so ill. I will have to be in bed for two or three days. People don’t realize how toxic things are, or are to others around them. Therefore I use products that are natural and clean and pure as far as fragrance goes and have always had good luck with Mrs. Myers products. So I purchased these bottles of hand soap. However, I had a reaction to this fragrance. This does not smell natural. It smells more chemical I used it for about three days in a row to be sure that it truly was this product. I was reacting to, and without a doubt, even after using it, and with the fragrance lingering in the air, I could not enter the room.  Therefore I will no longer use Mrs. Myers products as I cannot trust the source of their fragrance. I do not react to natural essential oils so if the source is truly a natural fragrance, I’m usually good, but not with anything that is chemical. This fragrance does not smell at all natural and smells more chemically derived. I absolutely cannot recommend this product .

I messaged the company again but this time I had a really hard time sending the information and the video clip.  Now the odor removal sensor keeps telling me there is no liquid even after I fill it. Well, I guess having this automated litter box for a year now has spoiled me so I need to buy a new one that works!  Any suggestions?

source_doc: I absolutely LOVE it. I love this thing.  Got it on a lightening deal and so glad I took the plunge. I love the little open shelf.  I put an extra hand towel and I will also add something decorative as soon as I find something that fits with my decor.  The only thing wrong was on my part.  I thought this was mission style doors, but they aren't.  My fault for not paying better attention.  I really don't care because I love it so much.  Oh, and I changed the knobs only because I wanted it to match the rest of the cabinets in the laundery room.  If not for that, I would have left the included knobs because they look really nice.  I would most definitely buy this again.

source_doc: Worst piece of fitness equipment I own. Not going to lie, I wanted something for the wife that was just easier than grabbing a bar and bench in limited basement space.  I have all types of equipment down there, and this was just going to supplement workout routines.  I had high hopes when I got this thing.  Then I started to try and out it together.  Let me tell you, the hardware us not marked, the instructions leave a lot to be desired, and holes do not line up (had to ream out two holes).  Sturdiness after being assembled is questionable, and the design is severely flawed.  There are two hooks that insert downward and attach with nuts on the back (floor side) of the platform.  We'll, these hooks protrude further than the feet of the platform and hit the ground more than the supposed platform feet.  Let me tell you, I was pretty upset when I discovered these hooks had dug themselves into my floor and sratched it all up!  I had to grind these protrusions down and tape them to ensure they wouldn't scratch anything.  I tried the system after I assembled and do not feel confident that it will last more than a month.  Everything is cheap!  I am super upset that this thing is like this, and feel cheated.  Honestly, this is the worst piece of equipment I now own!!!

source_doc: Great personal electrical guitar amp. First off, I knew that it was on the small side and I know how small audio amplifier circuits can be made because of my degrees, but I still was not expecting this amp to be this tiny.  If it was not for the battery pack adding on some size, I bet this amp could fit in my guitar case.  But I love how small this is, and yet how loud it can get if needed.  The only reason for 4 stars is I heard a hum on some of the strings as well as some of them are fuzzy, so I am not sure if this is the amp or guitar yet.  I did not hear this with no amp attached obviously.  I found out that electric guitars need to be setup and I don't think this guitar has been setup yet before being used as I was not told about it.  So once that is done, if the sound improves I will increase my rating, if not, well you know what happens then, but I will do my best to find the cause of the hum and fuzz that have been found now.

source_doc: Good lock for the price. I like this lock so far.  I attached the mount to my bike via the water bottle bolts, but I decided to move it to my bike bag instead.  The mount worked fine, I just missed having my bottle there.  This lock is pretty heavy, which is to be expected.  It is large enough for any bike rack and most poles I would use to lock up my bike.  It is too short for locking down your frame and front wheel to a thick pole.My only complaint is that the coating might end up scratching or wearing the paint on my bike.  This has not happened yet since I don't lock my bike up often, but I really wish there was some rubber on the parts that contact the bike.  I am considering adding some foam tape or something similar to limit the wear.All in all, this is a great folding lock for the money.  I like to budget about 20% of the bike's value for its lock so this falls well within that range for most of my bikes.  I will still use higher-security locks for any very expensive bikes, but that is just due to the higher risk involved.  This lock is far more secure than most cable locks I have seen and is much easier to carry than a U-lock, so this gets my recommendation.

source_doc: Great pants but order the right size. I really like these leather pants.  It’s hard to find leather pants in a store unless you go to a motorcycle store, but those pants are more about protection in case of a fall or crash.  The other place to find leather pants is at a kink store but those pants are very expensive.  I decided to order online, but when I read the reviews they all said to size down.  I followed their advice, and it was wrong!  I normally wear a size 36 in Levi’s, so I ordered down like everyone said and ordered a 34.  That pants was too small and too tight.  I then thought maybe I should order a size bigger so I ordered a 38, and that pants was too big.  Finally I ordered a 36, and it was perfect.  My advice is order your normal Levi size, and you should be good to go.  Just so you know I weigh 220 and I’m 6-1 who wears size 36 in pants.  Hope this helps someone out there.

The sleeves have built in fingerless gloves which I love because I always forget my gloves. The pockets are deep but they don't bulge when full. I can easily fit a 20oz waterbottle in the pocket and hardly notice it is there.Literally the only downside I've experienced is that I can't get to my smart watch because of the gloves, but I'm sure if I really wanted to I'd be able to.This coat made me feel cute for the first time in three years and I am so glad I got it.

source_doc: Perfect exercycle for me! I love this little stationary bike! And the price point is incredibly reasonable!! It's sleek, compact, cute, sturdy and tucks into a corner of my living room. It's SO quiet!! I can't believe it! I can listen to music, TV, read or watch Youtube while riding. My last recumbent bike made lots of noise, so I couldn't cycle if anyone else was around. I had to have my husband put it together for me because of the few electronic parts. I didn't want to mess it up. I suppose if I HAD to have done it myself, I'd have eventually gotten through it. It really wasn't that hard to do, my husband said. All the parts were clearly labeled, well packed (in spite of the box arriving opened and smashed). Nothing was broken or smashed. Instructions were clear. Seat is comfy. I LOVE IT!! I'd buy it again in a heart beat! :)

I decided to exchange the controller and get a new one. Now that I have the second controller, this one has stick drift in the left thumb stick. I've tried every troubleshoot with Xbox support, but now they recommend that I send it to them for repair. I am just going to return it and go with a different option. Also, I did not play with the controller to cause the stick drift. I noticed it fresh out of the box, so it was not dropped or damaged and it is not dirty from use. It's literally brand new. Extremely disappointed, I wanted to really like this controller.

Just know, if you are looking for compact, this is not for you.. But from what I can tell so far, it is nicely made and I have no complaints about its quality.

source_doc: Great for Price, Better after Tweaks. Loved the lamp. I am particularly fond of the design which is why I got it. As a student moving from dorm to dorm it folds nicely. Great Student lamp. It has two different strips of lights that cause the change in color. It is not the best light I have had but for the price it is pretty decent. Lumens I provides enough light for the tasks I perform at night which are normally just computer work, occasional solder, tiny tool usage and eating at my desk. I was really annoyed with where the switch was so I cut it off and reconnected close to the base of where the clamp is. I can now easily reach the on and off and lumen adjustment. I would have preferred the switch be closer to the head or arms of the lamp but I am happy with where it is now. I added a rubber pad to the clamp so I don't get charged for damages to the desk. I also had to un hinge a spring and tighten a few of the screws. The springs are unevenly strong that it pulls the light in funky ways and after removing a few and then tightening screws the lamp still adjusts and moves and stays where I want it. I have been pretty happy with it.

source_doc: Fantastic , portable amp. This is my second positive grid amp, I also own the the bigger 40 watt version. This one is much smaller, easier to carry and just as easy to use as its bigger brother. I love that it has a built in battery and charges via usb C. I haven’t charged it in almost a month and it still holds a charge. Given, I don’t play very often. I would say about 2 hours a week. So I imagine you’d be charging it more often if you play a lot. It only has a couple of built in presets, so you must have a tablet or smartphone to get the best use out of it, but that isn’t a huge deal for me. I like it. I like being able to search an almost infinite library of tones that people have shared. You can also play music and jam along with the app. I love it! I can even Connect my wah or flanger pedal to this without a hitch. I don’t regret buying this. It’s perfect for home jam sessions. If I had to pick between this and it’s bigger brother I’d go with this one, just because of the built in battery and usb C port.

source_doc: Best sleep ever!!! Okay, so I know this is an "Air Bed" (super-sized mattress) and not a standard or "real" bed but I've tried a bunch of "real" beds and have consistently had lower-back pain when I got up each morning. In desperation I thought I couldn't lose by buying and trying this Air Bed. Changed my life!!! EXTREMELY comfortable ALL NIGHT LONG! As you can see from the pics, I use it differently than most: (a) I found the fabric side with the channels to be less comfortable than the bottom so I inverted it with wonderful results; (b) by inverting the bed, the fabric catches on the carpet better than the smooth side so it doesn't shift when I get on or off of it; and (c) I didn't want to have to deal with fitting sheets so I just bought an inexpensive sleeping bad and it worked perfectly. I have the twin xl version and a double sleeping bag fits just right. I use this EVERY NIGHT and have been doing so for weeks. I do have to top off the air each night for about 10 or 15 seconds as there is a tiny leak. I couldn't find any air escaping so I'm assuming it's getting out through the built-in fan assembly. No biggee, though. I highly recommend this critter!!

source_doc: It's noisy but there's a cheap and easy fix. For the price it is a great elliptical. The resistance levels are good and I get a whole body workout on this thing. It's sturdy enough for the asking price, but the bolts on the main strut make an extremely irritating noise after a while due to the metal washer rubbing against the metal of the strut. I was pulling my hair out over this for a long time, because for a while I wasn't even sure exactly where the sound was coming from. Eventually I narrowed it down to the bolts holding together the two parts of the main support beam. I tried tightening them, lubricating them with WD-40, but nothing worked. I was about ready to throw the whole unit away until I had an epiphany one day. What if I put some rubber in between the metal washers and the strut? All I did was take a spare koozie I had lying around and cut 1-inch squares out of it. In the squares I cut a slit half way up the center and a 1/4" hole in the middle. I then loosened the bolts and slid the rubber koozie square between the washer and the main support and tightened the bolts again. Now the machine is silent! I couldn't be happier now.

source_doc: In LOVE!! I have the rucksack (small) Gootium to carry groceries in but I wanted something that was just for me.  Soon as I opened the package I was in love! I was afraid of the straps twisting or fraying but there has been no problems so far but I also, don't weigh my bag down with heavy things. I was on the fence about getting this bag until this color came out and I knew I had to have it. I'm so glad that I did because it is my favorite bag I've had (and that says a lot because I'm a "Bag Lady" hahahaha!)

source_doc: Soooo much easier than I thought. My slider was in such bad shape it took Rocky to open it. I didn’t want to pay megabucks for a repair man so I decided to try myself. I am a 56 yr woman but I am handy. I did need help getting the door on and off because it is heavy. You lift and pull out from the bottom. Now that’s the hardest part! With my particular door I only needed to take out 2 screws on each side and the rollers removed in a slot next to the screws. Replace the rollers and screws that’s it. One of the screws gives you the ability to raise and lower door. I wish I had done this a year ago. I can not tell you about how long this item will last but I can tell you I can open my door with 1 finger now. Hint.. when putting the door back on be sure the rollers are level with the door, not sticking out.The product itself seemed flimsy to me. Not as solid as I thought but it was I believe $20 and works great. Now If I need to replace it soon I won’t cry over my $20If your a newbee like me. Just do it.
