source_doc: Clear, not colored. As much as I love these little guys, I feel the description is misleading. The photo shows these are colored, and I honestly would probably not have ordered had I known they were not. I hate when this happens, as a simple adjustment to the title, would have solved any misunderstanding of whether they were colored or not. Or switching the opening photo. Still, they are very cute, thicker, yet small Mason jars. They are the same size, thickness, etc that I imagined they would be when ordering, just not the color. Overall, these would be great for little gifts, or just cute little guys to have for no other reason than they are just cute. I had the idea of filling with glitter in my craft room. Give them the color I thought they had. I have not yet decided what I will do with these yet,  but if it's a good one, I would order more for sure. The quality is there, and again, just cute cute cute. Many uses. The only reason I deducted a star was for the misunderstanding of what I thought I was getting (colored) versus what I got (clear). It in no way reflects quality. Quality and usefulness would definitely recieve a 5 star rating.

These bags were formed so much better material was better. The straps are even heavier duty I mean literally everything about them were better and I could literally buy five Saturdays versus the ones that I bought there . I can’t recommend is enough.

source_doc: Does not work... never did. Bought in 2020 didnt use it right away, just wanted to have it on hand when I needed it. When I finally needed it would not turn on... and it has never worked!Ive tried it on a 2006 pontiac G6, 2002 GMC Yukon, and a 2009 Jeep wrangler. It never turned on. I thought it was just me using it wrong. Then I lost it in some boxes. Found it three months ago and tried it in the jeep. It wouldnt turn on.03/11/23 I thought Id try it again in a 2002 GMC sierra... it didnt turn on. Tried it on a buddies s10 and it came on but wouldnt connect.Updated 03/19/23 I went back to the 2002 GMC sierra and started checking fuses. Found 2 blown fuses (cigarrete & DRL) and replaced. Reconnected scanner tool. It comes on but wont connect. Retried multiple times... same results. Next I guess is the drag test... where you use a paper clip to test each pin hole on the vehicles scanner port under the dash.After reading some other peoples reviews of this unit, I thought I should add my review to the list. No pins are broken, none are bent, and plug was pushed all the way in.If I could return it I would its really been no help so far, and a waste of money...

source_doc: Grainy texture, mild flavor. I wasn't impressed with how the safety seal came right off when I opened the lid. Was it secure? This is a packaging flaw I shouldn't have overlooked, but everything else seemed clean and intact, so I gave it a go.As for the gummies, which I did try (against my better judgment?) they have a mild taste that could be strawberry, but just seemed kind of generic, and have a very grainy texture that I do not enjoy. I wanted to try these in particular because this is a brand I thought I liked, but now I'm wondering if I misremembered.Overall I would not buy again, unless I was assured the packaging issue was fixed. If their manufacturing and packaging practices are truly cGMP as claimed, this seal issue should never have made it to the hands of buyers.

source_doc: Takes fabric pilling off sweaters, couches.... Well, I did it.  I read several of the reviews and took the plunge.  Usually I take a pair of old hair clippers and shave my sweaters but that has caused too many snags.  This little shaver DOES NOT create snags.  You charge this little bugger up and in no time you're digging through your closet and bringing out stuff you forgot you had and shaving everything down.  After that now I have sweaters ready to wear and a pile destined for a Lawn Sale.  What can I say... it's the cycle of clothing.  I like just about everything about this shaver.  It's small, rechargeable, fits in my hand well the only thing that I found a tad irritating is emptying out the collection of sweater lint/nubs.  It was really difficult at first and to pop it off I had to ask my husband hoping that he wouldn't break it.  He got it off and we emptied the bin and it was a hard snap back in.  It kinda scared me at the amount of force that had to be used.  It did NOT break (phew) and I've been using it practically weekly.  Overall - I would agree with the reviews and the amount of people who have purchased this item.  It really gets the job done. Enjoy and I hope you don't become a fanatic about keeping your sweaters pristine like I have. (slight nervous laugh).

source_doc: Worth it so far! I live in the Carolinas and have a lot of humidity here. I was 24 and pregnant with my only girl when my hair went from straight and unable to hold curl at all, to being super wavey, frizzy, and stubborn. Fast forward 20 years and I have tried I swear all the curly hair products with not much luck. I wash my hair twice a week. I have used this product 3 times since my purchase. Right out of the box this smell is AMAZING! After the wash my hair felt a bit dry, I did not use any product because I wanted to give a proper review, once dry my hair was soft, and manageable even without product. The poof was minimal, and the dry feeling decreased as it dried. I have used this with product twice, and the wave definition is unreal! I am very happy and satisfied with the product, and will continue to purchase it. I have since bought everyone in my home their own bars. Make sure to get the correct one for your hair type, but don't hesitate, this is awesome stuff!

It will stay cleaner and pretty, and I have no worries about general wear and tear and dirt in a bedroom. It looks really pretty.

source_doc: I thought I would use it more. This UV light for nails is very lightweight and as simple to use as any I've ever used. I got this for when I do my nails, so I could cure my nails all at once rather than one at a time, and it definitely works good for that when it's the finished nails. I have nerve damage in my right hand,  so I actually find that initial gluing of nail to finger works better for me if I just stick with the single nail at a time. So, unfortunately, this has only been used 1 time. I really thought I would use it more,but it's too hard for me to keep my hand straight long enough to put all nails on then under the light. I just bend them and they come off and it becomes a mess. But, having said that, it is a decent light for anyone who will not have issues like I have. Or great for even curing nail decor that needs UV light after the nails are already glue on. I wish I could have given a better review of this product, but from what I can tell, it does what it says, and works as good as it says. So I am going to give it a 5 star based off it being exactly as stated in the description.

source_doc: My feet don't hurt this morning. I expected these inserts to have an effect while I was wearing them - and they did. I was surprised about the impact the next day. Of maybe I just didn't notice because I live with a teen athlete and anything other than cleat feet doesn't register.I found the template a little annoying. Not enough to knock off a full star, but maybe an eighth of a star. Neither of the shoes I use these in has removable linings. I tried the template on the outside of the shoe, as it suggests, and, to no surprise, it said I needed the full-length insert, which didn't fit in my shoe. I got it right after three rounds of trial and error, but perhaps marking with template with shoes sizes (men's on one, women's on the other) would eliminate a few steps.

source_doc: Probably my favorite mouse of all time. I had a G502 Hero wired mouse before this one. The way I had my cables routed I was constantly dealing with drag issues. I would leave the mouse still and watch the cursor move as the cable sagged. It's a minor annoyance at best...and I could have fixed it...but I treated myself to a new mouse and I'm not disappointed in the slightest. I'm not really a huge gamer but I do IT work from home and am at the computer for 8 - 12 hours pretty much every day. A comfortable mouse is a must and this is it! The battery seems to last about 2 - 3 weeks between charges. If I ever have to go back to the office, the fact that this is the non-RGB version works in my favor and it won't attract too much attention.The software is a bit on the finicky side. I like to run mine at 6400dpi. The defaults are not great and when the software updates I'm stuck waiting for the speed to pick up again while watching the splash animation play out. I kind of got around this by enabling on-board memory mode but even then it randomly turned down the DPI for no discernible reason. I'm not hitting the buttons either, I have the default DPI up and down buttons disabled as well as the profile select button.

source_doc: Nice Fit and Look but Having to Replace the Washer Nozzle with OEM Disappointing. I really liked the look of this and it was a perfect replacement. I ordered the black version to accent my Black Jeep which I was really glad I did for the look!However there is where my problems came and why I only gave 3 stars. It comes with a paper saying to replace the Washer Nozzle that comes with it with the old OEM version from the one you are removing.YOU MUST DO THIS because The Nozzle that comes with it is terrible and basically squirts a stream of water down the back instead of spraying it. I found this out the hard way.First, because I ordered the Black version it would look real goofy with the Red nozzle on it. That’s why I ignored the manufacturers direction. So I had to mask off and paint my old red nozzle to match black.Second, because the original OEM nozzle was old the plastic was brittle and one of the securing clips molded into it was broken in the process. You cannot buy just the nozzle and have to buy the whole light assembly so I had to do some engineering to make it work.The manufacturer needs to fix this functional nozzle issue and not make Customers have to hassle with this. If it weren’t for this I would have given it 5 stars!

source_doc: Warm White Light Bulb. Exactly whT I expected. I got the warm white color. 3000 Lumen or whatever the rating is. I knew these were not dimmable. source_doc: These really work! I took these for the first time and had great results. I chose a night when I was pretty sure I would have trouble sleeping (Sunday night for teachers is the worst and I napped too much on Sunday afternoon). I took one gummy a hour and a half before bed because I wanted to make sure it wore off by morning. I was sleepy within 30 minutes! I made myself wait until bedtime and then slept peacefully. My cat woke me up once and I woke up another time naturally to go to the bathroom. Normally I wake up several times a night, so this was a huge improvement. I also have an issue with eating snacks at night, but I did not eat a single thing that night. I’m not sure if it keeps you too tired to be hungry or if it creates an appetite suppressant effect, but whatever it is, I am pleasantly surprised. I will be reordering when I run out. I will also be taking the gummy closer to bedtime!

source_doc: Once Upon A Time. Once upon a time I used to stand on a metal box that I place on a chair just so I could reach the light bulb socket.  This light bulb socket is located in the hallway leading upstairs.  So I had to place a chair on steps that was dangerous.  Now that I am older (60 years), weigh more and not comfortable with relying on my stability, I searched for something that I could use to reach the light bulb socket safely.  I am so happy that I found this product.  I did not buy the pole but used a old sponge mop pole which worked just as well.A lot of people said that they had problems with the spiral light bulbs, I did notice that as I was screwing counter clockwise, the standard light bulb gripper also was unscrewing.  I just tightened the screw on the light bulb gripper onto the mop pole and it worked.  I haven't tried any of the other grippers but am looking forward to seeing if it will work on the flood light bulb outside.

I give it to her daily in a higher dose than stated as she is most anxious and  has her bad eye. I am on the second bottle and just ordered more.

source_doc: Incredible audio and customer service! I purchased this monitor in June of 2021. I use it for monitoring my mom with severe Alzheimer's. The sound quality is amazing! I can hear her breathing from across the room on this monitor. Sunday morning about 2 am, I started getting a notification beep that the battery was about dead on my monitor. I checked the cord, battery, everything. I emailed customer support at 2:30 in the morning on a Sunday morning, I had a response later Sunday. Long story short, they expedited a replacement cord to me and I received it just now (Tuesday morning). Free of charge. Wow!The picture quality is pretty good, just small on this camera, but as I said the audio is amazing. $49 is a steal for this camera! I have purchased a lot of baby monitors to find the best one. This has much better sound pickup than any of the others I tried- including expensive ones. Expensive price is not equivalent to quality. This is a great buy! I can't say enough good about them. Oh yeah, the monitor also will pick up across the street as well. I can carry it over to visit with a neighbor and keep an eye on my mom as she sleeps.Buy it!

source_doc: Looks Nice, Quality Is Good, But... ...it didn't fit the dog I ordered it for. Did I measure wrong? I don't know, but I usually order a small or medium for my Chiweenie, this time I ordered a medium and it just doesn't fit. It's too small. The velcro straps barely touch when I put it on him, and it's too big to fit my next smaller dog.However, the quality is very good. It appears very sturdy and well made. I like that the velcro area on the strips is pretty big, so it really offers a secure closure, plus the 2nd closure option, the buckle, also feels sturdy.It's not adjustable in the sense that you can't shorten or lengthen any straps, but it is adjustable in the sense that you can adjust the velcro closure to fit.It's mesh and breathable and looks quite nice. The only thing I would see as a con, (instead of a "pro"), at least for me, is that it doesn't have a any stretch like other similar harnesses do. I feel like with a little bit of stretch, there's a little bi of give, so it doesn't hurt him if I happen to pull on the harness. Some owners may not want any stretch, so I guess this just depends on preference.All in all, I do recommend it based on quality, but unfortunately, it just didn't fit. Make sure to measure correctly!

source_doc: Find your studs before ordering. I assumed I would not have trouble laying out the footprint I hade in mind. But the studs in my garage walls appear to be irregularly spaced. Two different stud finder tools failed to help. So I had to probe around. I attempted to pop the wall plates off of a light switch and an outlet, identify the corresponding wall stud, and measure in 16 inch increments and higher, and couldn’t figure a consistent interval. So I ended up just using my smallest drill bit with some guesswork until I found enough spots that would work.Wish I had spent some time getting lines down on every possible stud before I opened boxes and stuff everywhere. I made it work by combining some 4’ and 3’ spans (from the 6’ model).Now that I got them up, I’m satisfied with how they look and getting my crap off the floor.

Even on the slowest setting every other nail drill was too powerful sometimes, but this one is perfect. Power when you want, but gentle when you don't. I would spend $100 on this and it would still be worth it.

source_doc: Almost perfect. Better as a light feature. I tried a few sound machines but this one was the best I found for my needs. I tried the portable frida, VTech soother with the app (similar to hatch), Google mini speaker, or just a fan running. I wanted a sound machine that worked with Google Home, had a reliable app, good sound quality and sound options, and dynamic lighting that I could change colors or dim. The govee sound machine fit most of these. My only issue was the sound options and the speaker sound could be improved. The app had mostly 'natural' sounds like wind, rain, river, fire, and some lullaby options. I just wanted a basic flat white, pink, or brown noise. The closest I found to the white noise is the wind and for some reason the speaker quality didn't block a lot of background noise. I noticed some of the other ones I tried did really well blocking noise because it had better sound frequency range. Other than that this would be perfect. My baby woke up more often using this for sound. The lighting options are really unique so I'll give it that. I like the gaming mode and different lighting combos. I now just use this as a light so I'll keep it.

source_doc: I LOVE This Little Light Of Mine. All kidding aside, I really love this little tactical flashlight.  The light is extremely bright and and versatile.  LED really does make a difference and it seems like the battery life is extremely long after a full charge.  The price is absolutely reasonable and I have been using this little flashlight for over 6 months and oddly, I find myself having to use it more than I thought I would.  I usually always buy those cheapy ones at the hardware store, they don't last very long and aren't anywhere close to as bright as this one is.  The fact that you can recharge is definitely a money saving bonus.  This would make a great gift for anyone as well.  I have since purchased 3 more so that I can keep them handy in different locations like the vehicle, that tool box, my desk and the tackle box.  I highly recommend this one and I hope you find this review helpful!

source_doc: Very Sturdy. I have bought what feels like a ton of these over my adult life for all kinds of different, practical applications not just for hanging a shower curtain and this one has to be one of the sturdiest ones I have ever purchased.  I wasn't so sure about the black as I normally stick to white, off-white or a light tan but for the purpose of my purchase, I was indifferent because I just needed a sturdier rod in my laundry room.  I use this rod to hang the clothes right out of the dryer and sometimes, the weight of clothes can be so much that a regular, cheaper rod, will buckle under that kind of weight.  I was hoping that this rod would solve my worry about that because I had my other one fall on me, a couple of times by that buckling under the weight of the clothes.  This one is absolutely the answer.  It is really easy to install and extremely sturdy, I can easily hang about 3 loads before I have to put them in their respective closets.  That's a LOT of laundry, and an amount that my other rod couldn't even dream about holding.  The price is very reasonable as well, so if you are in the market for a really sturdy rod, this is it.  I hope you find this review helpful!

source_doc: Good wireless earbuds. These are nice wireless earbuds. They fit pretty good, I have had one fall out a few times at the gym (I may need to change to a different ear cushion, which are included). I think the sound is very good, I like the bass-heavy music while working out. They seem to hold a charge a long time. The controls are a bit sensitive and I’ve accidentally skipped the controls I wanted. I have not used this for phone calls, so I cannot comment on the quality of talking on the phone. When I first connected my phone to these, the Bluetooth for the ear buds came up twice, and I only could hear out of one speaker (depending which one I chose, the left or the right) and I couldn’t get them to sync. The way I resolved it was “forgetting” both and shutting my Bluetooth off, then after turning it back on, it was only listed once, and they’ve worked fine ever since.

source_doc: So Easy. You just put the clips on them and they are ready to learn. I have a liftmaster + security. I looked on the garage door opener for the dangling wire, took the light cover off and saw a red button. This is my learn button. I long pressed II & III until the LED came on and then blinked a bit and went off. Since my learn button was red I clicked the I button 3 times. then pressed one of the different buttons (II or III). Then I pressed the red learn button on the garage door opener and immediately clicked the I button on the new remote. I heard 2 clicks. My light bulb is out or else it probably would have blinked 2 times as well. Afterwards I hit the I button on the remoter and the door opened. Then I hit it again and the door closed. Very easy for me. If what I said isn't clear refer to the directions that are in the box. Plus your learn button may be different. Inexpensive way to get extra remotes or replace broken ones.

source_doc: Requires you to close your doors into it. I have an older car (Toyota Solara), and wanted this to protect it from the times I can't park in the garage. I've used another cover previously however it has gotten worn down from seasons so I wanted to give this one a try.The good news is that the clips are plastic, which I LOVE. The old cover I used had metal clips, and if one isn't fastened properly, that'll scratch up the car in the wind as it shakes around. I prefer plastic or rubberized clips any day.The bad news, is that they want me to close the doors into this in order to hold it in place. I did not realize that is how it is supposed to work, and I have a major problem with that- The Solara doors don't have a top frame, it is glass against the rubber gasket of the car's top. With material in between like this, you are asking for leaks into the interior of the car around the door seams. I don't like that at all. It fits fine on my other car (Honda Odyssey) but I'm disappointed I can't use it on the car I wanted to.

source_doc: As flimsy as paper. I was looking to replace a wonderful bass clef magnet I'd had on my car for many years. I liked the romantic look of this treble/bass clef design, and was excited to get it. It arrived in a regular envelope, and I had no idea what was in it. I almost didn't open it, because the return address was not familiar. When I did open it, the magnet slid out like a piece of card stock paper, and the 2 "dots" that rest on the outer edge of the bass clef were 2 loose little black circles --- not in any way what I expected, and I certainly can't put it on my car. The first rain would wash them off. The extension at the bottom of the treble clef is flimsy & weak. I don't really know what I can do with it. I put it on my refrigerator, because I can't use it for what it was intended, and it won't stick to anything else.

source_doc: Simple Tool Makes for Easy Work! I love these. I have been buying them for a few years. Fret polishing is a task that never goes out of style and these fret erasers make easy work of a tedious task. This is the first time I got the 180 grit eraser so I am really excited to see how that will work on some of the more stubborn scratches and tool marks that I find on frets. They are pretty simple to use, I tape off the fret board and then use them just like an eraser. I go fret by fret with each eraser working my way up from the lower grits to the higher polishing grits. This kit has the 1000 grit which I have already but I would encourage buying the 2000 grit eraser or using a finger nail buffer stick to really nail the mirror shine. I not only recommend, but I use them myself and love them!

source_doc: JONATHAN Crystal/Metal LED Table Lamp. I have to say that I am extremely pleased with the Jonathan Crystal/Metal Table Lamp set. These lamps are very attractive, weigh a descent amount, and are made very well. I purchased four of these for the bedroom, and with the crystal stems and brass crystal base these really look elegant. I tend to read a majority of the reviews when I am purchasing a product, and based on those reviews I purchased two sets of these lamps, even though I read a few of the following concerns.  The lamps have an electrical cord that is covered with a lead woven covering, and the top part of the bulb socket has cardboard inserted inside it, in addition to the metal. This could have been a deal breaker for me, but you have many options for the wattage size of bulbs you may use. I also spent so much time looking for lamps on Amazon, and I was so pleased with the appearance of these lamps that I just did not want to send them back. I hope the Designer can eventually afford to use a electrical cord without the leaded woven covering,and a full metal socket without the cardboard insert.  All in all, I am pleased with these lamps.

source_doc: This is a compact unit that will work with your existing ratchet wrench or breaker bar. This tool has a solid, compact storage case, and the unit will work with 1/4, 3//8, and a half inch drive.  The unit will display and work with numerous torque measurements and specifically inch-pounds and foot-pounds that I need. To test its functionality I loosened a wheel lug on the tractor.  I then connected the electronic torque tool to my existing click adjustable torque wrench.  I adjusted the electronic device to 83.5 foot-pounds and the click adjustable to 86 foot-pounds.  As I tightened the bolt, the electronic device began beeping at just under 80 pounds.  My initial thought was "this isn't good".  So I next set both to 86 foot-pounds.  The beeping began around 83 foot-pounds but I kept going.  At 86 foot-pounds I heard the click and the tone switched from beeping to solid simultaneously.  Great, I figured out the beep is "approaching" and solid means you're there.  I later went back to the manual and found a "note" explaining the beep means you're within 20% of the target.  So, I like the unit and the audible feedback.

source_doc: Ryobi 3/8 in. Variable Speed Drill (Renewed) I ordered this drill because funds are tight but I needed a drill to do some home maintenance. It is refurbished. The drill came without a case or any bling which is exactly what I expected. It did come with an instructional manual and a full 1 year warranty which was enough to impress me. I have used it a couple of times and I am not disappointed at all. It has plenty of power for the size of drill it is. I am a 60 year old disabled woman and I was able to fix my own wall that was bulging out due to blown insulation settling. I search high and low to find this Ryobi drill because I still have the 9v cordless I bought about 18 years ago and it is just now dying and no batteries are made for it anymore. Ryobi is a great product line. I wish I could afford 1 of everything they make. Don't be afraid to order the refurbished drill. It was a fantastic purchase choice for me.

source_doc: Meh... It's OK for low volume playback. So, I have 2 offices I work out of in my home. My small office has a set of M-Audio AV32.1 to play background music at low volume, but I always find the low end lacking. I run a 10" Monolith sub in my other office, paired with Mackie XR624 monitors and I'm mostly happy with that setup, so I thought I would get another Monolith, but I think if would be way too much sub for the M-Audio speakers. Thankfully, Monoprice makes a very inexpensive 10" sub that supposedly plays down to 20hz. I played with it for a couple of hours, and so far, it's ok. I'm cycling now to break it in, but overall it adds that little depth  I was missing on the M-Audio speakers. I'm sure they'll sound better once they are broken in. I'm still on the fence about this sub, since it lacks authority like the Monolith or the 15" DR. HSU I have for my main setup.  Then again, I haven't added a proper crossover to the small office setup, so the verdict is still out...  For small room, low volume - I give it a 3 out of 5.  If you can afford it or wait for a closeout, the Monoprice Monolith 10" is 10 x better.

source_doc: Works great on my long haired Maine Coon. I have a Maine Coon cat with really long hair. This comb really helps pull the loose hair out of his coat. I use it about once a week on him and I am always shocked at how much hair I get, between a golf ball size to tennis ball sized clump of hair when I am done. You would think after pulling up that much hair that he would be thinned out, but every week there is more. I think it really helps with the fur ball problem because I don't hear him trying to cough up the fur balls as much since I started using this every week. You just have to go slow, don't pull to hard, and if it starts to have resistance just pull up away from the body. Just watch if he likes it or not, if he is purring I good to go but if I start getting the look and the wagging tail I had better slowdown or back off. He is 24 pound cat that you want to treat right. Afterwards I give him some freeze dried chicken as a treat and he is very happy with me. I like this comb, very happy with it, best out of the five I had prior to this one.

source_doc: I like it a lot. I had an old one I bought years ago that was smaller. This one is large enough to easily accept a paper shopping bag, and it’s a little taller than my old one, so if I have a bunch of plastic shopping bags, I can pile them up higher. I’ve heard some of them fall apart, so I pulled on mine from different directions, and it’s not falling apart. I don’t doubt with automated manufacturing that some of them would be defective. source_doc: Better than expected. I used this as a junction box on my utility trailer. My trailer doesn't have brakes so I didn't need all the lugs but I wanted a box like this to use in wiring the trailer and didn't find anything like it for a four wire setup so I went ahead and got this one and I'm glad I did. I did add a rubber gasket and I sealed around the wires with silicone RTV where I brought them into the wiring box through the rubber plugs that came with the box.The box itself is pretty stout but the strain relief clamps on the ends of the box could definitely stand some beefing up. It would be a better product if the side enty ports also had strain reliefs.In spite of its shortcomings, I like this box well enough that I bought another one which I intend to use when I rewire another trailer of mine next summer.

source_doc: Thick, plush & WARM as advertised!! Sir Thomas is a stray ( in pic), roaming the neighborhood; came up missing for a few days; when he did return, he had been in a fight. I brought out the new (still in box) thermal cat mat-pad, folded a blanket throw underneath the Morapet, so he’d be elevated a bit. This fellow didn’t hesitate; it’s as if his name was on it, got right in, laid down and was out like a light. Slept several hours. Outside temp was 47°. I called our Vet, no openings for another 4 days. I’m trying to get him to trust me more, so I can get him fixed, but this injury took front-runner, I can work on trust later. Originally, I had browsed all the other brands of self-warming mat-pads for one of our senior indoor cats, as I needed another self-warming mat-pad for Geno… I settled on this one for it’s plush fabric &  thickness, but when I saw Sir Thomas’ eye injury,  the 3 deep gashes on his paw and small bit of missing fur on his hind area, I felt this warming mat-pad really needs to go to him. Before his injury, he’d just sleep wherever he could.I was so impressed with the quality of workmanship, the thickness, plush & warmth of this product. I will be buying another 1 or 2 to replace Geno’s.  YES I would recommend this product !!

source_doc: Bulky. I have large chihuahua so I ordered the medium according to their size recommendations.  I was surprised at how bulky this collar is.  It was a bit larger in circumference than I expected but I was able to size it down fine to fit, some of the lights are now tucked under, but there is still plenty of brightness.  The battery box and the AirTag holder are big though.  I put it on my giant Chihuahua and he was like, "what the heck is on ma neck, lady?" He got used to it quick.  I do really like the light show.  You can choose your color and your blink pattern.  This collar is bright!  Very visible will be the dog you put this on.  You can see in my one of my pictures the width of the battery box controller, and airTag holder which is what I docked the star for.  This collar is holding up well with our rainy winter night walks, but this thing verges on apparatus rather than collar.  Maybe it's just me having a smaller- but still *relatively* giant- dog and not being used to what a big dog might wear.  It came with a seatbelt adapter but I use a dog seat so I gifted that to a friend who likes it. I don't know how safe it keeps the dog but it keeps her out of the front seat!

source_doc: Awesome thermometer. I love this thermometer! I never worried about a thermometer until the RONA hit. The first time I caught it was right before we could get vaccinated and I have Fibromyalgia so even the CDC told us that I was going to have a rougher time of it than my mom. And I did, I fought with a fever for over a week while she never had a fever. (That's just the pertinent symptom here) We had gotten 2 thermometers one for the temple and I got a regular one because I had to be able to use it simply and in the dark and didn't want to fumble with it. But they both used button batteries. Guess what, a couple years later when I got it a second time (proving I was more prone to it because I didn't pass it to my mom as she had passed it to me) Both thermometers were dead and we couldn't check my temp, though I didn't have a fever. So when I saw this one and saw it took normal every day run of the mill always on hand batteries and that it displayed the same as the ones we had I grabbed it right up and it didn't disappoint. And while I don't need it yet, I did try it and it works perfectly. I'm so happy with this thermometer.

source_doc: Does not work. I don’t like leaving bad reviews, but here it is. I bought this lapel mic in December and JUST opened it up to try and use it. I charged it up, at least I think I have, but this thing will not turn on. I used the cable that came with the mic and a trusted wall charger and I don’t know if it is charged or not because it won’t turn on. I’ve tried to get it to work, my tech savvy husband (who warned me not to buy a lapel mic this cheap), and my tech savvy father in law. It’s been plugged in to charge at different points in the house and with different charge ports/bricks, all of it. It will not turn on. I unfortunately did not realize that the return by date was yesterday (the 31st), so now I have to buy another one. I’m pretty sure I got a broken/bum mic. Some people praise this mic and I took a chance. Just my luck.

source_doc: Great, until it fell apart! I am in a nursing home, and I had it sitting on a table at the end of my bed. I reached for it with my grabber tool, to pull it towards me, and the side literally just popped off. There are two miniscule nails holding it together, which are as thick as office staples. As soon as that side came off, the rest of it started to come apart as well. I started to do a return, but it said it had to be returned in original packaging, which of course I didn't keep. Or I could get an exchange, but I what if that falls apart too? I noticed that beside the tiny, insignificant nails, there is a trail of wood glue that is about the width of a human hair. I think if they had used bigger nails or more wood glue, it would have stayed together. I'm just going to try and hot glue it back together. If that doesn't work, I have elbow joint brackets I can screw on to each corner. If not for it falling apart, I would have given it 5 stars. The concept is awesome to store your different sizes of zippy bags in. Just wish it had been put together better.

source_doc: Great for Dog Training Gloves. I have learned that my dogs and I both do better when I wear gloves while training them. I have a better grip on toys and tugs, and when my pups see me don a pair of gloves they get excited because it is time to WORK. I have been using leather gloves, and they get gross very quickly.These Manusage work gloves are exactly what I need for training. Obviously, they'd work well for gardening and other things around the house too, but dog training is what I'm most excited about. Slobber doesn't soak through these gloves to make my hands cold or stinky. The gloves themselves dry out quickly so they don't get stinky (leather gloves...ewwwww). The gloves grip things very well so I am no longer dropping slippery slobbery toys and balls. They do actually work on a touchscreen - I tried them out just to see - but I highly doubt I will be using a screen with slobber covered gloves.After multiple sessions of training dogs with the same pair of gloves, I may never need to buy any again...or at least, it will be a couple of years since I have 12 pairs now. The medium size fit as I expected as I typically wear a medium in work gloves.

source_doc: Not sure if it worked, but my tank was cycled quickly. I watched a bunch of youtube videos and was expecting to get some giant algae bloom or a huge spike in nitrites and then nitrates.  I never experienced any of this. I was so unsure if my tank was cycled. I tested my water consistently, for 2 weeks no change. Then i bought a small rock covered in algae from petco and put it in there. I shined a flashlight that night and saw it had some good hitchhikers in it. Tiny Stomatella snails, and alot of amphipods. I watched them for a week and they were thriving so i knew it was obviously cycled now. Then i bought one fish, a diamond goby. That guy is the best purchase ive made. He is a workhorse and keeps my entire sandbed clean of all extra food. Anyways... he was happy in there. So then i knew it was safe to add more.  My tank is 75 gallons with live sand and dry live rock carib sea. The only wet live rock i added was that tiny one from petco.  I think it works. Still not sure really if it was this stuff or the extra time i gave it.

source_doc: My very first VR set! So worth the money! I finally decided to plunge into the world of virtual reality — and I’m so glad I chose this item as my first “attempt” at VR! I really liked that any adjustment (minus the strap) could easily be done even while wearing the device without interrupting gameplay! As for the strap, just a simple fix of placing the joycons down, fix it, and bam, you’re immediately back to gameplay. I saw other reviews say it was heavy… honestly I found it to be light!My only downsides to it (which neither have nothing to do with the product itself), are…- The games offered. I wish Nintendo would offer a VR mode for more games- Because I have thick hair, if I moved a certain way, the straps would slide up to the top of my head (due to gripping) and I would have to pause the game and reset it on my head before continuing. But I’ll try wearing a ponytail next time!All in all, I really enjoyed my time with this, and I can definitely see it as a more long-term option than what Nintendo offers!

source_doc: Good for the Price..But. I have some nice heavy duty solar lights that I want to hang in my yard along the back fence line which overlooks a wooded area.  When I saw these 9ft light poles, I knew it would be the perfect solution!  I was so excited when the box arrived but then quickly disappointed because apparently I did not read the description well enough - I saw the beginning of the title ‘Patio String Lights Poles” and assumed I would be getting two poles.  It does say ‘Pole’ singular further in the description.  So if you order these, you may want to order two.  I cannot hang lights from one pole lol so I will have to order a second one.  Having said that, the price doubled is about what other sets of two cost.  The pole comes in sections that you just screw together so assembly is simple.  I wish it was a little bit heavier duty because I’m not sure how well it will support my lights but it may be fine.  The pole doesn’t wobble much once in the ground with the five spikes.  Overall they are decent quality.

source_doc: Tore My Skin - Also NOT Returnable. Sadly this “gentle” tape stuck too well. After changing my bandage only twice my skin tore as the tape was removed. I do not have thin skin. I’ve used a variety of tapes over the years, and yes skin can tear after multiple bandage changes, it happens, the skin just gets worn down. But I’ve never had it happen on the second change. The tape was really really stuck after just four hours on my skin. I slowly removed the first piece, when that gave me trouble I tried soaking the second piece. It didn’t work. I definitely don’t recommend using this product if you DO have thin skin. And I would think twice about getting this if you’re going to have to change the dressing multiple times.Worse, I had bought two different widths of this tape. When I went to return the unopened one I learned that it is not returnable. If you look at the return policy on the side bar it says it IS return or replaceable. But when you actually click on it the message pops up that says you can’t return it. No, I do not usually click on it when I see you can return it. I guess I will have to do that from now on since it is misleading to say the least.Lesson learned.

source_doc: Engine power is reduced? This can be your fix. Ok, another Cadillac story, it has been showing "engine power is reduced" for as long as I got the car as a gift. I don't mind to work on it, and for 2 months I learned a lot. I programmed all the modules that I replaced, still, engine power is reduced...So the last two things I was going to do was to change the fuel, then change the accelerator pedal, since I already changed the throttle body, the accelerator pedal was one big thing on the DTC report. My friends thought I was wasting my money, since how the Accelerator pedal can cause that? Well, that part was under water...so...why not? I took my old pedal out, to my surprise it was really easy to get it out, basically just one screw! Then I opened it, it had some corrosion on it, I tried to clean the chip with contact cleaner and wire brushes, didn't work. So I waited till next day this delivered, replaced it. Turn on the car, the "engine power is reduced" message is gone!! I ran GDS and it didn't show any DTC code, so this was a successful fix!

source_doc: Great product and great company. I got this high chair for my 2nd baby. It converts to a little chair when it’s not needed to be a high chair anymore. It can also attach to a dining chair which is great for space saving. I’ve had the chair for over 2 years now. As you can see my son picked at the face, Chewed it and all that. It had started to bubble up on the fox face before he picked at it. I think from his head being warm and rubbing on it. Anyway I was dissatisfied because I wasn’t happy with how it looked but I kept on with it until it got to the point of the picture I posted. So I went to the manufacturer and told them about the problem and asked if they had any replacement parts I could buy. They emailed me back, asked for details and that was the last I heard from them when I sent the email back. Well today 6-8 days later I got a new replacement part sent to me for free. I love when a company listens and goes above and beyond. I’ve had this chair so long I was fully willing to pay for the part but they just made it happen. The chair is durable and easy to clean and it’s cute. I would buy this again and again.

After I replaced the sensor I am getting lights on the dash and even more codes then before I replaced it (basically it made it worse). I don't know if it's the sensor, the way I replaced it, or anything of that nature because I am not a professional mechanic, which is why I'm giving it a 'neutral' review. The sensor was definitely brand new and looked fine before installation so I can't 100% say it's faulty right now. After I get everything worked out I will probably update this review.

source_doc: Almost impossible to play as it came. The guitar looks beautiful and I was very happy until I realized the strings had never even been tensioned....meaning the neck could easily warp.  So I got to work on it, I'm very familiar and used to setting up acoustic guitars.  First the sound hole hex key adjustment is one I've never seen...bizarre...they provide a very long and difficult to use adjustment hex....and it barely works.  This guitar came with action so high it could not be played really.  I play out fairly regularly and have some very high end guitars, even affordable Alvarez guitars I have came setup and easy to adjust.  I have no idea right now what I was do.  I know a good luthier and will get his opinion.  I'm extremely disappointed.  This instrument is not well thought out in terms of design of the neck tension system at all and the copy I received had very little care before it was taken out of a very beaten up box...perhaps it was one sent back.  But this is unplayable.  I may send it back, I wanted a jumbo that I could take out to play and not worry about a super expensive guitar...I've seen half the price guitars that are better than this one...but the finish etc is nice...what a shame the rest isn't.

source_doc: I Want To Learn To Play The Drums. I literally just told my mom I want to learn to play the drums. I'm old enough to get those senior citizen perks and looking for something new. So when I saw this on the vine list I giggled and ordered. I love how quiet this is even when I'm really pounding away. It has a nice pad on the back to keep it from scratching and also helps dampen the noise. When I learn the basics I'll move on, but for now I love my new drumming pad. It came with two sets of sticks and a zippered case. I love that I got it from Vine but would have paid what it cost. Can't wait to get good enough for a real set of drums! I'm signing up for a drum therapy thing to get going. Vine is an Amazon program where you get things free in exchange for your honest review. I will update this one to let you know when I get good enough to have broke a drum stick. Five stars because it's so inexpensive, well thought out and a great way to learn the basics.

source_doc: On the Fence….Good Microphone With Flaws. My wheelhouse is electronics and security so I have used my share of microphones either in security equipment or setting up electronics for a band. The problem I had with this was volume. Maybe it was the App I tested it with, maybe it bugged me that there was no way to monitor the volume. I don’t do YouTube, so maybe this can be tweaked in editing but this did not give me enough volume for the App I was using even at max. I gave it a generous 4 stars because the sound I heard I guess sounded good but I would not use this anyway as it has to be unplugged to hear what you recorded. I don’t know why anyone would go through that pain. Points for quick set up and instant pairing. I guess I’ll leave the rest to the professional YouTubers but I see no use for this unless you are a pro blogger or something. I thought it would work on calls and I could clip it on and walk around but does not work for that. A niche product for video bloggers.

source_doc: I LOVEEEEE IT - but not for work. I eyeballed this keyboard for the LONGEST time before deciding to buy it.  I wanted something pink.  I wanted something backlit.  I wanted something CLICKY.  And this keyboard gave me all of that.  I don't like rechargeable keyboards because I never remember to charge them.  So this being wired made me happy.  I use it all the time for gaming and personal work.  However, when I am working I switch back over to my Apple keyboard.  Only because the clicks of the keys are loud and I don't feel like it is professional.  I prefer a muted keyboard when I am on the phone with clients and I'm typing away.  That's just a personal preference for myself.  I'm sure not everyone is bothered by it, it's just who I am.  So I can easily flip between my personal keyboard and my work keyboard.  That made this thing even better!

source_doc: Work great. Good quality. I switched my trailer axle from a 7500 lb to a 2000 lb axle. I just don't need that big of one way overdone. I went to a couple local places to try to get the u-bolts in the plates but just couldn't find the right size.These are for inch and 3/4 round axle. I think I'm going to need to replace the leaf springs because there's four leaf springs. I need a little softer ride. The trailer is only going to be maybe 1500 lb so I need to switch out those as well.But what I'm getting at for the leaf springs is it fit around four leaf springs and the axle?. After I cranked and tighten the bolts, the bolts are nylon. No washers. But the fact that I have four leaf springs. The bolts barely make it through the nut. Just kind of flush with the top so once I replace the springs I should have a little bit more thread on top of the bolt. I think it would be fine even with three leaf springs.As for quality, definitely quality product, the u-bolts the plates, the nuts, even the coupler that goes between the shock leaf and the axle high quality. I definitely recommend it but it again it is for a inch and 3/4 axle or the 2000 lb load?.If this fits your axle, it's a good product. Get it.

source_doc: I would buy it again if needed. I couldn’t find the spring isolators for a decent price so I bought this kit. I figured if the springs were junk like everyone said I would still be money ahead buying this kit and a set of springs. Great news, the kit was great. Springs are a good ride height and everything went in easy. I don’t know why this product had such mixed reviews. Install took about 2 hours with good tools. Extending the axle enough to put the new spring in was expectedly tough because I couldn’t find my spring compressor but I was able to use a small bottle Jack to get the axle separation I needed. If I buy another sequoia I will buy this air spring delete instead of working on the air suspension every 6 months.

source_doc: Strange angle of mouthpiece. I think I've played just about everything that has keys or strings - even a theatre pipe organ - and I was looking for something different that was fun to play.  I did play the recorder a number of years ago, but again, I wanted something unique.  And that, is when I came across the ocarina.  I didn't want to invest a lot of money, but wanted something that had a good tone.  A little research on line brought me to the Night by Noble.  And I love it -- but my right wrist Does Not.  The mouthpiece just seems to be at an odd angle.  I did a little comparison to other brands and sure enough the angle and length is a bit odd.  Again, I really like this particular instrument, but might consider another brand with a longer and,more importantly, more angled mouthpiece, in the near future.Update - I purchased an STL Aria ocarina yesterday.  What a huge difference!  The mouthpiece angle is perfect and definitely longer.  And it gives me a great finger wrap for the balance needed in high notes.  It was three times the price of the NbN, but you pretty much get what you pay for.  I got a thick velvet carrying bag with the NbN, but wanted something more protective for a ceramic instrument.  Ended up finding a camera case that was just the right size.  I'm happy, my wrist is happy, so all is well!

source_doc: Is okay - not good for long-term. I bought this because I wanted a clicky keyboard for when I WFH (I know - a silly reason but I prefer the aesthetic of it). It wasn't hard to set up - The mouse and keyboard function with a USB inserted into the computer/laptop and no batteries are involved. The downside to this is having to re-charge your keyboard every so often. The first time I charged the keyboard (using the cable they provided) it worked fine and I was able to use it for a couple days (maybe 3?) There's no real indicator that tells you how much battery is left - if you turn it on and the battery symbol is red that means it needs to be charged again but other than that nothing. The second time I tried to re-charge it I had plugged in the wire and had it charging for 12 hours. When I went to go unplug and use it though it was completely dead. I figured that the wire might have been faulty so I tried again with another micro-USB I had in the house that I knew worked. Still nothing. Because I couldn't replace batteries or resuscitate it really I had to toss it, which was unfortunate because the mouse was still fine.

source_doc: Love this... and so does my soon-to-be 19-year-old Kitty! I purchased this on December 17th, 2022....  Came on the 19th.  I plugged it in and placed it in my elderly kitty's soft basket on top of his blanket.  At first he was hesitant, but I plopped him in there.  He had been slowing down and cold, and I had moved his basket next to the heater in the kitchen and he was happy.  Well, he has not left his basket since.  He loves this heating pad.  I have set it to No. 4 bar.  I have never turned it off and it's still working.  I am surprised.  I figured it would have burnt out, but so far so good! (Fingers crossed!!!)  He is walking better and so happy!  He loves it.  I haven't washed it yet.  I just turned it over.  I can't get him out of it to wash it.  I feel bad.  I did vacuum it.  LOL!  Now, it doesn't look all plush like in the picture, mind you, but it is soft.  As long as he is still alive, I will replace it if it burns out.  I think it helps him feel better.... Heat is good for old joints for all of us :)

source_doc: Undecided on these stirrups. I bought these for an overseas riding trip in Ireland. I will be riding cross country and jumping. The place where I ride will outfit you with the horse and saddle, etc. however, I've brought my own stirrups and leathers before and just swap them out. The climate is pretty wet. I specifically bought these because when I ride there, my boots are always slipping off the stirrups due to the wetness of the land we're riding through. I have mixed thoughts on these. I like the light weight nature of the stirrups. I normally ride in MDC sport stirrups and they are quite heavy. I like that my feet don't slip out of my stirrups when my boots are wet. I don't like that they're hard to get your feet back in if you lose a stirrup because they lie flat against the flank of the horse. I'm not sure if they're more comfortable. I have been trying them out during my normal riding and lessons. I will keep the stirrups and take them on the trip but I think I'll switch back to my MDCs for normal riding.

source_doc: Important to know!! We had a harrowing experience just now Daisy our cavachon ripped apart the monkey and on the floor next to the monkey was a little tiny battery.  I was hoping to attached a picture but I was able to post it.  UGH!!  I never would've dreamt that those batteries were in there. Anyways, we threw them out because I don't want to take a chance because I thought we were going to have to run to the emergency vet that she might've swallowed one. But we able to figure out there were three and then we called the manufacture, and he confirmed it was three and when I suggested they note it they have those batteries in their toys as a warning but he said it’s on the outside of the packaging.  I could not debate the packing because I ordered it through amazon and I really couldn’t recall if there was special notation on the package it came in. So I thought I would just forewarned when your dog is chewing that there are those tiny little batteries there like hearing aid batteries and be careful!

source_doc: Great Upgrade from HF Cheap Spray Gun! I will start by saying that I am not a professional, really only a weekend woodworker so my experience with HVLP spraying is limited at best. Not only that, cleaning it seems to also not be as tedious, not sure why because it basically has the same parts. If I ever need to replace it, I will order another one and recommend it to anyone looking to jump into the world of HVLP spraying.

source_doc: I couldn't consistently keep the remotes charging. I was really excited to find this product! I have the old Wii system and I have several remotes and I thought this was a great solution to be able to use that system again. However, the product was cheaply made and it seemed to be a wobbly docking station. Once everything was plugged in and remotes were set on the charger the slightest movement stopped the charging process on some remotes. I would mess with the remote on the station and it would start charging again. But, whenever I went back to check it always seemed like a few of them were not charging again. So, I would readjust it to get it charging again only to come back and find that some were charging and some were not. After 15 to 20 minutes of this I decided to return it. I have no idea what triggered it to stop charging. But, the slightest movement seemed to disrupt the whole base. And if you left it alone it still had issues with the position of the docking station and where the charger sat. it was too much of a headache. So I returned it.

source_doc: Very beautiful. This pool cue has no flaws, and is very beautiful. The brown has an almost tigers eye look to it under the light, which makes it that more stunning. It has a nice feel in your hands, and is pretty good quality. I was surprised I liked it even better than I thought I would. The case is also pretty well made and I see no flaws with that either. The cue fits nicely in it without any issues. For the price, I did not expect it to be one of my favorites, but alas, it might just be my favorite pool cue to date, mostly due to the look, yes, but the fact it also has a nice feel, and works as good as any as I've used, plays in that as well.  I will note I am not an avid pool player, but I have played with a league team (as a stand in) previously, and have some experience beyond being new to the sport or just messing around. So I am only giving my review as an in the middle player, not a professional. Regardless, I think this would be a nice addition to any players collection, be it a beginner, or all the way to a pro.

source_doc: Works well, seems well made. Ok, I hate cleaning my shower. I mean it's not gross, but it's not spic-and-span either. I was glad to receive this and as soon as I got it, I plugged in the included charger and charged it for an hour or so. (It shows a red LED when charging that flips to green when fully charged.) As the pic shows, it consists of the head, where the brushes attach, along with 2 other sections, one of which contains the battery, the other is an extension piece that also telescopes to provide more length. You also get 4 brushes of various sizes.After charging it up, I sprayed down the shower with a soap scum cleaning spray and let it sit for about 5 minutes. Then I went to town on it with this little baby. I made the mistake of trying the large, flat brush, and I quickly realized the large rounded brush is a much better option for shower cleaning. Otherwise, it's a little hard to control and it dances around a bit.It worked well, and made the job simple - no awkward bending, reaching, standing in the tub, etc. Glad I purchased it. I've not tested the battery duration yet, but it didn't slow down, and still had plenty of power after I used it.

source_doc: Waste of money. Works great... until it stops working. I purchased two for a trip I took last December/January where it was going to be cold. I live in Florida, so I did not have to use them again until another trip up North about a month ago. I packed them along with the charger and when I got up there, found they were not working (the light would not turn on once it was connected to charger). Thankfully other friends packed extra disposable hand warmers. I emailed the company because I purchased this over disposable hand warmers thinking they would last a while, and I only used them for one trip that was a week long. I was two weeks past my 1 year warranty so I lost my money and nothing can be done. They suggested to charge every once in a while when they are not in use and offered to give me a coupon for my next purchase with them. I respectfully declined as I am sure that product would break as well. Would be great if they included that suggestion along with the product, so their clients would know to charge it every so often to make it last longer. Might just stick to disposables for next trip.

source_doc: Took me a long time to figure this out, but happy with it now. I was eager to try this as a way to record from my guitar onto a Macbook Pro, but was totally new to this type of device.  I understood that I would need to download 'digital audio workstation' (DAW) software, so I read about a few options and decided to go with the free version of Waveform. After downloading it, and connecting my guitar to the BOMGE, and connecting the BOMGE to my laptop (all of which were simple and quick), I spent an unsuccessful hour trying to achieve a recording. Then I downloaded Audacity software and retried, but was again unsuccessful. At that point, I had no idea whether the trouble was the BOMGE or just me not being able to figure this out. Turned out it was me. I returned to Waveform, re-watched a couple of its Youtube tutorials (which I highly recommend for beginners), and eventually got the hang of this. (With the guitar plugged into port 2, make sure that the 'inst' button is set on, and in Waveform, set the input for the recording track to 'input 2.') After that, the info page that came with the BOMGE was meaningful, and I have found the device to be just what I hoped for. It is compact in size and provides a fine sound quality for my amateur level.

I only sprayed it on my arm, and it's giving me a headache. I can't imagine how awful I would feel if I sprayed it all over, not to mention on others around me. The trio is $45.60.

source_doc: Fit well and actually work! When buying these I was a bit skeptical because they were so much cheaper than pants from an actual motorcycle store. However, I got a jacket from a store and was trying to save money so I decided to purchase these pants. Unfortunately I got into a motorcycle accident a couple weeks ago; however, I found out the pants actually work!! There was rain on the road, I had to make a sudden stop, my bike lost traction, slid on its side, and threw me off once it hit a car. I must have slid 15ft on the asphalt, got up and was completely fine besides a few impact bruises. On top of me being fine, the pants are also fine, no rips or tears. I will continue to wear them once I fix my bike. After this experience I had to write a review because I did not see any that mentioned wearing them in a accident.A few reviews mentioned upgrading the padding inside, which I could definitely see and probably would have helped with the impact bruises. But overall these pants are WELL worth the price and I would highly recommend. Saved me from some really bad injuries!Will try to upload pictures when my phone is fixed.

source_doc: Great auto feeder for those that work long days! This is a great auto feeder for those that work long days! I just changed jobs recently, and I'm now working 12 hr shifts. I was worried about how I would keep my 2 small dogs on their feeding schedule, as I leave before their breakfast time and get home after their supper time. This has been a lifesaver knowing my little fur babies are being fed on a regular schedule. It is simple to set up and very simple to use. The portions that dispense are perfect for my dogs. Now I can control when and how much they eat when I'm away working. I also love the fact that I can watch them and speak to them. Although they get a little excited when they hear my voice, I see disappointment when I am really not there. So I keep the speaking very limited. But sometimes they want to fuss with each other when the food comes out, so I can tell them to stop, and they typically will at that point. All that said, this is a great auto feeder with many features and will provide peace of mind knowing your little fur babies are getting their food, and seeing how happy they are when they do. I highly recommend this feeder.

Do what your doctor says but I personally think that this is worth a try if you can afford it. It doesn't have to be this brand. source_doc: stopped working after less than 1 month. i like the design, feel and style of this keyboard. it's one of the few that's not the annoying RGB-colored nonsense that i personally find tacky. everything's great... until less than 1 month goes by and i noticed my text would delete itself while typing, or it'd bring up a random window, or command prompt... then it got worse.i take every key off and clean it with air - still broke. so i look up a keyboard input tester. if i press any bottom row key (like space bar for example), it thinks i'm pressing every single bottom row key (ctrls, alts, windows, fn, and even the left, down and right arrow keys)it progressed so far that i can't use it for gaming, web browsing, writing emails - ANYTHING. it's useless junk. instead of jumping to a negative review, like i am now, i contacted the seller directly and they want to put me through the rigamarole instead of giving me a refund. they do this to demotivate people from getting a refund, and they will waste your time - i've been through this before.maybe i just got a defected one, but even if yours isn't, they're not keen on giving refunds, so i think that says a lot, personally. i 100% regret purchasing this.

source_doc: great for cat hair and taking on the go. my uniform for work is 100% black and having 6 cats, yeah my clothes get covered in hair. now, using a lint roller isn't anything new to me, but the one i had ran out of paper and i had no clue it was out. so ofc i ran to amazon to buy one that would arrive quickly. this one came up and i was intrigued by the design, i've only ever had the straight ones. so i took a chance on this one and omg i'm never going back. the design of this one somehow makes it easier to roll. and i love the fact that it has a cover, because a lot of the time i forget to lint roll before i leave, so it's nice that i can just keep this in my bag and use it once i get to work.it was a little hard to figure out how to peel the paper off but once i did figure it out, it became easy.

source_doc: The shrimp are healthy! The shrimp are beautiful and healthy and so fun to watch.  DO NOT put them in a tank with a betta, guppies or Harlequins.  I have 2 tanks, and at first, I thought it was the betta that was eating them, so I removed him to my second tank. They still kept disappearing, so I removed the harlequins, because after hours of observation, I saw them get aggressive to the helpless shrimp. All that was left was guppies, and they still got eaten. I loved the shrimp so much, they were so fun to watch, but if I try again, I will have them in their own tank with nothing else.  They all arrived alive, healthy and very active.  Their color is so striking.  I feel terrible the research I did online was wrong.  I do wonder if you can keep different colors of shrimps together?  The red and white ones are so cool, too.  So learn from me, people, and don't put them with other fish or they will become a very expensive appetizer!

source_doc: What I expected for the price. I had to send the first order of these baskets back due to damage to the large & medium basket. In spite of the plastic they look very nice and seem sturdy. I have not put any items in them yet but I am sure they will be fine. They are woven around a wire frame and I am sure they will hold up once filled, Another complaint was the inside metal pieces that hold the straps in place. The baskets I purchased are safe. The pointy ends are tucked under the weave. I figured if there was any danger I would simply cover the metal with some sturdy tape, All in all I am pleased with my purchase and I would recommend these baskets.

source_doc: I didn't think I would love it. I honestly wasn't expecting to love this game.  I was waiting for Frosthaven to arrive from the kickstarter and was jonesing for a card game fix that was easy to set up.  Then I saw the reviews for this and figured I'd give it a try since I had a gift card to burn.  Well glad I did, I put 70 hours into it before the credits rolled and I'm waiting for all the DLC to get released before playing it again on new game plus. I'll be honest I haven't had a game tickle me like that since DBZ: Kakarot a few years back.The game loop is nice; get cards, get powers, and make friends.  The combo of it all worked perfect for me, and I was telling my wife dumb stories from the game about blade and captain marvel cute romance or the book club which I found hilarious.  Also one of the first times I've liked captain America.  Or I should say I got him in a way the movies/comics never worked for me.  I still don't like Tony, but that's not a surprise he's a terrible human being.I'm excited for the DLC and what they add since I figure I'll be putting in another 40-60 hours easily to platinum the game on my NG+ run.

source_doc: Useful Microphone For Making Social Media Content. I have enjoyed using this set of microphones to make small videos for social media.  I am not super experienced but I wanted something to be able to more clearly narrate the videos I was making.  I found this set to be super user friendly.  Right out of the box, I was able to figure out how to use them.  I was a little bit apprehensive but these are really just plug and play.  The sound quality is good, probably not the best there is, but I think better then using only the microphone on my iPhone.  I didn’t use them at a distance so I cannot comment on that.  I think if you are looking for a something to get started with, at the price of  $24.99 this is a pretty good place to start.  A few of my friends have seen me using it and have even inquired about where the can pick a set up.  Definitely recommend.

source_doc: if you use festool, with makita vac…it’s a must. it has taken me a long time to work with multiple tool platforms.  Not having a money tree and moving among trade work, construction, and wood working it is also a fact that festool doesn’t make every tool under the sun.  I like the makita vacuum and have really enjoyed it, but bouncing back and forth between AWS gear and plugged in festool devices I got the idea to get this product and velcro a festool power chord to it.  Now when I use my festool planer or sander, I swap hoses (which is easy unlike other extractor or shop vac platforms) and attach the one with the chord.  No it’s not the festool system, but it works for me and has made my desire to get another dust extractor not be a hot button issue.  The older I get the more conscious I am of what I am breathing in.  I can’t say I gave much thought into sanding walls in my fraternity house 30 yrs ago. What I can say is that while I work alone in a job, I will have several extractors, but as far as I am concerned this hose has at least temporarily saved me $900.

source_doc: Very useful, built in metronome is nice. As a person who has been playing bass for almost 16 years now, I tend to try to get whatever equipment I can. For years I had been looking for a metronome, but never really found one at a price point I wanted. After seeing that this tuner has a built in metronome, I decided to give it a try. I charged it with the included cable and first tested it as a tuner. I used the included (piezo?) sensor on the headstock of my acoustic and it seems to be just as accurate as any other tuner I've used in the past. Afterwards, I played with the metronome for a bit, adjusted the tempo, changed up the rhythms, and was quite surprised with the variety of beats I could get out of it. If I didn't already have a designated tuner pedal, I'd probably use this at my local church where I play bass. Display is pretty good, and easy to read, too, so there's that.Overall, I'm satisfied with it. I give it a thumbs up.

source_doc: So much more than I expected. Ok, so I open my package and my heart sinks. I see this tiny little thing about 1/3 the size I imagined. So charging took about 2 hours and I was on pins and needles waiting for it. So fully charged connect it up and BOOM! Wow! So much more sound quality than I expected. The distortion and clean are exactly what I would expect. The bluetooth let me jam along with a backing track AND since BT and INPUT both have separate volumes you can mix it in perfectly. The delay AND delay time is precious and then you still have gain and a 3 band EQ! I can’t wait to run this into my Valve JR head and out my 2 12” cabs. Oh oh I wonder how harmonica sounds through it? Damn, gotta wait till tomorrow to “GET LOUD” I can’t turn this up more than 1/4 if I want to be able to turn my guitar up. So much louder than I expected… I might just have to call this thing a great affordable Christmas present for all my music jamming friends!

source_doc: Mind blown. These were easy to get setup. Fill water to the fill line then drop one of the tubes in and stick the sprayer in and twist tight until you hear it click. It's fun to watch the concentrate go in the water. Each one has its own scent and are for certain areas and materials. It suggests spraying the soiled areas and let them soak for 10 minutes. Then I take the color coordinated cloths that came with them and wipe up the mess. It literally works really well. So far I've used the kitchen one my countertop. I purposely left my cupcake mess from the night before and just cleaned it and I could not believe how easy it was to wipe off( and there was hard frosting on there). Then I used the glass and sprayed the mirrors. I've always used a foam and paper towels but I used the cloth and I seriously couldn't believe it. There were NO streaks and I didn't have to go back over the areas. The last one I used tonight was the shower. I didn't go all gung-ho on the shower but I sprayed it on some areas that get build up quite often and let it sit for a little bit. Again, I couldn't believe how easy the grossness comes off. Tomorrow I'm tackling the bathroom with a blacklight and will update with video!

source_doc: Perfect for small pet food cans. The wet food that I feed my cats comes in small cans and these lids are perfect for saving any leftovers in the refrigerator. They fit perfectly and create a good seal which keeps my refrigerator from smelling like cat food. They’re very easy to wash with soap and hot water. I believe they can even go in the dishwasher but I’ve never tried it. I just wash them when I wash the cat food dishes every night. I’ve had these for nearly a year and they still look and work like they did when I first used them. I highly recommend them for any pet owner that needs to save leftovers.I should mention that I took one of these over to my Mom’s house after Thanksgiving because she wanted a top for leftover canned cranberry jelly (you know the type of gross wobbly cranberry stuff in a can that is somehow a staple of Thanksgiving every year) and she hasn’t returned it because she really likes it. I can’t fault her for that so I guess I really should buy another pack of two. Life is easier when you have more than one of these so I suppose what I’m trying to say is that you should buy more than you think you need. :)

source_doc: I can't believe how cheap this was. Because it certainly doesn't feel or look cheap. It looks higher end than it is.I've been using it for a little while, before deciding to write a review, and I love it just as much now as when I first got it. The keys are clacky, in a pleasing textile-ish kind of way, if you like that, but also not obnoxiously loud at the same time. I did notice the space bar is a bit springier sounding than the other keys like others have said, but I honestly don't even think about it when I'm using it anymore. The contrast of the white keys against the stainless is very aesthetically pleasing. I wish it had dedicated volume buttons, but I'll live. Because the keys are raised, I find it very easy to dust when cleaning--it even includes a cleaning brush to get between the keys, which I thought was a nice touch. The different light modes are fun, though I usually just keep them stationary. It just makes my work area a little more playful, and I love that because it's so me. I don't know much about gaming keyboards or what actually makes a keyboard a **gaming** keyboard, so maybe those who are more hardcore might be able to pick it apart. But I bet a kid would absolutely love this. I'm 38 and I sure do!

source_doc: It's perfect 💕 I love the look of this basket. The color the pockets are deep. My dog seems to like it. I started a return on this purchase because I thought it was just to big. Then I couldn't get the walls to stand up. I didn't understand that at all.  To top it off the basket was touching my tire without my dog being in it.  I was very disappointed. I read the description on the site and thought I measured it right. I got up the next morning determine to make this basket work.  I just loved the look of it especially the color  Ok, the side walls...the openings are hidden up under the Velcro. Which you wouldn't know unless you was really looking.  Once I figured that out the basket was sturdy. Then I tried it on my bike again. You have to pull all the straps up and make it as tight as you can to make sit right. After doing this, the basket no longer sat on my tire. I put my dog in the basket and it was a perfect fit. I'm so glad I didn't return it. I'm in love with all over again. I see my dog and I doing a lot of riding. I just love it💕

source_doc: Didn't Work !!! I bought this Jump Starter in summer because I  knew I might have problems with my car during the winter time and it happened. I didn't use my car for couple of day's and my battery was dead and it was really cold outside. So I decided to jump start it. I connected the jump starter per all the instructions and it didn't help. Unfortunately I came to the conclusion after I googled some info that it's a waist of money. It won't start your car when you have dead battery. Fortunately I asked my neighbor to jump start me and he had a really powerful portable jump starter that started my car in seconds. And I don't have old car, it's from 2017. I just don't drove very often. You can still use it as a portable power bank to charge your phone and light and that's about it. To expensive for a power bank.
