source_doc: Do not waste your money. I had high hopes for these pads & was impressed by looking at them when they arrived. They are a great size & cover a lot of area. They are nice & thick & seem to be of a much better quality over thin pads I’ve gotten previously. Unfortunately that’s where the good part ends. They work horribly. I have a senior dog who is incontinent so I use these where she lays. She wears diapers but has leaks. I was hoping to have an added layer of protection by using these pads. I tested them by pouring a small glass of water on them & waiting a few minutes. The floor under the pad was wet. Not damp, but wet. I felt the top where the pad would have contact with the person or pet’s skin & it was also sopping wet. I double checked to make sure I had the correct side up and it was laid down properly. These pads are no different than laying down a towel. Very disappointing. I’m wondering if all these great reviews were done prior to actually using them. If I had rated on initial looks alone without testing; I would have given this an excellent review. Because of their thickness if you have to double them up for them to work, it is going to be uncomfortable to lay on. I wanted to love these but they were a complete disappointment.

source_doc: This is my second purchase of these. I originally purchased this belt when I had an iphone 8+ back in 2018.  I used it every other day when I ran.  I constantly pulled my iphone out of the belt 2 - 3 times a run (for pictures).  When I purchased an iphone 13 pro max I was happily surprised that it still fit in my old belt.  The belt fit me fine (I wear size 8 women's pants) and never "bounced" during the time I used it (although from time to time I did have to tighten it a bit as it sometimes came loose).Finally after many years of service, the zipper broke in December 2022.  I purchased a replacement and the quality is still as good as the original.  Not planning to upgrade my iphone any time soon, but I hope this still works in future.I highly recommend this product for those who don't like to carry their phones in their pockets when running.

source_doc: Comfy, cushy seat! We just got a stationary bike and it came with one of those skinny bike seats you use on cycling bicycles. It was so uncomfortable that I decided we needed a different seat so I came on Amazon, like I always do, and searched for one. When I came across this one I loved how it looked so I clicked it and read all about it. Even the reviews were mostly positive, and I see why. When we got the seat we put it on our stationary bike, as soon as I got on the bike I knew we made the right choice! It’s so soft and very cushy, it’s such a huge difference from the original seat! I can’t say anything about the durability quite yet since we just got it, but it feels very sturdy to me and seems to be very well made. I’m very happy with it and I definitely recommend this seat to anyone who needs a comfy bike seat.

source_doc: In anticipation of using, I'm going to say it's right up there with Hydroflask. My family owns too many water bottles and most of them are hydroflasks. We've got a few eco vessels and a few generic throw around ones. But I wanted to be different so that I would know it's mine... My wife might try and claim it as hers like she did with another hydroflask bottle I bought.I really like the size and the wide mouth opening and the chug cap. The wide mouth when you have the chug cap off makes it super easy to fill with ice and drink. It's wider than the hydroflask wide mouth bottles. The chug cap is really easy to take off. It has a grippy edge to it.Having had the handle cap for the hydroflasks, I think I can honestly say I like the yeti design better. A solid shape as opposed to having it swivel. I prefer the solid shape.Even though I haven't used it yet I have no doubt that it will perform as well with hot and cold as the hydroflask bottles. I plan on using this for travel and of course those hot summer days on the golf course.The picture doesn't do the color justice. It looks better than the picture. I'd definitely get another so I can have 2 in a rotation... Just a different color.

source_doc: Just what I need. I have just gotten it all set up in our bedroom, so haven’t had a chance to really see how it is in the long run, but I am hopeful. We both use CPAPs and of course living in the Midwest, the furnace has been running for months, and it is dry as a bone in the house. I also have Autoimmune Dry Eye Disease, with an overlay of moderate TED (Thyroid Eye Disease), so the dryness is kind of a big deal.I got a different one last year and after I got it i went over instructions. Dear sweet Jesus, it was the most picky, intricate, PIA humidifier-thing I have ever seen. Use special water (not just distilled), and fill this other hole with whatever-the-hell (more special c**p) and be sure to run this, flip that, push this and dance around it in goatskin chaps in hopes of getting humidity.I have very high hopes for my dry, scratchy eyes, mouth so dry my tongue has to be peeled from the roof of my mouth, cracked lips, dry skin, and itchy face and hands. I haven’t had it long enough to to fall to my knees in joy and say “OMG it is the miracle I was looking for” but I bet I will in about two-four weeks.Humidity for EVERYBIDDY!!!

source_doc: Teachers, this is a game changer for your students. I am a professional cellist and teacher. I had the mother of my 6 year old student order this for our little cellist. I have not been impressed with other products in the past, but this looked like it was worth a shot. It's much easier to assemble and lighter than a similar animal themed product- hint, hint. Despite the bulk, it was comfortable in my hand and in her tiny hand. You can pop it on and off with ease. I will never use the beginner thumb on the ferrule bow hold again. I will forever start my students with this gadget. In her 30 minute lesson she graduated to a "real" bow hold with and without the grip aid. I could see the instant change from her fingers to her elbow and shoulder positioning. Hallelujah!! I am ordering one or two for my studio. I think it will be a wonderful aid for my experienced students struggling with bad habits they developed before getting into private lessons. If I was still teaching orchestra in the public schools I would purchase a classroom set. I will definitely be recommending this to my Youth Orchestra cellists.

source_doc: Good for kids (and very good for adults ears) These are very, very light weight. I was desperately looking for foam mallets because they just sound nicer on steel tongue drums and mid class vibraphones. I bought these, not caring that they looked like a lollypop( probably not a good thing because it may entice little ones to chew on it) So I gave them a try and even though the foam was the density that I was hoping for, the handles are so light that I can’t get the sound I want, without whacking really hard,,,,and then all you hear is the thudding and no music. I thought the handle might be hollow and I that I could somehow add some weight but the ends are sealed ( I may chop it off & see if I can add weight and then sand the ends, so they’re smooth. Hmmm….may have to update later.Pros: For parents, whose so called friends, have gotten the kiddies a xylophone, this may save your sanity…Even though the munchkins may bang away, at that thing,,,the sound will not pierce a hole in your eardrum & make you long for their 18th birthday..lol

source_doc: Genuinely Emotional. I can't even begin to describe the wonderful feeling I got when I first used this serum &... Zero Contact Dermatitis!!! None, not even a single red mark. I almost cried! I was SO nervous...I spent months in hell before I figured out I was allergic to synthetic ascorbic acid... I was exhausted, my life was a mess & I had no idea what was causing it or how many products I owned that contained it (topical AND consumable) or were cross contaminated with it (Curology, my Electrolyte Powder, my Vitamins... I was heartbroken)! Ever since discovering my allergy, I've felt like I was on the same exact skincare odyssey I went through in my mid 20's only worse. It's been stressful & filled with a lot of disappointment plus wasted money.But to find THIS product.... Who was the BEAUTIFUL human that thought of this? Bless you!!! There aren't ENOUGH hypoallergenic options in general, but let me tell you... There are almost NO hypoallergenic Vitamin C products!!! They are RARE... & This is one of them. If you're allergic to synthetic ascorbic acid like I am, buy this. Your skin will thank you & you'll feel the deep sense of gratitude that SOMEONE out there cared enough about us.

source_doc: Great mic. I'm kind of new to the podcasthing thing and at first I was disappointed with the sound quality. It was only as good as the $5 desktop mic I replaced. Then I figured out that I had to speak directly into the mic rather than just having it to the side of me on my desk. If I speak directly into the mic the sound quality is amazing. I was really hoping not to have to move the mic directly in front of me each time I recorded, so I started looking for some type of arm that I could connect above me so I could just bring it in when I needed it but I can't seem to find any clamp that fits the mic since it's so wide. source_doc: You get what you pay 4 I'm just getting back into playing the cello after many years, so when I committed to lessons at the beginning of the year I had to move quickly to find an instrument. I found what appeared to be a good beginner cello for a great price. The instrument arrived the next day and was packaged immaculately. However the good stoped there. On first inspection everything seemed normal as I set up the bridge. However, as I started to tune the cello I noticed the tuning pegs would very easily slip out of place. Then I noticed the fine tuners for the D string on the tail piece was bent. I disassemble the bridge and strings to correct it and it just popped backed into the wrong place again. When I took my cello to my first lesson my instructor immediately noticed several things off about the instrument. The nut and bridge were too high, making the strings sit up too far away from the finger board. These physical issues made it very difficult and next to impossible to play. Save your money and go to a licensed string instrument seller. It might me a little more pricey but at least you'll get a quality instrument. I know I did.

source_doc: Great pillow for neck pain. I wasn't sure about buying this pillow mostly because I am not a back sleeper. And while I don't think it has made any difference with my snoring, I do love this pillow. I always thought I loved feather pillows, but after getting this I realized it was because I could bunch them up to be high or low where I wanted. But they don't stay that way... I like this pillow because it is firm but not overly firm and there are various heights. So while I'm on my side, I sleep on one section but if I roll more to my stomach, I can move my head to a different section. And, surprisingly, I do actually enjoy relaxing on my back with my head cradled before I go to sleep. I still don't sleep that way but it's very comfortable to initially wind down

source_doc: Love it! My old knob had been slipping on my genuine leather Wheel Skins cover, even though I used the optional rubber strips. I replaced this cover with a wonderfully plush, inexpensive leather-like cover. The ad for the XL spinner urged me to measure before I ordered. Out of laziness, I did not, and I had to return the regular-size knob for an XL. Installation was a bit of a hassle because the supplied small L-shaped Allen wrench had to be used upside down and out of sight. I wished I had a tool like a screwdriver handle with an Allen wrench attached. I think I did the final tightening by attaching the Allen wrench to a vice grip. I am male, but I have never been as strong as some. I love the XL knob! It operates so smoothly, like a precision instrument with ball bearings. The large, flat head provides secure, excellent control. It does NOT slip, and I wouldn't hesitate to bet it never will. This product is the cat's pajamas!

source_doc: Okay cheap grinder. I've been getting into whole bean coffee here recently and I wanted something that I could fine-tune better than an electric grinder so I got this.  It came packaged just fine and I didn't see any defects or dings on the grinder.  It is basically 3 main pieces the handle which has a plastic knob, the grinder which has all the guts, and the collection bin which catches your grounds.  I got a whole bean that I hadn't tried before and loaded it up and got to grinding.  The grinding while okay didn't feel that great and I had to put a bit more muscle behind it than I had to for my other grinder.  Cleaning it was a breeze, it says not to get it wet so I took it most way apart (I left the grinder guts in) and took my electronic duster, and just blew it out.  For how cheap this is it does its job well I'll probably take this one with me when I go on trips because if it gets lost or broken eh no big deal, but if you want one for home I would spend a couple of bucks more.

source_doc: Versatile and the perfect size, I wish the keycaps were transparent. I really like this size in a portable keyboard. It's small enough that it'll fit easily in a backpack but big enough to have cursor and function keys. All it's missing is the number pad and I can always get a standalone one of those for the occasions that I need it.This keyboard connected very easily with the included cable, dongle and also over Bluetooth. I noticed no typing lag in any mode, but I wasn't using it to play games. The dongle slips into a little pocket underneath the keyboard to reduce the chance that it gets lost. The included instructions are brief but comprehensive.The keys feel great to type on. You can definitely tell you hit the key but it's not super loud like some other mechanical keyboards. The spacebar makes a different and louder sound, but I like that too.There are plenty of backlighting options, and the keyboard remembers the last one you set. My biggest complaint is that the keycaps are not transparent, so it's harder to identify the keys in the dark. A minor quibble is that I don't like the side-by-side notation for shifted keys, I prefer when the shifted key shows up over top of the non-shifted key.Overall, I think this is a great portable keyboard with a lot of versatility in connections. I only wish the keycaps were transparent.

source_doc: Love the scent. First thing I do on any new shampoo or conditioner is smell it to see if it smells nice.  Both the conditioner and shampoo passed with flying colors.Shampoo first.  I like a squeeze bottle over a pump.  I just feel that I can utilize the entire bottle over a pump bottle.  Shampoo did lather nice.  Again, I liked the smell of it as I was washing my hair.Rinsed off and left my hair feeling clean.  Not the dry squeaky type of clean.  A nice soft clean.I then put on the conditioner before I washed up so it would sit in my hair for a few minutes before rinsing.  Like the shampoo, I loved the scent.Nice thicker conditioner.Rinsed off and towel dried my hair.  It didn't get every tangle out but I could tell I had less tangling.  I have very long hair so it's close to impossible to not have a few tangles.My hair felt soft and smelled so nice.  Even after blowing it a little dry, it felt soft.Once I straightened it, my hair feels like silk.  I love it.Price is a little on the higher end.  But ,the bottles are large and with not having to use as much as some other hair products this should last quite awhile.  So price can be comparable.

source_doc: Good for quick cleaning. This electric spinning scrubber is really good for quick cleanings. I'm not a fan of cleaning the tub and this helps to move things along. It's a good quality handle with various types of brush heads. Right out of the box I could use it because it was charged which I like. I put the large brush head on to tackle the tub and turned it on...well hold on because I wasn't ready for the brush to take off once it made contact. It's spinning so it kind of spun right along on it's own, I had to get used to it to hold the brush down to clean the area I wanted. The main thing is you have to hold it at the right angle for the brush to make solid contact because the tip of the handle where you attach the heads is at an angle. With the attachment I have been using it's a little difficult to keep it in full contact so I feel like I am missing areas while I'm cleaning. That's why I say it's good for quick cleaning, not necessarily a thorough cleaning. The power also lasted awhile for me, I've used it about 4 times and it still has a charge. I like having this tool but at $75 the price is high in my opinion.

source_doc: 2012 RAM 2500 ST 6.7L  Transfer case switch perfect  replacement. I was stuck and put my truck 4low, and a service 4wd light came on. Once I was no longer stuck, I shifted it back to 2wd hi, and the dash said I was in 4 hi. So I wanted to see if it was in 4wd. I put my truck in my yard and stomped it, and of course, I was actually in 2wd. I placed it in 4wd and stomped it I was in 4w drive. My truck is a manual floor shift for the transfer case if that helps anybody, which means no electronic actuator to replace for 529.00, just a sensor (Dorman 600-555 ) for 83.00 at Autozone or 60.00 at amazon. I would purchase it again and I suggest going to Harbor freight tools for a 1-1/2-inch spanner wrench or the spanner wrench set for 65.00. the Spanner wrench would fit in the space much better than huge combo wrench. it took only 25 minutes to remove and install please use dielectric grease in the switch plug to keep water out.

source_doc: A simple lamp that brings beauty! Since receiving & writing my original review of the defective lamp I received the seller contacted me & offered a replacement. For as much as I loved it’s beauty I returned as defective. I didn’t trust purchasing another one. A disappointment. I don’t recommend.

Highly recommend for anyone looking for a great heating pad for your upper back, neck and shoulders!

source_doc: I do love this water bottle. I found this water bottle at a great deal when I was looking to add a new one to my collection. I love the colors - and there were a ton to choose from. The motivational writing on the sides is cute and I know works for some people. I don't necessarily follow them strictly during the day, but they do help to keep you a bit on track for water consumption. The outside has a good grip, even if you have melting ice trying to form some condensation. The handle is also great for carrying it around. It fits into most cupholders in the car or even in a backpack side pocket. The lid has been great for keeping the water inside the bottle and not leaking. I love the ease of pressing the button and having the spout pop up. The only thing I'm not a huge fan of is it is a little difficult to clean the straw. I haven't tried to force it from the lid because I don't want to break it. But I don't think you can detach it from the lid. I'm just extra vigilant about regular rinsing and soaking in hot soapy water and hoping no mildew or mold ends up growing in there. Overall a great water bottle and probably one of my favorites from the many I have tried.

source_doc: Used for cabinets, WATER DOWN YOUR PAINT. I have never sprayed paint before and I bought this for a laundry room project to paint unfinished Home Depot cabinets.At first I hated this thing, it only has 1 PSI setting and it blows HARD. First pass with sanding sealer was a nightmare and resulted in large bubbles and all of my (quickly applied) masking tape and plastic getting blown off.Then I switched to paint and I kept getting speckles and not enough paint. I was about to give up and just roll the cabinets with paint, but after a huge mess and lot of trial an error I found that watering my paint down MUCH more than recommended worked great. You'll still see speckles or even globs of paint, but they dry fine and are not noticeable at all.I was using .5cup of water with the paint inside of the container (Sherwin Williams cabinet paint) of the gun and what I found to work perfectly was about 60% paint, 40% distilled water in the container. I had much better results and after 3 coats with sanding in between they looked awesome.I finished the cabinets with 2 coats of Minwax Polycrylic and they came out great. There are some remaining drips from my first coat of sanding sealer that I missed when sanding so I would just be careful to not apply too much and test a lot on cardboard.

source_doc: Good keyboard for the money. This keyboard feels really good for the price point. I like the somewhat stiff action and the quiet clicking sounds. I enjoy using this keyboard and I use it all day. I have not tried it for gaming yet but for the everyday tasks that I do while working. My son tried it out with some games and he said it was pretty good. The RGB lights are fun, but they do not add a lot for me personally. I may just be too old to enjoy that stuff. ;)  I have two things that I wish were different. First, the indicator lights that show Caps Lock, Num Lock, and Scroll Lock are not very bright. They are white labels with white lights, and I can barely tell if they are on or not due to the reflection of my overhead lights. With all the RGB on the keyboard, I wish these indicator lights were bolder. Also, I was excited about having a keyboard for my PC that had mute and audio controls on it. Unfortunately, I have not found any way to invert the function keys so that I can use the audio controls without also holding down the FN key. The FN Lock just locks the whole keyboard which isn’t all that helpful on a desktop compared to its usefulness on a laptop, if those two items were fixed, I would give this keyboard a five-star rating.

I burn a lot of firewood and the LR is right next to the garage so I wanted an alarm that would add some protection in those areas.I love the idea of getting an alarm wherever I may be but I certainly want a true signal.

source_doc: So awesome probably for everyone. I just started to learn how to play. I bought this back in august and it has been amazing. I find it easier to learn to play a song if the guitar sounds like what I’m attempting to emulate. There is no sound this thing can not produce and with the preconfigured sets that users put out it’s an endless supply of sounds. From Hendrix to Freddy Fender. When I purchased it I thought it was the 100% cordless one. It was not so I just went ahead and bought that smaller one too. I hate cords, and with my wireless sender / receiver and the smaller spark it’s going to be so freeing to go anywhere. Now if you’re new like me you will love this I promise. I matter who you are. If you’re a pro I am not sure but I am sure you would probably enjoy this as well. Also for such a small amp it packs a hell of a sound. Must buy.

source_doc: Just what I needed. incremental degrees of lighting is helpful. I needed a lamp for my desk, so I was pleased to try this gooseneck lamp. It clamps onto the desk securely via a spinning C-clamp (as opposed to one you pinch to open). Since it can be tightened and loosened it is quite stable. I tried this lamp in different positions so I clamped it and reclamped it with no issues until I found exactly where I wanted it.I REALLY like that I can increase the light output incrementally (10 levels) from quite dim to nice and bright. There are also 3 different light modes: warm light (2700K), warm white light (4500K), and cool light (6500K). Each of these modes also can be increased/decreased incrementally. Really nice for helping prevent eye fatigue.The neck/arm is 24" and the light strip is 11". I really didn't notice the power supply before I got it, and assumed that it was a normal plug, but it has a USB plug at the end instead. It seems that I'm finding this to be the case more and more. Not an issue except I have to grab some more USB adapter blocks.Made in China.

source_doc: Woks well for fine, straight hair. This is one of the better hair masks that I've found at this price point for my super fine, straight hair. While I wouldn't say it makes a hugely dramatic impact, it's noticeably stronger than regular conditioner. It adds a bit of shine, detangles, and makes my hair more manageable overall. I really struggle with volume, so the fact that this smoothes without flattening is a huge win for me. I also like that I can see its benefits while sticking to my extremely basic hair care routine. I use my normal shampoo and conditioner beforehand and simply comb and air dry afterwards.It does work a bit slower than similar treatments I've used, so I always make sure to thoroughly saturate my hair and leave it on for at least 7 minutes. If I rinse it much sooner, I don't notice the full effects. A little goes a long way though. I start with a small glob to avoid wasting it and usually add a little extra to my ends, as they tend to dry out. It doesn't magically fix split ends, but they do seem to occur less often when I use this mask a few times a week. One tub lasts me several months that way. I think it's a good value overall and will continue purchasing it!

source_doc: Can I give these more than 5 stars?! I love the convenience of using a Swiffer for quick clean-ups.  I have four rescue dogs and foster frequently too so I definitely use my Swiffer a lot.  But let's face it, the Swiffer doesn't really do a great job of cleaning.  In one area of my house, I have tile that was put down years ago before it became more popular to use the larger tiles (my tiles are probably only 12" tiles so I have lots of grout).  The Swiffer doesn't seem to really get down in the grout to clean.  I bought these reusable pads mainly because I thought they would be cheaper in the long run.  An unexpected huge bonus was finding how much better they actually work than the disposable Swiffer pads!  These pads are thick and absorbent.  They make it a tad bit harder to push your Swiffer around but the results are so much better and worth the extra effort!  I haven't tried to wash them yet. I have only just rinsed them off and reused them but will wash them soon and update if I have any issues (but I don't anticipate any problem with them). They do come with instructions telling you not to use fabric softener on them - just an FYI. So glad I ordered these and I will definitely order more!

source_doc: A complete waste of time and money!! Do yourself a favor and look at other tankless rv units by OTHER manufacturers! The listing says that it will fit and opening but this is false! I originally purchased this to go in a travel trailer but it was entirely too small to fit in the opening. I never installed it but decided to hold on to it for my next RV. I recently purchased another RV and the existing water heater was shot so I got this unit out and placed it in the RV. The first time that I used it, it worked great!! I was pleased. The next morning when I tried to do dishes I kept getting an error code and the hot water would immediately shut down. When I very first turn the water on the sensor says that the water is 199 degrees so the unit thinks that the water is too hot. So, now I have to order and install a new temp sensor after using this unit 1 time! A ripoff. I can get no support or warranty repair because I purchased it 2 years ago even though it was kept in the box in new condition I have no support! A complete waste of time and $600.00.

These diapers were on sale and oh how I wish I had been able to purchase more because they are the best diaper I have ever put my hands on. The feel absolutely divine, almost too good to be something a little human poops on. I have had no issues with leaking and they hold pee just as well as the other bamboo diapers I have mentioned here. They are out of my price point but if I they ever go on sale again I will be back. If you can afford them, I highly recommend these diapers.

source_doc: Seemed great until I realized how off it was. I got this thermometer because it had thousands of great reviews!

source_doc: Stopped working after a the first time using.  I paid for shipping on the replacement. I got this as a present so that I can have radio with my partner whilst biking.  I received it for Christmas and live in a winter wonderland so I only tried this once and it worked fine.  Then the weather finally got bearable to bike and low and behold it did not work. No base and only really good for the spoken word.  It tells you to download the app but the only thing the app is good for is the instructions.The helmet itself looks nice and fits comfortably.If I could do it all again I would choose a different company.

source_doc: I bought a bunch of these and so far, so good. I bought an air purifier for each bedroom in my house and I have a big Winix downstairs to help combat our outrageous fur and dust issue. I like these little ones because they are really really quiet on low. The high setting is a little much sound-wise so I have to agree with other reviewers that there should be a medium setting to move more air but still be quiet. But I do keep them on low and they seem to collect plenty of stuff so I can't complain too much. The color is a little odd, but pleasant if you like blue. I can't comment on the sleep mode because I never use it. I just leave them on low at all times instead. I don't use the light up function either because I like my bedroom dark when I'm sleeping. Overall, I think that for the price, they are a good deal and every little bit helps in my house full of cats and dogs. I also like that you can get filters easily and it's made by a big name brand instead of a small company overseas that could stop offering filters at any time. I think this a good buy and I like them.

source_doc: Just what I wanted. I had a jump rope but I didn’t like the super light jump rope cord on it. I needed something a little heavier that I don’t have to spin at a thousand miles an hour to make it track straight. This kit is fantastic, I trimmed the medium cord (the black one) to the size in needed with the included tools and took off using it like I’ve owned it forever because it felt so natural. The medium is perfect for me but I will also trim the other two cords to the same length so I can mix it up now and again. I have nothing but good things to say about this set, the handles are comfortable and spin well, the quick release system works well, all three included cords seem high quality and the case is nice. The extra set screws and Allen wrench were a nice touch and the cable cutters are so nice they are going right in my tool box after I get my other two cords sized. In my opinion this jump rope set is a great value and I can recommend this without reservation.

source_doc: Batteries. So far I do like this wet vac. I've discovered that if I don't run a dust mop over the floors first, the "suction pipe needs cleaning" command is given. If I dust mop first, I totally avoid needing to stop, dump dirty water, flush out dirty water tank, and then resume. If I don't dust mop first, I need to rinse the "suction pipe" maybe 4-5 times. After self-cleaning, I do take a rag and hand dry the rollers, they're pretty wet! Also, I find every time that there's material that needs to be wiped out of the roller compartments, and where outlet where the dirty water is conduited into the suction pipe of the dirty water chamber. I have a question in to the seller as to how to change out the rechargeable batteries. I looked everywhere, called Amazon, and they gave me a link to do this. All that being said...it's STILL steps above my old mop and pail! I am not regretting the purchase, which was made a couple of months ago...

source_doc: Perfect fit for SRX 2012 13582688...Why I remember this number? Because this was the BCM number in my SRX, and I had a hard time finding it new. That was also before I learned EEPROM...anyways. I saw this one, and it was reasonable, I tried to google to see if it will work, no clear answer. I finally contacted Cadillac and they told me yes it fits, then I purchased it. I did have hard time to get the car start even after programming the part, then I copied the EEPROM from my old BCM, wrote that in the chip, it showed "EEPROM PROGRAM INCORRECT". So what to do? I just ran SPS2 and reprogrammed the BCM again, then everything worked. Car started fine, most of the error message is gone on the dash. That was great! Then I purchased ALLDATA subscription, and under the BCM replacement, it showed this one as the only one fit for my car. So happy!

source_doc: Definitely worth a play at a discounted price. Feels like a PS2 era game in regards to voice acting and hack and slash combat but, it’s actually pretty challenging to master the combat in this game. You can actually do some pretty neat things with the gum and katana strung together. You can also hit and then guard cancel into another attack to save animation frames, the game never explains this but once you get a hang of the combat it’s actually a lot of fun.The huge issue I have personally for the game is that it is somewhat too difficult. I have played the game about 7 hours and beaten a couple of bosses and I understand the gameplay loop and how to play, I just feel the checkpoint system makes the game too challenging. The game itself is difficult, but I genuinely enjoy the combat and the challenge to some extent, I just need more checkpoints after completing a challenging area. Often times I will play through a 5-10 min section of the game, just to die and have to replay it, over, and over again. I feel like I really do enjoy how tough the combat feels because overall it feels fair, but it’s hard to not make many mistakes through the long combat sections and overall I ended up losing interest in the game prior to finishing it. I don’t want the Combat to be easier, I just need more checkpoints.

source_doc: So far, so good. I received this yesterday, so I cannot speak to its long-term reliability.  However, I would like to make a few points.  It is smaller than described. About 4 inches wide instead of the 6.3 inches in the description, which fits nicely on my dash.  I chose the "warm light" color.  Gold really, and this fits well with my other dash lights.  The more popular green would have looked much more like an added, non-factory accessory.  It started working right out of the box; however, I did charge it further before installing.  It took about two hours.  Yes, the instructions are poorly translated  from the Chinese.  As with many other consumers, I wish that the Chinese manufacturers would simply find a native English speaker to write their instruction manuals.  Too proud, I suspect.  In any event, If you have trouble with the directions find a 14 year-old to do it for you.  I'm 72 and I managed.  I set it so that only the time shows.  I would have included the temperature, but it will only show that in Celsius.  I don't need the date and year, so I passed on that, too.  My car does have a factory clock, but it is small and poorly placed.  This does the job.  I'll post a follow up in a year or so if I have any further comments or problems.  If you don't see a follow-up then so far, so good.

source_doc: Good for GI issues. I decided to try this food for my APT, who was having intermittent diarrhea.  I initially thought it was related to NSAIDs, as she needs them daily for arthritis.  At wits end, I tried stopping the NSAIDS as a last resort, as I also tried MANY supplements and changed her food, with still no signs of her loose stools resolving.  Chicken and rice helped the most, but I knew she couldn't stay on it forever.  My dog's only symptom was diarrhea.  Her appetite and energy were normal (both over the top) and she would have formed stools as often as diarrhea.  Her weight remained unchanged.At the time I switched to Dave's dry food, I was feeding our dog Blue Buffalo Basics Salmon dry food and white fish wet food.  I didn't realize these were grain free, as I was focused on the "basic" part of the food.  In chatting with a vet, I learned that sometimes grain free diets in dogs can lead to intermittent diarrhea.  After  much research of good quality and affordable dog food for sensitive systems, I came across Dave's Pet Food and decided to try it.  Within a month our dog was back to having consistent formed stools, even while taking her NSAIDS.  I would highly recommend this food for dogs with sensitive systems and GI issues.

source_doc: Least irritating shave I've had in a while. I didn't think there could be too much difference between these and the other razors I've purchased and have been using. While shaving, these seemed as good but no better than a new blade of the other brands I have. What surprised me, was afterwards when I was applying alum and expecting the burn I typically get there was none. I looked these up and the only thing I could tell that is different (from the details in the listing) is that the grind angle is different than other blades might use. This really does seem to make a difference as the next time I used them I experienced the same thing, and I know for a fact that burning is from the micro cuts you are getting when shaving. Alum on shaved skin exacerbates that burn, but with these so far there has been no burn. Hopefully I keep having the same luck, but I highly recommend these as a result!

source_doc: Works so good but you'll never use this much. First of all my child had mild cradles cap, or so I thought. We combed them out etc.  And we ended up doing this for 2 days in a row at bath time And she's never had it again. My only criticism is that I wish there was a smaller volume of this stuff that cost less. I'll never use it all even if I had 5 babies with cradles cap. Unless its like a chronic condition that keeps returning for some idk why someone would need this much. The product itself though it amazing and I highly suggest it.

source_doc: Nice to be able to order the buttons without the entire assembly... I use Straploks on all my basses. I have three straps, and each one has the male portion of the Straplok system. On my main strap, I have four Straplok male connections so that I can achieve the correct playing position for different basses. Each time I purchase a bass, the first thing I do is to change the existing buttons to the Straplok buttons. Until recently, I thought it was necessary to buy the entire assembly, even though all I needed was the buttons. Now it is nice to be able to order just the buttons, but I believe they are priced too high. The entire assembly can be purchased for just $5 more than the buttons alone, which makes no sense, since the male portion of the assembly is much more complex to manufacture compared with the button portion. Still, I would rather pay $5 less and not have too many useless male portions just lying around. I think $5 or so would be a more fair price, not that Dunlop is listening to my advice. lol.

source_doc: Better than the Toyota factory links. My elderly Toyota had a rattle that I had a lot of trouble pinning down.  It would happen as I went over some bumps but not others.  It would act up so intermittently that I couldn't figure it out.  After a lot of driving around and head-scratching I finally narrowed it down to a worn out front sway bar link on the passenger side.The factory Toyota links are non-greasable.  Mine lasted almost 200k miles which is certainly a good track record, but when it came time to replace them one of the reasons I chose the Moog parts is because I can grease them.Yeah, I know suspension grease nipples have gone the way of vent windows and manual door locks.  Modern suspension components are Lubed For Life (yeah right) and last a long time.  Except when they don't.  Besides, I don't mind hitting a dozen fittings with the grease gun once every few months.So I bought the Moog links, installed them, and pumped them full of grease.  It's been a few years and almost 100k miles and the Moogs are still going strong.  I think I've lubed them twice in all that time (so much for those grease fittings) but they're as quiet and slop-free as they ever were.If I ever manage to wear out the links again, I'll buy another set of Moogs.

source_doc: Does not stay on well. I need to preface this review by saying that I am new to doing my nails at home. I have always been a nail biter and picker. So, before spending money on going to a salon and have my nails professionally done only to tear them up, I thought I would try it at home. I used this gel in particular to attach nail extensions to my natural nails. I then used a dip powder to polish them. During the entire process three nails came off very easily. I simply figured I had not used enough of the gel and replaced the nails using more gel. However, once all was said and done, and I was finished with the manicure, the nails still popped off quite easily. So in my very unexperienced opinion, this gel does not seem to stay on your natural nails very well. I still gave it three stars because it could entirely be user error on my part.

source_doc: I am impressed. I have never purchased anything that has impressed me more than this.  I have a 130 lb yellow lab that sheds a pound of hair a day.  I am constantly chasing hair bunnies and sweep my floor daily.  He has very thick hair but this works great, I filled the bin the first use.  I have brushed him everyday and no longer have hair everywhere.  The best part is that he loves it.  I pick up the hose and he comes running.  The only down side is that my arms get tired before he does.  The best purchase I have made in a really long time.  I even used it on our cat, she was not as happy as he was but did let me brush her for about 10 minutes before she flipped her tail and left.  I could never brush them in the house because hair would fly everywhere I spent more time cleaning up after brushing than I did brushing. This brushes and vacuums at the same time which is wonderful, no mess to clean up.  It is amazing how much hair is in the bin.  My only regret is that I didn’t buy it sooner.  I am happy and the dog is thrilled that he gets brushed everyday.  The noise is low so it doesn’t bother him.  I highly recommend this product

source_doc: I buy for convenience. I buy this strictly for the convenience factor. I do a lot of cooking from scratch and many recipes call for bell peppers. Peppers are pretty expensive these days, so I think this is a good value and I’ll definitely buy them again, especially when they’re on sale.

source_doc: I keep coming back to this foundation. I’ve tried other foundations over the years but seem to always come back to this one. I have fair skin and use the L1 ivory color. My skin is also sensitive and I honestly find this somewhat soothing.No fragrance, not too thin (I do like some coverage for my uneven skin and some minor scarring) but not too thick. It actually glides on very smoothly with my make-up sponge. It easily smooths into the hair line and blends well over the chin-to-neck area. No obvious borders from skin color to make up, so I know it’s a good color match for me.I like the pump feature for ease of putting on my sponge (I never apply foundation with my fingers), but I do hate leaving product in the bottle when it gets low. I typically save a “low” bottle and then when my next bottle gets low, I stand one on top of the other to hopefully drip down into the bottom bottle. There is still some waste, but at least I’m getting the use of more product. I think there are even small make-up “spatulas” out there, so perhaps I will try that.I dislike spending money on high-end make-up, and I find this is a quality brand and good value. I highly recommend.

source_doc: Very impressed with the quality of this microphone. I have to say I was pretty blown away by the sound and quality of this microphone. Out of the box, I saw that it was modeled after the Sennheiser series which I own. This allowed me to do a side by side comparison. Now it does come with it's own cord, but I tossed it aside as for using this mic you will in fact to get the best results want to use a full XLR cable. To be honest, I could not tell the difference. The WEYMIC has just as much warmth and presence as my mic. Weight, construction, looks exactly like my own mic, so needless to say, I was very impressed. Since I was at band practice, I let the other guys listen while I tried both and they also could not tell the difference. Just so you know, the WEYMIC microphone is now on my stand and my previous mic is with my guitar player who also shares vocal duties. This works out great since both mics match in sound and quality. I couldn't be happier with this and have hopes that in the future I'll be able to try out some of WEYMIC's other products. This mic well earns 5 stars. Thank you.

I also noticed that I don't have back pain or feel stiff when I wake up.The price was exceptional.This is a great buy if you follow directions to the T.  Check back for an update in April 2023.

source_doc: Good Soap; Very Fragrant. I got this dish soap specifically to take to the office. source_doc: I love it. I did significant research before pulling the trigger on the Honbay modular sectional. I’m so glad I did. My family and I absolutely love it. As other reviews mentioned, 5 out of 7 boxes arrived earlier than expected. The 2 remaining boxes arrived the next day. Once I had an idea of what I was working with in my space, I ordered two additional ottoman pieces to create the sectional I had envisioned. I have a weird space in my living area so many traditional sectionals would be too large. It was super easy to assemble, I did it myself over the course of the two arrival days. I love the storage in each piece, which really helped to declutter my living area and eliminated the need for two storage baskets, freeing up floor space in the process. I love the firmness of the seats. I would agree with other reviews that the back cushions could be fluffier but I added a lot of my own pillows which solves that problem for me. My kids and my dog have bounced around on it and I haven’t noticed any instability. With the layout I chose, I love the little cutout which makes it easy for kids or dog to climb in. I’m so thrilled with my new sectional. If you are on the fence, do it!!

source_doc: Great versatile lamp that gives off plenty of light. I mostly got this lamp because I wanted something we could use when the power goes out. We have high winds where I live and usually a few times a year they end up making the power lines where I live go down. Amazingly enough two days after this light arrived our power went out for about 3 hours. I was so happy I had charged this little lamp and had it to use. It gave off all the light we needed. I even put it at lower light to make it last longer since we had no idea how long the power would be out. The only thing the least bit negative is that it takes a long time for it to fully charge. I set it to charge as soon as I opened it and probably 4 hours later it was still glowing with the red light so I ended up leaving it on for the night. It was fully charged when I got up the next morning but I really don't know just how long it took. So far we have used it for maybe 5 hours all together and it's still going strong. I'm really happy with this light and I'm even thinking of getting another one to keep on hand for the next time we lose power. Definitely recommend this light.

source_doc: I love everything about this, except for the price. I'm 32, acne prone, with combination skin (oily tzone, but dry around my chin). I don't use social media at all, but I am in Korea and my family gifted me some of this. I've been here a month and just finished a stick of it (well there's a bit more, but it's at the bottom and I can no longer glide it over my face). I did not apply it sparingly, used it most days and most evenings as I had forgotten my normal moisturizer. I found that sometimes I'd feel a pimple coming on and I think it actually helped it heal much faster. I haven't noticed wrinkle reduction, but my skin feels healthier and brighter. I tried slugging over it with CeraVe healing ointment, but that's too heavy together, unnecessary. I really like the scent and the packaging, I think I will repurchase, but if you're looking for wrinkle reduction - microneedling and/or retinol products will be more affective. This would be a nice product to alternate when not using retinol.

source_doc: Bought ultra healing in lieu of regular version due to availability/pricing. Same overall quality of the ultra healing product vs the regular Curel moisturing lotion.  The former's viscosity is a little thicker, so as you apply/rub it on, there is a less fluid/liquidity feel to it as the regular Curel.  I would not characterize it as 'tackier' application feeling but definitely thicker and not as smooth/slippery.  If this bothers you, get the  regular blend Curel.  I don't have any comment (yet) if the ultra healing works any better/quicker than the regular moisturizing version as this is my first/earlier use.  I will say the regular version works fine, so I expect to have improved, quicker results from the ultra healing.  I love Curel as I have very low oil and very dry skin.  I apply the lotion in the morning and in the evening, and it resolved some significant skin cracks (actual severe that had some light bleeding) and fingertip ends very rough/dry/abrasive skin in about a week.  So now I use it regularly twice a day and have had no recurring dry, rough, or breaks in the skin.  I don't perceive either ultra or regular Curel as oily or leaving a long-standing film.  I just rub and spread it thoroughly over the skin and in a minute or two I don't even think about whether my skin is greasy, don't notice it.

source_doc: Good seat for floor play. I bought this seat for my 5 month old to help her sit up even though I was hesitant. We are doing as much of the Montessori method as possible, so I do my best to minimize her time spent in ‘containers’. There are still times where I want/need her to sit by herself for independent play while I complete a task and this fits the bill.The seat is lightweight, which makes it easy to move from room to room or travel with. The tray is very easy to install. Right now I put her in it and place on or two of the toys in our current rotation for her to play with on it. She seems to focus on them more in this upright position than she does in tummy time. I only use the seat after she has had some tummy time and I don’t keep her in it for more than 15-20 minutes.For what it is, I think the price is high. I don’t really need it as a booster seat, as we have a tripp trapp high chair and a Montessori table we’ll use when she starts solids next month. I can see how it would be helpful to people who don’t have or don’t want to buy those things.

source_doc: Fizzy bath tablets. I had previously tried a Monster Bubble product by the same brand, in spicy citrus, that I really love, so I was excited to try this assortment pack. What I realized is that the Monster Bubble is the same bath tablet, but in a larger size. And I realized that I actually prefer the larger tablet, as there is more scent and bath ingredients (I’m a huge believer in using Epsom salts and other minerals in the bath, and I love going to the hot springs for the same reason, so I’m a fan of products that add minerals to my bath). However, though I didn’t find the scents to be offensive, I didn’t love them as much as I loved the spicy citrus scent that I had originally tried. Overall I still enjoy using these bath tablets. I have come to really enjoy the pop of color in my bath, as well as the fragrance. The color doesn’t stain my tub but does kind of lift my spirits. I never realized that I would enjoy color in my bath, until I started using these tablets. I definitely prefer the larger sized Monster Bubbles, but overall still really enjoy the regular sized assorted tablets in this set.

source_doc: Haven't even had it 3 months... This mattress was great at first, but I got it for my son on November 14th for his Graco Solano crib. I loved that I didn't have to purchase a protective cover for it, as the material covering the foam allowed me to wipe it clean easily. But this is a terrible mattress for toddlers - for infants, it should be fine. My son is 16 months old and is walking around and loves to jump like a maniac in his crib. He grabs the side and goes to town like it's a trampoline. This mattress was not made with that thought in mind, as you can clearly see in the pictures that it busted open. I was getting my son ready for a bath and put him in the crib stark naked for only a moment, and he proceeded to immediately pee on the mattress. I figured, no big deal, I could just wipe it clean after his bath and change the sheets while he played in his playpen. When I removed the sheet, I saw the damage, and he happened to have peed over the hole and the urine had been absorbed by the foam. Now I have a peed on mattress whose inside I cannot clean, and I'm not about to let my son sleep on a mattress that is damaged and unsanitary. I will just have to purchase a different mattress that possibly requires a mattress protector.

source_doc: Nice half cup size for baby and toddler food. I got these to have a set of same-sized containers for when I make baby food, and I really like the 1/2 cup size.  Currently I’m putting the food in various containers I have, and I am wanting to be more orderly.  I like that the lids are sunken in the middle so one container can sit on top of another without sliding off.  Because these are plastic, they are lightweight if I need to take them on a day trip.  I like the various colored lids for sorting fruits, veggies, and meats. I have also found that the screw lids are leakproof, which is necessary for traveling.  I will say that they are indeed plastic, not brittle thin but not super thick either, so I do not expect them to last forever.  If they get too close to the dishwasher heat element I suspect they would melt. These state that they are microwave safe but I would not do it.  I would purchase glass ones if you need to microwave.

source_doc: Well ... if it's all you've got, it's better than nothing i guess. I really wish I'd taken photos of this after i used it the second time. I was hacking at a relatively small branch of a tree for my pet squirrel's habitat. It was the second time i used it and up until this use, i felt it was pretty sturdy and durable. I aimed and struck about 4 times and the ax head just broke right off the handle. I definitely wasn't expecting the head to just fall off. I'm hoping it was just an issue with this one ax and not the entirety of them. Like, maybe i just got a defective or a bad one ? Not going to pay more money to find out though. I hope you have a better experience with yours than i did mine if you do purchase one.

source_doc: Good keyboard for Mac. I have an apple wireless extended keyboard and I like the simplicity but was never happy typing on it for long periods of time.  I bought this one because I was hoping for the feel I had with the older Apple keyboards.  I miss those.  This one is a pretty good replacement.  The key feel is good for touch typing and the angle doesn't make my hands as tired after a long time banging away at the keys.The light effects I do not find necessary but I do like the setting that illuminates the key that was just typed.  I just wish there was a way to lock that selection in as if I accidentally hit the key that switches the light setting I have to toggle all the way back to where is was.

source_doc: Works for me and helps improve my sleep. I was a little unsure about this because I've tried a wide variety of supplements for sleep and not a lot has been effective.I bought these during a bout of stress induced insomnia causing me to wake up around 4-6 am, unable to fall back asleep. Or I would try to sleep early and would struggle for hours to fall asleep. I was exhausted and desperate.These tablets have seemingly helped to stabilize my sleep enough to where even if it's interrupted, I can get back to sleep quickly. I don't wake up feeling groggy like I do if I were to take something like zzzquil.I'm so happy to have these and will definitely always keep them stocked for those stretches of time where my sleep just won't cooperate.Edit: one caveat is these contain lactose. I do not recommend if you are severely intolerant. I have a sensitivity to lactose myself and sometimes I do get a little extra gassy/bloated from taking these, but not enough to where it disrupts my sleep. These are not effective for all situations but months later I still find them helpful most of the time.

source_doc: So convenient! My old pill organizer broke so I needed a new one. After comparing so many, this was my choice and I have been very happy with it. I don't actually take meds 3x daily, but in the morning I take vitamin C and biotin that are both chewables. So I put those in the center compartment. I love that the containers can be removed for travel when I might not need to pack the entire week's worth. I have had to come up with a way to easily fill these with my pills which is a little less convenient with the individual containers, but still worth it. I actually purchased 2 of these so that when I am filling them, I do both at the same time and don't have to deal with it as often.

source_doc: I can finally play the high notes. I am an adult casual learner of recorder. I started playing on a $12 yamaha plastic recorder and upgraded to a $30ish dollar wood recorder because I couldn't manage to play high notes. I like the tone of the wooden recorder for the most part but I have the same trouble with notes higher than "G" and couldn't really hit high "B" or "C" at all. With this recorder I am able to hit all of those notes. It's still not super easy but I'm getting better all the time, much less squeaking - the dogs are very thankful. I have read that the arched airway gives more "control" over pitch. As a beginner I can tell that this will be difficult for me as I can vary the pitch a lot unintentionally, would probably make an experienced player cringe. I downloaded a tuning app so I can work on being consistent with my pitch.I also really love the feel of this recorder. It feels more lightweight, refined and well built. I also like the snap on thumb rest. I am pleased with this purchase.

source_doc: How the...I LOVE IT. I LOVE IT. Basically, I have 5 tanks and at first was using really amazing usb pumps. They work great but after getting my 3rd tank and then a hospital tank and plant tank... so yeah... Here I am.Pros:- Can be used on 4 tanks and you can control the air flow for each one without it making the strength more/less on a different tank.- Pretty Quiet! I have my tanks in my living room and I don't hear it. I can hear the clicking on my keyboard more than the pump.- Easy to set up, comes with some airline tubing, and I just cut a bit and worked like a charm. Can't speak for the quality or longevity, but free anything is a plus nowadays.-Easy to hide in with the rest of my fish messCons:- Can get hot (but not hot to where I'm concerned though we shall see how it holds up)*will update if I have other issues*Overall - At the $39 I love it. Wish it came in black so I could hide it better but honestly I don't care. If I get more tanks I'll probably end up buying another.

source_doc: I'm impressed ! Honestly I was a bit skeptical when I bought it but I am pleasantly surprised.  It feels very sturdy !  I like how you can rotate the brush head. The padded grip is pretty nice.  The main bar is metal, then there is a plastic brush head and a plastic that clips on each end with a sliding pin system. The plastic feels pretty heavy as well as main metal piece. The scraper head is nothing special but I think it will work just fine.  It's not looking like I'm going to get to use this ice a rapper this year as I ordered it late in the season but my old one just recently broke.  It didn't help that it took 3 weeks to get here but that's not the seller's fault. Amazon was the shipper so I had to wait a week before they even shipped it, then I'm not sure what the hold up was w the shipping company. At some point they passed it off to USPS.  I have no clue why.  Anyways I honestly was impressed when I put it together, it has a good comfortable, sturdy feel to it.  It's pretty cool for as far as I've scrapers go I guess lol

source_doc: Great keyboard, but not for beginners. TL;DR: I REALLY like this keyboard, especially once you add different switches and keycaps, but it didn't work out because my accuracy sucks. Definitely not for beginners.Long review: I got the optical reds with this keyboard and it's definitely not for me since I'm a heavy typist. It's just too sensitive so I got the orange and bananas (yellow) optical switches to try them out. I do like the oranges but the ping on some of the switches is too dang loud and annoying so I settled with the bananas (yellow).Once I got them to my liking, it's time to test drive the keyboard. I'm not a typist per day but I can type. Not 100% accurate though, and that's where my problems arose. When I do make a mistake, I will almost 50% of the time would hit the "page up" instead of the backspace.. I do use "del" a lot as well and would hit the light switch instead.. If you're competent and have 99% accuracy when you type, it may work for you. Otherwise, get the K1 DE (what I did instead).

source_doc: Like the semi transparent ones better ---- Fits Acura Sedan & similar model -- Read review. I ordered these sun shades during Amazon prime day, but since it is winter time I didn't use them. Well, I recently got some moles and freckles removed from my face, so I am in complete vampire mode. That means I apply globs of sunscreen on face and hiss at the sight of sunlight, that is ......... until my skin heals.Yesterday, I pulled out these shades, happy that there was a dark option to help me stay in vampire mode, but both of the dark shades would not stick to my window. Only the two transparent ones worked. The transparent one is ok, but not nearly enough shade for those who need to be out of the sun. The darker ones are much better.  In fact, I would rather have bought 4 semi transparent ones instead of 2 transparent and 2 semi transparent.I guess I received a defective batch, but I still give them 5 stars because I sent them a message explaining the above situation, and they promptly responded stating they stand by their products and will ship me 2 working ones. 5 stars for the amazing customer service. I wish all companies were like them. Anyway, don't be like me and use this a month later. Check to make sure all shades work right when you receive them.Hope my review helps!

source_doc: Love it. 40LB great beginner weight to lift heavy. I'm a pretty out-of-shape woman I wanted to start lifting heavy meaning going as heavy as I could reasonably handle as a beginner but also without hurting myself or just being psycally unable to lift it.  I chose this 40LB kettlebell.  I think it's perfect. I do my squats with two 15 LB barbells so I went back and forth between the 40, 50, and 95 LB weights.  After getting this one I think 40 is perfect.  50 is the max I realistically prob could have handled and anything over that would have been a mistake for me. I can lift it with one arm, over my head, and do all my squat sets comfortably I get winded at the end but it feels good. I bought it used at 43bucks which is a great deal.  I had to sand the handle a bit because of some sharp bits and it arrived busted out of the box since the box the shipper chose was way too big for this item and it knocked around during transit.  That said it did not sustain any damage in transit. It was bubble wrapped well.  It has a few miner scuffs and chipped paint but I don't care about any of that stuff just mentioning it for the people who are concerned.  I made an awesome choice.

It saves me money because I don't have to buy the disposable product. I spent less on this item than I would on enough disposables to last the month, so it's worth it. I recommend this product!

These are quite lovely and come well packed Ed, tightly preventing any damage so yes, you have to fiddle with them to spread out the branches maybe for a minute for each pot but it’s literally no time at all. Yes they are white plastic pots! In my case? They are on windowsills where I will be opening the windows so, I bought a bag of River Stones at the dollar store and filled each pot so when the breeze from the open window hits them they won’t topple over. You could probably use any stones or even dirt but I liked the weight of the River stones. Not my first rodeo with these plants! I loved them so much I bought a set of six Cactus potted plants plants as well. They’ll get a nice review too. I have two left over from the 8 pack and they’ll go on a small night stand in my guest room. I’ve already had to warn the cleaning lady NOT TO WATER MY PLANTS! LOL also, the center pots in my pics are MINE…I just dropped a pot in each to see how it looked and decided I liked it. I will be buying more for an Idea that I have for an arrangement I want to do. I 100% do recommend buying these! Good Luck and TRUST ME on this.

 TEXT:
hypothesis: Tyto vypadají DOST REALISTICKY a budou se hodit do malých až středně velkých prostor! Jsou opravdu krásné a přicházejí skvěle a pevně zabalené, což zabraňuje jakémukoli poškození, takže ano, musíte si s nimi trochu pohrát a rozprostřít větvičky, což zabere tak minutu u každého květináče, ale to není doslova vůbec žádný čas. Ano, jsou to bílé plastové květináče! V mém případě? Mám je na parapetech, kde budu otevírat okna, takže jsem v levném obchodě koupil/a pytel říčních kamenů a každý květináč naplnil/a, aby se nepřevrátily, když se do nich opře vánek z otevřeného okna. source_doc: Don’t waste your time or money. I have a 6 year old German Shepherd that was going on a 1k mile road trip with me. I wanted her to be more comfortable while strapped into a safety harness in the backseat of my GMC Terrain. I ended up purchasing this 1 piece grey inflatable seat extender in a bind because a different product I ordered had been delayed and wouldn’t arrive in time. I read the reviews and knew I was taking a chance.Product inflated easily using a shop vac. It fit very well and I was able to adjust seat position and seat back easily.The outside temp was around 28° F so I left it inside the house after checking the fit thinking I would pop it in place before hitting the road.In a 70° F room it completely deflated in under an hour. I checked the plug, reinflated it and again it was completely deflated in under an hour. I decided to give it one more chance; fully inflating it and checked it for leaks in the bathtub. I could not find a single location where air was escaping. No air bubbles at any seams or the plug.I ended up putting empty cardboard boxes in the floorboard instead of using this product.Don’t buy it. It’s not worth the high chance that it will be defective.

source_doc: Very convenient way to work on my bike. This repair stand has made working on my bike much easier.  My back is not what it used to be, so I prefer to sit when working on my bike.  I used to flip my bike over and balance it on its handle bars and seat to perform maintenance and repairs.  Now I just clamp it in and go.  I can work on the derailleurs so much more effectively now that it can be upright instead of upside down.  I do not have an e-bike so I am not sure if it would handle that weight.  My bike is about 58lbs to give you and idea of what I have been using this stand for.  The tool tray has magnets that are great for holding the little nuts and bolts that have to be removed.  The tray is sturdy enough to hold my commonly used tools, but I would recommend not putting too much weight on that particular part.  The clamp has been kind to my bike's finish and has not scratched it at all.  I don't fold the stand up very often because I have enough space not to worry, but I do like having the option.  It folds up easily and is pretty compact.  I recommended this to anyone that prefers to do their own bike maintenance.

source_doc: Very Helpful. I first learned of these strips from my orthopedic surgeon. And back then I used them for carpal tunnel symptoms as well as tennis elbow symptoms. That also ended up hurting other areas on the back of my knees. And I got to thinking, KT tape. I did research on how to use this tape for my knees. I do not by any means recommend anyone to diagnose their own symptoms etc. But I can tell you, I am now in my 60's and this definitely did the trick for me. This is amazing tape for aches and pains that do not require surgery. I am now able to walk better and do more things that I haven't done in a while. Make sure to see your doctor for severe injuries. This tape did give me back my legs so I could walk without hurting after a 30 minute grocery store run etc. And if applied correctly, I can shower a day or two and it still sticks. Thank you for this tape. I can see why athletes use this.

source_doc: Wish the Structural Part was Better Designed. I so want to love this bag for cloth diapers. It does very well with keeping the smell contained, looks nice, and I love the zipper bottom and how it fits with a hanger. However, the plastic pieces that provide the structure push themselves through the fabric during the washing process. I have mended it multiple times and they keep finding ways to push through...and the main one is difficult to put back in. The last time it happened, I decided I was done fixing it and got a different bag. The fabric near the ends of these plastic pieces needs to be reinforced. My other issue is that after washing once I left it in the washer a little too long and after going through the dryer on highest heat there were little spots that I guess I assumed were mold spots. I immediately washed again and made sure to move to dryer right away and they seemed to be gone. But they have come back over and over. I'm not sure how to dry hanging and keep these spots from developing, and the dryer makes the plastic pieces push through the fabric worse. If this bag was redesigned with reinforcements, I would consider purchasing again because I do like it apart from the two issues I talked about.
